summary: Traditional Polish Easter white sausage parboiled and baked until golden in a roasting pan with lard and onions.
steps: Coil the white sausage into a wreath, prick in a few spots with a fork, parboil with salt over low heat for about 10 minutes, then remove and drain.
Peel the onions and slice them into half-moons.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C, place the sausage in a roasting pan over melted lard, surround with the onions, and bake for about 30 minutes.
Serve the hot sausage topped with the roasted onions.

name: Spaghetti with ham and broccoli (Spaghetti z szynką)
summary: Spaghetti with broccoli and ham strips in a garlic and dry white wine sauce, finished with grated Parmesan.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water, drain, and set aside in a warm place.
Briefly parboil the broccoli, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Peel and crush the garlic, fry in the butter mixed with oil, then pour in the white wine and simmer until two-thirds of the liquid has evaporated.
Cut the ham into strips, add to the sauce along with the broccoli, and season with salt and pepper.
Portion the spaghetti onto plates, pour over the sauce, and sprinkle with grated Parmesan just before serving.

name: Chicken fillets in white wine and sage
summary: Tender pounded chicken fillets pan-fried with fresh sage leaves and simmered in dry white wine.
steps: Wash and pat dry the chicken fillets, slice them into halves, and gently pound them with a mallet.
Dust the meat with the flour mixed with salt.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet and fry the fillets on one side until golden.
Turn the meat over, place a sage leaf on each piece, and brown on the other side.
Toward the end of cooking, pour in the white wine and simmer briefly until the sauce reduces slightly.

name: Ryżowe kulki nadziewane mielonym mięsem (rice balls stuffed with minced meat)
summary: Golden-fried breaded rice balls filled with a savoury stuffing of minced meat, sautéed onion, chopped almonds, and raisins.
steps: Cook the rice until parboiled and slightly tender, then let it cool slightly.
Peel and chop the onion, cook until translucent in the hot oil, then add the minced meat, blanched and chopped almonds, and rinsed raisins.
Cook the filling until the meat is browned and cooked through, and season with salt and pepper.
Shape the rice into small, thin patties, place a spoonful of meat filling in the centre of each, seal the edges, and roll into neat balls.
Roll the rice balls in beaten egg and breadcrumbs, then fry in hot oil on all sides until golden brown.

name: Roast beef in green peppercorn sauce (Wołowina w sosie pieprzowym)
summary: Oven-bag-roasted beef roll served with a creamy sauce of white wine, blended onion, sour cream, mustard, and green peppercorns.
steps: Wash and pat dry the meat, rub with salt and pepper, roll up, place in an oven roasting bag, and set on a baking sheet.
Roast the beef for about 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.
Melt the butter in a pot, add the chopped onion and garlic, pour in the white wine, add the mustard, and cook gently covered for 5 minutes.
Blend the braised onion, pour in the vegetable broth, add the green peppercorns, and cook for 15 minutes.
Whisk the sour cream with the flour, pour into the sauce, and stir.
Cook the sauce for a moment longer, stirring, season with salt and pepper, pour into a gravy boat, and serve with the roasted meat.

name: Braised beef with vegetables (Wołowina z warzywami)
summary: Beef strips braised with caramelized onions, red wine, and soy sauce, combined with parboiled root vegetables.
steps: Peel and chop the onions, fry them in oil, and sprinkle with sugar.
Add the beef cut into strips and brown, then add the red wine, soy sauce, bay leaves, and thyme, and braise until the meat is tender.
Wash and peel the carrots, turnip, and celeriac, cut into small dice, and cook until tender-crisp in lightly salted water.
Just before the vegetables are fully cooked, add the braised meat with sauce, simmer covered until done, and season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Roast turkey breast stuffed with peaches (Pierś indyka z brzoskwiniami)
summary: Turkey breast fillet marinated in orange juice, stuffed with diced peaches and roasted in foil.
steps: Wash and dry the turkey fillet, place in a bowl, pour over the orange juice, cover, and refrigerate for about 60 minutes.
Blanch the peaches, peel the skin, cut in half, remove the pits, and dice the flesh.
Remove the meat from the orange juice, drain, cut a deep pocket into it, stuff with the peach pieces, and secure the edges with toothpicks.
Season the fillet with salt and white pepper, wrap tightly in aluminium foil, place in a roasting pan, and bake for about 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Makaron w śmietanowym sosie (pasta with steamed vegetables and creamy cheese sauce)
summary: Farfalle pasta with steamed vegetables, green peas, and a cream and processed cheese sauce, garnished with anchovy fillets.
steps: Cook the farfalle pasta al dente and drain.
Wash the broccoli, zucchini, and carrots, steam them until tender, then cut into smaller pieces.
Toss the hot pasta with the chopped vegetables and drained green peas, and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the whipping cream with the processed cheese in a saucepan, stirring until smooth.
Pour the warm creamy cheese sauce over the pasta and vegetables, and garnish with anchovy fillets.

name: Chilled creamy zucchini soup
summary: Delicate cold soup blended from zucchini, potatoes, and onion enriched with milk and garnished with chives.
steps: Wash the zucchini, trim the ends, shave a few thin ribbons or slices for serving, and dice the remainder. Peel and dice the potatoes, and peel and slice the onion into rings.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan, sauté the onion, add the diced zucchini, and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.
Transfer the vegetables to a pot, pour in the milk and 500 ml of water, add the potatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer covered for 25 minutes.
Blend the soup until silky smooth, stir in the potato starch, and cook over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Cool the soup thoroughly and serve garnished with the reserved zucchini slices and chopped chives.

name: Fasolka szparagowa z cząbrem (green beans with tomatoes and savory)
summary: Tender green beans served with diced blanched tomatoes, olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and aromatic savory.
steps: Wash the green beans, trim the ends, remove any strings, and cut the pods into pieces about 5 cm long.
Boil the green beans with salt and sugar until tender, then drain.
Blanch the tomatoes, peel off their skins, and dice the flesh.
Drizzle the cooked beans with olive oil and lemon juice, toss with the diced tomatoes, and sprinkle with chopped savory.

name: Kolorowa papryka w oliwie (marinated bell peppers in olive oil)
summary: An appetiser of tri-coloured bell peppers marinated overnight in olive oil with garlic, parsley, and fish fillets.
steps: Finely chop the parsley, and divide the peeled garlic: mince three cloves through a press, and slice one clove thinly.
Wash the green, red, and yellow bell peppers, remove the seeds, and cut the pods into 2–3 cm pieces.
Toss the peppers with the minced garlic and arrange on a serving platter.
Scatter the chopped parsley and garlic slices over the top and arrange the fileciki helskie fish fillets over them.
Season with salt, drizzle with 85 ml of olive oil, and leave overnight in a cool place.

name: Corn-stuffed tomato and cucumber cups (Warzywne miseczki)
summary: Hollowed-out tomatoes and cucumber rounds filled with a fresh salad of freshly cooked sweetcorn, garlic, and fresh parsley.
steps: Remove the silks and husks from the ears of corn, place them into boiling water with a tablespoon of sugar, and cook until tender for 20–25 minutes.
Slice the tops off the tomatoes, trim the ends of the cucumber, and cut it into large chunks.
Hollow out the pulp from the tomatoes and cucumber chunks, leaving the bottoms intact to create cups, and dice the scooped-out flesh.
Cut the cooked corn kernels from the cobs and mix them with the diced vegetable pulp and chopped fresh parsley.
Mash the minced garlic with the oil, salt, white pepper, and lemon juice, combine with the corn mixture, and spoon the filling into the hollowed-out vegetables.

name: Red cabbage salad with mandarins (Surówka z kapusty)
summary: Crisp red cabbage salad with mandarin segments, slivered almonds, orange juice, and ginger.
steps: Rinse the red cabbage and shred finely, removing the core and thickest ribs.
Peel the mandarins and divide into segments.
Scald the almonds with boiling water, slip off skins, and cut into slivers.
Transfer the cabbage to a salad bowl, drizzle with orange juice and sunflower oil, toss with the mandarins and almonds, and season to taste with salt, sugar, and ginger.

name: Curry spaghetti (makaron z curry)
summary: Quick spaghetti with a mild sauce of whipping cream, grated Parmesan, butter, and curry powder.
steps: Cook the spaghetti pasta al dente and drain.
Whisk the whipping cream with the grated Parmesan and curry powder, then gently warm the sauce in a saucepan.
Toss the hot spaghetti with the butter and pour over the prepared curry sauce.

name: Tomato tartlets (Tartaletki z pomidorami)
summary: Flaky shortcrust tartlets made with curd cheese pastry, filled with a thick, sweet and tangy fresh tomato mousse.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: half a teaspoon for the dough and to taste for the filling

steps: Sift the plain flour onto a pastry board, add half a teaspoon of salt, the margarine, and minced farmer's cheese, quickly knead into a dough, wrap in cling film, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll out the chilled dough into a thin sheet, line tartlet tins with it, and bake until golden in an oven preheated to 200 °C for 15–20 minutes.
Wash the tomatoes, cut them into quarters, transfer to a saucepan, and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes until completely broken down.
Pass the cooked tomatoes through a sieve, reheat the purée, season with salt and sugar, then thicken with the potato starch dissolved in a splash of water and simmer briefly.
Remove the cooled tartlets from the tins, fill them with the thick tomato purée, and garnish with fresh mint or basil leaves.

name: Kolorowa zapiekanka (colourful vegetable bake)
summary: Vegetable bake with pumpkin, broccoli, Brussels sprouts, turnip, and tomatoes under béchamel sauce and firm cheese.
steps: Wash the vegetables, peel the pumpkin and turnip and slice them, blanch and peel the tomatoes and cut into slices, and divide the broccoli into florets.
Parboil the Brussels sprouts and turnip in salted boiling water for 5 minutes, and the broccoli florets for 2–3 minutes, then drain the vegetables in a sieve and cut the Brussels sprouts in half.

Melt 1 tbsp of butter in a saucepan, stir in a heaped tablespoon of plain flour, pour in 250 ml of cold milk, season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg, and cook, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
Rub a baking dish with the cut clove of garlic and grease with the remaining tablespoon of butter, then arrange the prepared vegetables in it.
Dust the vegetables with grated nutmeg and oregano, pour over the sauce, and sprinkle with grated firm cheese.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for 30 minutes.

name: Kapusta zapiekana z orzechami (baked young cabbage with walnuts)
summary: Young cabbage quarters baked under béchamel sauce with breadcrumbs and walnuts.
steps: Remove outer cabbage leaves, wash the heads, cut into quarters, and boil in salted water for 8–10 minutes after boiling, then drain in a colander.
Melt half of the butter in a pan, stir in the wheat flour, and cook over low heat, stirring constantly.
Slowly whisk in the milk, cook until the sauce thickens, and season with salt and pepper.
Grease a baking dish with the remaining butter, arrange the cabbage, pour over the sauce, and sprinkle with breadcrumbs and finely chopped walnuts.
Bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C for about 15 minutes.

name: Leek lasagne
summary: Vegan vegetable bake with sheets of blanched leek layered with stewed vegetables.
steps: Trim and wash the vegetables. Cut off the green parts and root ends from the leeks, slice the white stalks lengthwise, and cut into 10–12 cm sections.
Drop the leeks into salted boiling water, cook for 4 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Dice the zucchini, celeriac, and carrots. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large frying pan and fry the carrots with the celeriac.
Add the zucchini and green peas and cook gently, covered, for 20 minutes; after 10 minutes add the blanched, peeled, and diced tomatoes, then season with salt and pepper.
Grease a baking dish with the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, arrange 4 layers of leek sheets and vegetable mixture, and bake for 10 minutes in the oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Baked vegetable stew
summary: Baked vegetable stew made with zucchini, eggplant, bell pepper, and potatoes tossed with herbs.
steps: Peel and finely chop the onion, and wash the remaining vegetables.
Peel the potatoes, deseed the bell pepper, dice the zucchini, potatoes, and pepper, and cut the eggplant into bite-sized pieces.
Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan, saute the vegetables with the onion for 7–8 minutes, and season with salt and black pepper.
Grease a baking dish with the remaining oil, transfer the vegetables into it, sprinkle with oregano and basil, and press down lightly.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 20 minutes, and garnish with chopped parsley leaves before serving.

name: Paprykowy tort (layered bell pepper and mozzarella meatloaf)
summary: A baked ground meat casserole layered with diced mozzarella, assembled in a pan lined with colourful bell peppers and smoked bacon.
steps: Wash the bell peppers, halve them lengthwise and remove the seeds, then cut the mozzarella into cubes.
Mix the minced meat with the egg and thyme, and season the mixture with salt and pepper.
Line a round baking tin with aluminium foil and grease it with oil.
Arrange the bell pepper halves on the bottom of the tin and line the sides with slices of smoked bacon.
Spoon half of the meat mixture into the tin, scatter the mozzarella cubes over it, and cover with the remaining meat.
Bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Turn the finished casserole out onto a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh parsley leaves.

name: Bakłażanowe zawijasy (eggplant rolls wrapped in smoked bacon)
summary: Baked eggplant rolls filled with bell pepper, onion, and herbs, wrapped in crisp bacon.

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp for the stuffing, 1 tbsp for greasing the baking dish

steps: Wash the eggplants, slice them lengthwise into slices about 5 mm thick, arrange on a baking sheet, and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
Peel and chop the onion, and finely dice the green bell pepper.
Combine the onion and bell pepper with 3 tablespoons of oil and dried herbs, then season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Spread a portion of the vegetable stuffing over each eggplant slice, roll up, wrap with a slice of smoked bacon, and secure with a toothpick.
Arrange the rolls in a baking dish greased with the remaining tablespoon of oil and bake for 10 minutes at 220 °C.

name: Zupa z papryki (Polish bell pepper soup)
summary: A light, vegan vegetable soup made with a broth of Polish soup vegetables, diced potatoes, and fresh bell pepper strips, finished with lemon juice.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: boiling water to make the broth

steps: Clean and chop the soup vegetables, drop them into boiling water, add the bay leaf, allspice, mustard seeds, salt, pepper, and vegetable oil, and cook for about 40 minutes.
Peel and dice the potatoes, and slice the seeded bell peppers into strips.
Add the potatoes and bell peppers to the broth and cook for another 20 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season the soup to taste with lemon juice and a pinch of sugar, and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Ryba zapiekana z ziemniakami (fish baked with potatoes)
summary: A simple casserole of fish fillets, sliced potatoes, and onion baked in milk and garnished with fresh parsley.
steps: Rinse and pat dry the fish fillets, then season them with salt.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into slices; peel and finely chop the onion.
Grease a baking dish with margarine, lay the fish fillets on the bottom, and arrange the potato slices and chopped onion on top.
Season everything with salt and pour in the milk.
Bake for about 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 150 °C, and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Baked salmon (Pieczony łosoś)
summary: Juicy salmon fillet marinated with fresh basil, fish seasoning, and lemon juice, baked with butter in a roasting sleeve.
steps: Wash and dry the salmon, rub with fish seasoning, sprinkle with chopped basil, drizzle with lemon juice, and refrigerate for about 3 hours.
Cut the chilled butter into small pieces and distribute them across the top of the fish.
Place the salmon in an oven roasting sleeve and bake for about 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.
Garnish the baked salmon with lemon slices before serving.

name: Greek-style chicken with feta and tomatoes
summary: Chicken breast stew braised with red bell pepper, tomatoes, olives, garlic, and crumbled feta cheese.
steps: Dice the chicken breast fillet and brown it in a saucepan in the melted butter.
Add the chopped onion and strips of bell pepper, frying until the vegetables soften.
Add the chopped canned tomatoes with their juice, sliced olives, and chopped garlic, simmering everything over low heat.
Add the diced feta cheese and season with oregano, rosemary, sweet paprika, chicken seasoning, salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar.
Scatter over the chopped parsley and heat for a few moments more.

name: Śledź na czerwono (herring in tomato sauce)
summary: Herring fillet pieces layered in a jar with onions stewed in tomato paste and spices.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: if needed to thin the sauce

steps: Peel and chop the onions, then cook them in vegetable oil until translucent.
Add the tomato paste and a little water if needed, season with salt, sugar, pepper, and paprika, heat for about 1 minute, then cool completely.
Cut the herring fillets into pieces, layer in a jar alternately with the cooled tomato-onion mixture, and chill overnight (about 12 hours).

name: Diablotins (cheese croutons)
summary: Crispy baguette toasts baked with a savoury spread of butter, egg yolks, sharp cheese, and sweet paprika, served with clear soups.
steps: Cream the butter with the egg yolks until smooth, then mix in the grated cheese, sweet paprika, and salt.
Cut the baguette into square pieces and spread them generously with the prepared cheese and butter mixture.
Arrange the toasts on a baking sheet and bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 10 minutes until golden.

name: Potato salad with egg (Sałatka ziemniaczana z jajkiem)
summary: A salad of boiled potatoes, raw celeriac, tomatoes, onion, and hard-boiled eggs with an olive oil and lemon dressing.
steps: Whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and set the dressing aside.
Peel the potatoes, boil until tender, allow to cool, and slice into thick half-rounds.
Peel and wash the celeriac, pat dry, and cut into thin matchsticks, then cut the tomatoes into wedges.
In a salad bowl, combine the potatoes, celeriac, and tomatoes, then arrange onion rings and eggs cut into eighths on top.
Scatter the chopped parsley leaves over the salad and drizzle with the prepared dressing.

name: Bułeczki faszerowane (stuffed bread rolls)
summary: Hollowed small bread rolls filled with a pesto, parsley, and olive oil paste, topped with roasted peppers, ham, mould-ripened cheese, mushrooms, and olives.

ingredients.name: pickled green olives stuffed with pimiento

steps: Roast the red bell peppers lightly in the oven, peel away the skin, remove the seeds, and cut the flesh into strips.
Slice the tops off the small bread rolls and hollow out the crumb from the bottoms.
Blend the scooped crumb with the pesto sauce, chopped parsley leaves, lemon juice, and olive oil, then spoon the filling into the rolls.
Top the rolls with ham slices, pepper strips, slices of mould-ripened cheese, pickled mushrooms, and pickled green olives with pimiento.

name: Tilapia with chanterelles, porcini, and rosemary (Tilapia z kurkami, borowikami i rozmarynem)
summary: Pan-seared tilapia served with penne in a chanterelle, porcini, and white wine sauce, alongside beetroot slices simmered in red wine.
steps: Marinate the fish with lemon pepper and part of the truffle oil.
Clean the chanterelles and porcini, sauté them with the chopped onion in butter, pour in the white wine, and set aside.
Cook the beetroot until tender in red wine with the bay leaf, then slice it.
Cook the penne pasta in salted water, drain, and toss with the chanterelle and porcini sauce, seasoning with salt, pepper, rosemary, and chopped fresh parsley.
Pan-fry the marinated fish, arrange it on plates alongside the mushroom pasta and beetroot slices, and drizzle everything with the remaining truffle oil.

name: Makaron z jesiennymi grzybami (pasta with honey mushrooms in sour cream sauce)
summary: Farfalle pasta in a sour cream sauce with braised honey mushrooms, onion, and thyme.
steps: Cook the farfalle pasta al dente and drain.
Clean, wash, and slice the honey mushrooms, and peel and finely chop the onion.
Melt the butter in a pan and sauté the chopped onion.
Add the sliced honey mushrooms to the onion, season with salt, pour in the water, and braise covered until tender.
Dust the mushrooms with wheat flour, cook for a moment longer, then pour in the sour cream and bring to a boil.
Season the sauce with salt, pepper, lemon juice, and thyme, and toss with the warm pasta.

name: Norwegian-style marinated salmon
summary: An appetizer of raw salmon strips cured for 24 hours in fresh lemon juice, French wholegrain mustard, and fresh dill.
steps: Clean, rinse, and gently dry the salmon fillets, trim off the skin, and slice the flesh diagonally into strips about 5 mm thick.
Scald and dry the lemons, set aside a few slices for garnish, and squeeze the juice from the rest.
Place the salmon strips in a dish, pour over the lemon juice, add the French mustard and finely chopped dill, and mix thoroughly.
Cover the dish with plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 24 hours, then garnish with the reserved lemon slices before serving.

name: Pan-fried liver with rhubarb and apple sauce (Wątróbka z rabarbarem)
summary: Pan-fried flour-dusted liver slices served with a sweet and sour sauce of rhubarb, tart apples, and onion.
steps: Peel the apples and onions and cut them into large dice, and cut the washed and trimmed rhubarb into one-centimetre pieces.
Add the onion and rhubarb to the melted butter, add the apples, pour in the meat broth and wine vinegar, and bring to the boil.
Thicken the sauce with a teaspoon of gravy, simmer over low heat for a minute, and season with salt, pepper, and sugar.
Coat the liver slices in flour, fry in the hot fat for 3 minutes on each side, season with salt and pepper, then serve drizzled with the rhubarb sauce and sprinkled with fresh parsley.

name: Potrawka z kurczaka (Braised chicken with root vegetables)
summary: Chicken legs and breast fillets braised with grated Polish soup vegetables, onion, and warming whole spices.
steps: Brown the chicken legs and breast fillets in heated oil until golden.
Peel and wash the celeriac, carrots, and parsley root, grate them coarsely, and slice the onion.
In a separate pan with a splash of oil, braise the grated vegetables gently with the onion.
Transfer the braised vegetables to the pot with the chicken, then add the bay leaf, allspice berries, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper.
Braise everything for about 30 minutes, adding a little water as needed.

name: Kartoflanka (Polish potato soup with smoked bacon and wild mushrooms)
summary: Traditional Polish potato soup made on meat broth with dried forest mushrooms and smoked bacon.
steps: Add the soup greens, crumbled dried mushrooms, and peeled, diced potatoes to the meat broth, then simmer for about 15 minutes.
Remove the cooked greens from the soup, chop them finely, and return them to the pot.
Fry the diced smoked bacon in a skillet, add the chopped onion, sauté until golden, and transfer everything into the soup.
Temper the 12% sour cream with a few spoonfuls of hot broth, pour it into the pot, and bring to a boil.
Before serving, sprinkle the soup generously with chopped parsley leaves or dill.

name: Zupa serowa (Quick cheese soup)
summary: A quick soup made with vegetable broth, butter-braised onions, and grated firm cheese, served with cheese toasts.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for cooking the onion gently covered and rubbing with flour

steps: Peel and finely chop the onion.
Melt the butter in a pot, add the onion, and cook gently covered for 5 minutes, taking care that it does not brown.
Add the bay leaf, pour in the vegetable broth, and thicken the soup with the flour rubbed with a little butter, stirring vigorously.
Simmer over low heat for 5 minutes, then season with salt and pepper, add the grated firm cheese, and stir thoroughly.
Remove the bay leaf before serving and serve the soup with cheese toasts.

name: Zupa pomidorowo-czosnkowa (Tomato and garlic soup)
summary: An aromatic, quick soup made with fresh tomatoes cooked gently with garlic and parsley in vegetable broth.
steps: Scald the tomatoes with boiling water, peel off the skins, and chop finely.
Peel and very finely chop the garlic, and wash, dry, and chop the parsley.
Heat the oil in a pot, add the garlic, tomatoes, and part of the parsley, and fry for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the hot vegetable broth and bring everything to a boil.
Season the soup with salt, pepper, and lemon juice, ladle into bowls, and sprinkle with the remaining parsley.

name: Apricot and white wine mousse
summary: A light mousse made from simmered apricots, dry white wine, and honey, set with gelatin and served with whipped cream.
steps: Wash and dry the apricots, cut them in half, discard the pits, then simmer in a small amount of water and blend into a smooth puree.
Pour the dry white wine into the fruit puree and sweeten to taste with honey.
Soak the gelatin sheets in cold water, dissolve them in a few tablespoons of hot water, and stir into the apricot mixture.
Spoon the dessert into dessert bowls, chill in the refrigerator until set, and garnish with whipped cream before serving.

name: Crispy homemade waffles
summary: Crisp homemade waffles made with flour, milk, melted fat, and egg whites beaten to stiff peaks.
steps: Melt the margarine and allow it to cool.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites, then beat the yolks with the sugar and vanilla sugar until fluffy.
Pour the cooled melted margarine into the beaten yolks and mix thoroughly.
Mix the flour with the baking powder and add it gradually to the batter alternately with the milk.
Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold them into the batter.
Bake portions of batter in a preheated waffle maker until golden and crisp.

name: Spaghetti with tuna (Spaghetti z tuńczykiem)
summary: Spaghetti with a sauce of canned tuna in its own juices, diced tomatoes, onion, and garlic.

ingredients.name: canned tuna in its own juices

steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water and drain.
Heat the oil in a pan, fry the diced onion until golden, then add the pressed or finely minced garlic.
Add the tuna, followed shortly by the diced tomatoes, and simmer over low heat for about 10–15 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper, spoon over the cooked pasta, and optionally sprinkle with grated cheese.

name: Potato gratin (Zapiekanka ziemniaczana)
summary: A classic casserole of thin potato slices layered with firm cheese and nutmeg, baked under hot milk in a garlic-rubbed dish.
steps: Peel the potatoes, wash them, and cut into thin slices.
Rub a baking dish with garlic and arrange the potatoes in layers.
Season each layer with salt, pepper, nutmeg, and grated firm cheese, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bring the milk to a boil and pour it over the potatoes.
Place the dish in an oven preheated to 200 °C and bake for about 40 minutes.

name: Zebra cake (Zebra)
summary: A traditional two-tone cake with distinctive stripes, made with eggs, vegetable oil, and sparkling water.
steps: Beat whole eggs with sugar until pale and fluffy.
While stirring continuously, gradually add the oil, flour mixed with baking powder, and sparkling water.
Divide the batter into 2 equal parts; mix 3 tablespoons of flour into one part, and 3 tablespoons of cocoa into the other.
Alternately spoon 3 tablespoons of dark and light batter into the center of a springform pan, starting with the dark batter.
Bake for 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.

name: Quick tomato and pepper salad (Szybka sałatka z pomidorów z papryką)
summary: A simple salad of fresh tomatoes, cucumber, red bell pepper, onion, and chives with vegetable oil and lemon juice.
steps: Wash and drain the vegetables, then peel the onion and cut into rings.
Halve the bell pepper, remove the seeds and cut the flesh into strips. Slice the unpeeled cucumber and quarter the tomatoes.
Transfer the vegetables to a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and drizzle with the oil whisked with lemon juice.
Scatter chopped chives over the salad and toss thoroughly.

name: Warming shrimp soup
summary: Fragrant Asian-style broth with shrimp, sea fish, shiitake mushrooms, lemongrass, ginger, and chili.
steps: Pound the chopped chili pepper, lemongrass, ginger, and part of the fresh coriander in a mortar.
Bring the broth to a boil in a pot, then add the sliced shiitake mushrooms, peeled shrimp, and sea fish pieces.
Add the pounded herb paste, lime juice, cane sugar, and fish sauce, and simmer for 2 minutes.
Chop the remaining coriander leaves, stir into the soup, adjust seasoning with extra lime juice or fish sauce if needed, and ladle into bowls.

name: Kotlety mielone z nadzieniem serowym (minced meat patties with cheese filling)
summary: Minced beef patties stuffed with mozzarella, parsley, and sour cream, braised gently after browning.
steps: Peel the onion, chop finely, and cook until translucent in 1 tbsp of oil.
Soak the stale roll, squeeze out excess liquid, and mix with the minced meat, eggs, and sautéed onion, seasoning the mixture with salt, pepper, and marjoram.
Finely chop the mozzarella and parsley, and mix them with the sour cream.
Divide the meat mixture into 8 equal flattened patties, top 4 of them with the cheese filling, cover with the remaining 4 portions of meat, and seal the edges thoroughly.
Fry the patties on both sides in the remaining oil, then lower the heat towards the end, add a splash of water, and braise for several minutes.

name: Caprese cherry tomato skewers (Szaszłyki z pomidorków koktajlowych)
summary: Chilled Italian-style appetizer skewers of whole cherry tomatoes, mini mozzarella balls, and fresh basil, drizzled with olive oil.
steps: Wash and dry the cherry tomatoes, and drain the mini mozzarella balls from their brine.
Thread onto skewers alternately whole cherry tomatoes, mozzarella, and fresh basil leaves.
Drizzle the assembled skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

name: Zupa gulaszowa z kasztanami i winem (Goulash soup with chestnuts and wine)
summary: A hearty goulash soup braised in dry red wine and broth with fresh thyme, carrots, and canned chestnuts.

ingredients.name: turkey meat
ingredients.note: or beef (turkey in ingredient list, beef in method)

steps: Cut the meat into small pieces, dust with rye flour, and fry in a small amount of hot oil until lightly browned.
Add the finely chopped onion and fry until golden.
Add the thyme sprigs, pour in the red wine and broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and braise covered for 60 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and canned chestnuts and simmer for another 60 minutes until all ingredients are tender.

name: Mięsne serduszka z brzoskwinią (breaded heart-shaped chicken cutlets with canned peach)
summary: Breaded chicken breast cutlets shaped into hearts and served hot topped with canned peach halves.
steps: Rinse and dry the chicken breast fillets, then gently pound them, shaping each cutlet like a heart.
Season the meat with salt, pepper, and chicken seasoning, then coat in the beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry the breaded cutlets in heated vegetable oil on both sides until golden.
Place a drained canned peach half on top of each fried cutlet and serve hot.

name: Caramel fish
summary: Fish fillets braised in a sweet-and-savoury caramel sauce made with brown sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, red onion, and garlic.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp for the fish, 2 tbsp for the onion

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: or lemon, for juice and wedges for serving

steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a skillet, add the fish fillets and fry for a few minutes on one side until lightly browned, then turn and fry for 1 minute.
Remove the fish from the skillet, pour in the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil, add the chopped red onion and minced garlic, and fry for 3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Pour in the dark soy sauce and fish sauce, and add the brown sugar.
Return the fish to the skillet and braise until the sauce thickens to a syrupy consistency.
Season the fish with pepper, drizzle with lime or lemon juice, and serve garnished with citrus wedges.

name: No-bake lemon biscuit dessert
summary: A chilled no-bake dessert made with crushed biscuits, a fluffy lemon butter-and-egg cream, dried fruit, and nuts.
steps: Beat the butter with the icing sugar until pale and fluffy, then mix in the grated lemon zest.
Continuing to beat, add the egg yolks one at a time and pour in half of the juice squeezed from the lemons.
Pour boiling water over the raisins, drain them, and fold into the mixture along with the finely chopped candied orange peel and crushed biscuits.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks, gently fold them into the mixture, transfer the dessert to a bowl, cover, and chill in the refrigerator for about 120 minutes.
Before serving, decorate the top with mandarin segments and blanched, peeled almonds.

name: Kaczka po czesku (Czech-style braised duck with quark and citrus sauce)
summary: Braised duck baked under a sauce of quark, cream, citrus zest, and raisins.
steps: Wash the dressed duck, cut into 4 pieces, rub with salt and nutmeg, and dust with wheat flour.
Heat cooking fat in a skillet, brown the duck pieces on all sides, drizzle with cream, cover, and braise until tender.
Remove the tender meat, partially debone, and arrange the duck pieces in a baking dish.
Mix the braising juices with the ground quark, grated lemon zest, grated orange zest, and rinsed raisins.
Pour the prepared sauce over the duck and bake in the oven.

name: Sałata zielona w kremie szynkowym (lettuce in creamy ham sauce)
summary: Whole heads of lettuce boiled and served warm with a light roux-based sauce containing finely chopped ham and whipped cream.
steps: Trim and rinse the heads of lettuce, place them in a pot of salted water, and simmer for about 10 minutes, then drain, reserving the cooking liquid, and keep warm.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour to make a roux, and gradually whisk in the reserved lettuce cooking broth until a smooth, light sauce forms.
Season the sauce with lemon juice and salt, stir in the finely chopped ham, and gently fold in the whipped cream.
Arrange the warm lettuce on a serving platter, pour the sauce over while leaving the green leaf tips exposed, and serve the remaining sauce in a gravy boat.

name: Lithuanian apple cheese (Ser jabłkowy)
summary: A traditional Lithuanian preserve made from long-simmered tart apples with sugar and cinnamon, dried in cloth bags to a dense, sliceable confection.
steps: Peel the apples, remove the cores, and cut the fruit into eighths or sixteenths.
Toss the apples with the sugar, mix thoroughly, and set aside for 1–2 days until plenty of juice is released.
Pour the released juice into a wide pot and simmer over very low heat until it darkens, thickens, and reduces by about half.
Add the sliced apples and cinnamon to the reduced juice (to achieve a marbled look, stir in 3/4 of the fruit first, and the rest right at the end).
Cook the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until it becomes very thick and pulls away cleanly from the sides of the pot.
Transfer the apple mixture into damp cheesecloth or linen bags (or into shallow dishes moistened with cold water), shape, and hang in a breezy place to dry.
Once the apple cheese has set and dried firm, wrap it in parchment paper and store in a cool, dry place or in the refrigerator.

name: Fresh vegetable salad with cheese (Surówka ze świeżych warzyw)
summary: Salad of tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and firm cheese with an olive oil and wine vinegar dressing, garlic, and fresh herbs.
steps: Wash and dry the tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper; slice tomatoes and cucumber into rounds, and cut cored bell pepper into thin rings.
Peel and finely mince the onion and garlic, and cut the firm cheese into small batons.
Rub a salad bowl with garlic and whisk together the olive oil, wine vinegar, minced garlic, salt, and pepper inside.
Toss the salad ingredients with the dressing in the bowl, and sprinkle with finely chopped fresh herbs just before serving.

name: Green bean and cranberry salad
summary: A quick vegan salad of green beans, sliced red onion, and cranberries tossed in an olive oil and wine vinegar dressing.
steps: Cook the green beans in salted boiling water for about 3 minutes, then drain and cool.
Peel the red onion and slice it into thin feathers.
Toss the cooled green beans, red onion, and cranberries with the olive oil and wine vinegar, then season to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Valentine's sorbet cocktail
summary: A frozen cocktail made from raspberry or blueberry sorbet blended with currant juice and chilled vodka.
steps: Transfer the raspberry or blueberry sorbet to a blender jar, pour in the currant juice and chilled vodka, and blend until smooth.
Pour the cocktail into chilled dessert glasses and serve immediately.

name: Smoked halibut and mandarin salad (Sałatka z wędzonego halibuta i mandarynki)
summary: A quick salad of smoked halibut, roasted or boiled beetroot, and mandarin segments with fresh mint and olive oil.
steps: Cut the smoked halibut slices into smaller bite-sized pieces.
Peel the cooked beetroots and cut them into thin slices.
Peel the mandarins, separate into segments, and gently toss with the sliced beetroots and fish pieces.
Transfer the salad to a serving dish, drizzle with olive oil, and garnish with fresh mint leaves.

name: Francuskie sakiewki z twarogiem (puff pastry parcels with quark and raisins)
summary: Crispy baked puff pastry parcels filled with sweet quark cheese, raisins, and egg yolk.
steps: Mash the quark in a bowl and mix with the sour cream, raisins, icing sugar, and egg yolk until smooth.
Preheat the oven to 210 °C.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of 3–4 mm and cut into 9 cm squares.
Place a teaspoon of quark filling in the center of each square and pinch opposite corners together to form parcels.
Arrange the parcels on a baking sheet lined with baking paper, brush with beaten egg, and bake for 15 minutes.

name: Spaghetti with broccoli in cheese sauce (Spaghetti z brokułami w sosie serowym)
summary: Spaghetti with braised broccoli in a thick sauce of firm cheese, processed cheese, white wine, and sour cream.
steps: Divide the broccoli into florets and lightly sauté in hot oil. Add a little water, cook gently until tender, then break into smaller pieces with a wooden spoon.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the grated firm cheese, processed cheese, and white wine or milk, and heat while stirring continuously until the cheeses melt completely.
Pour the cheese sauce over the broccoli, fold in the thick sour cream, and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, drain, arrange onto plates, spoon the sauce over, and top with grated Parmesan.

name: Souvlaki (Suwlaki)
summary: Greek skewers of tenderloin marinated in lemon juice, olive oil, soy sauce, garlic and oregano, with onion and bell pepper.
steps: Mix the lemon juice, olive oil, soy sauce, oregano, and finely minced garlic in a bowl.
Add the diced tenderloin along with pieces of red onion and bell pepper, toss thoroughly, cover, and chill in the refrigerator for 150 minutes.
Thread the marinated meat along with pieces of onion and pepper onto skewers.
Grill the skewers on a hot grate or in the oven for about 20 minutes until browned.

name: Gyros (pan-fried seasoned pork strips)
summary: Tender pork strips marinated in spiced herb marinade with oregano and paprika, then quickly pan-fried.
steps: Rinse the pork in cold water, pat dry with paper towels, slice each cutlet lengthwise, and cut into thin strips.
Mix the salt, black pepper, ground paprika, and oregano in a bowl, stir into the water, and add the vegetable oil.
Add the meat to the marinade and let sit for 90 minutes.
Remove the meat strips and fry in a hot pan without additional fat for 2–3 minutes, turning occasionally.

name: Szpajza (Silesian layered egg mousse)
summary: A traditional Silesian dessert of whipped eggs and sugar with gelatine, layered in lemon and cocoa flavours.
steps: Soak the gelatine in a small amount of cold water, dissolve in a hot water bath, and cool slightly.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks, and in a second bowl beat the egg yolks with sugar until light and fluffy.
Gently fold the egg white foam into the beaten yolks and stir in the dissolved gelatine.
Divide the mousse into two equal portions: add the lemon juice to the first, and cocoa dissolved in vodka to the second, mixing both thoroughly.
Layer both portions alternately into dessert dishes, smoothing the top with a spoon, and chill in the refrigerator for about 60 minutes to set.

name: Sałatka orientalna (oriental pepper and cucumber salad)
summary: A tangy marinated salad of blanched green bell peppers, fresh cucumber, and onions in an aromatic vinegar marinade with garlic and bay leaf.

ingredients.name: onions
ingredients.note: 1 for the marinade, 2 for the salad

steps: Peel one onion and the garlic clove, and finely chop them.
Pour the water and vinegar into a pot, add the chopped onion, garlic, peppercorns, bay leaf, and salt, and simmer the marinade for about 15 minutes.
Wash and dry the green bell peppers, halve them, remove the seeds, and slice the flesh into thin strips.
Add the pepper strips to the boiling marinade, parboil briefly, remove with a slotted spoon, and let the marinade cool completely.
Peel the cucumber and the remaining two onions, finely chop them, combine with the parboiled peppers, and pour over the cooled marinade.

name: Zupa z cykorii i pora (Chicory and leek soup)
summary: A quick vegetarian soup made with butter-braised leek, chicory, and garlic in a milk and vegetable broth base, served with garlic toasts.
steps: Trim the leek and cut it into slices, cut the core out of the chicory, and cut the leaves into narrow strips.
Finely chop the garlic, cook gently in the melted butter, then add the leek and chicory and fry briefly together.
Pour in the milk and vegetable broth, and season everything with salt, pepper, nutmeg, and caraway.
Cook the soup over low heat for about 5 minutes and serve with garlic toasts.

name: Kalafior w sosie serowym (baked cauliflower in cheese and ham sauce)
summary: Cooked cauliflower baked under a sauce of hard or semi-hard cheese, sour cream, ham, and chives.
steps: Wash the cauliflower and cook in water with salt and lemon juice, then drain.
Bring 500 ml of water with the bouillon cube to a boil in a saucepan, pour in the wheat flour mixed with a little cold water, and bring back to a boil.
Add the grated hard or semi-hard cheese, ham cut into strips, and sour cream to the sauce, stir, and add finely chopped chives.
Arrange the cauliflower in a baking dish, pour over the cheese sauce, and bake in a preheated oven for about 10 minutes.

name: Sernik truskawkowy (no-bake strawberry cheesecake)
summary: A no-bake cheesecake on a sponge biscuit base, with a fluffy farmer's cheese and butter filling and fresh strawberry mousse.

ingredients.name: icing sugar
ingredients.note: most for the cheese filling, a little for the puree

ingredients.name: strawberries
ingredients.note: about 250 ml once blended into puree, plus a few whole strawberries for decoration

ingredients.name: sponge biscuits
ingredients.note: packet, for the base of a springform tin

ingredients.name: gelatine
ingredients.note: 2/3 for the cheese filling, 1/3 for the strawberry mousse

steps: Pour a little cold water over the gelatine to swell, then add a splash of boiling water and heat gently while stirring until completely dissolved.
Beat the softened butter with the icing sugar and egg yolks until fluffy, add the vanilla sugar, and pour in 2/3 of the cooled gelatine.
Mince the farmer's cheese and combine thoroughly with the creamed butter mixture.
Line the base of a springform tin with sponge biscuits, spread the cheese mixture evenly over them, and chill in the refrigerator to set.
Blend the strawberries into a smooth puree (about 250 ml), stir in the remaining 1/3 of the gelatine, and sweeten with a little icing sugar to taste.
Pour the setting strawberry mousse over the cheesecake, decorate with whole strawberries, and chill again in the refrigerator.

name: Italian-style roast veal (Pieczeń cielęca po włosku)
summary: Veal leg roasted with soup vegetables, onion and herbs in beef broth and white wine, served with pickled fruit.
steps: Wash and pat dry the veal leg, then rub it with rosemary, sage, sweet paprika, and salt.
Peel the onion and cut into quarters, and slice the cleaned soup greens.
Heat the oil and sear the meat on all sides, then add the onion and soup greens and fry together briefly.
Pour hot beef broth and white wine into a roasting pan, add the browned meat and vegetables, and roast for 60–70 minutes in an oven preheated to 220 °C, basting frequently with the pan juices.
Let the tender meat cool, cut into thin slices, arrange on a serving platter, and garnish with pickled fruit.

name: Salmon and avocado appetizer
summary: Avocado halves filled with smoked salmon, celery, and scallion salad, topped with a spicy sour cream and mayonnaise dressing and sprinkled with almonds.
steps: Cut the smoked salmon into thin strips or chop it, and finely chop the trimmed celery stalks and scallions.
Wash the avocados, cut them in half, remove the stones, and gently scoop out some of the flesh with a teaspoon.
Drizzle the scooped-out avocado flesh and the avocado shells with lemon juice, then mix the flesh with the salmon, celery, and scallions.
Fill the avocado halves with the prepared salmon salad.
Whisk the sour cream with the mayonnaise and ketchup, season with salt, pepper, and Tabasco sauce, spoon over each portion, and garnish with toasted flaked almonds.

name: Tomatoes stuffed with blue cheese and salami (Pomidory faszerowane salami)
summary: Hollowed tomatoes filled with a flavourful paste of Rokpol blue cheese, salami, vinegar pickles, walnuts and grated horseradish.
steps: Wash the tomatoes, slice off the tops, and scoop out the pulp, leaving a half-centimetre shell around the skin.
Mash the Rokpol blue cheese with a fork, add the chopped tomato pulp, finely shredded salami, finely diced gherkins, and chopped chives.
Mix the ingredients with the chopped walnuts, grated horseradish, yogurt, and mayonnaise, then season to taste with hot paprika and salt.
Fill the hollowed tomatoes with the prepared stuffing and top with the reserved tomato caps.

name: Zupa z czerwonej fasoli (Red bean soup with smoked bacon)
summary: A hearty soup of red beans, smoked bacon, potatoes, leeks, and carrots, finished with sour cream and marjoram.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: boiling for soaking the beans and water to cook the soup

steps: Rinse the red beans, pour boiling water over them, soak for about 3 hours, then drain.
Trim the leeks, slice lengthwise and chop, peel the carrots and cut into sticks, and dice the peeled potatoes.
Place the beans in a pot, add the whole piece of smoked bacon, cover with water, and cook for about 60 minutes.
Add the prepared vegetables and stock cubes, and cook for another 30 minutes.
Remove the cooked bacon, cut it into dice, and return it to the pot.
Stir in the sour cream, season to taste with salt, pepper, and vegetable seasoning, and sprinkle with marjoram.

name: Honey-roasted chicken
summary: Whole roast chicken brushed with a fragrant glaze of honey, melted fat, lemon juice, and nutmeg.
steps: Rinse and pat dry the chicken, cut off the neck and wings, and rub the carcass inside and out with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Melt the margarine in a pan, mix with the honey and nutmeg, and brush the glaze inside the cavity and all over the outside of the chicken.
Place the chicken in a roasting tin, spoon over the remaining glaze, and pour 125 ml of water into the bottom of the tin.
Roast in the oven for about 90 minutes, basting frequently with the pan juices.
Remove the roasted chicken, carve into portions, and spoon over the pan sauce.

name: Ryba w sosie zielonym (poached fish in parsley and sour cream sauce)
summary: Fish portions simmered in vegetable broth and served with a hot sauce of sour cream, white wine and finely chopped parsley.
steps: Place the portioned fish into a pot with the vegetable broth, simmer gently for about 20 minutes, then transfer to a serving platter.
Prepare a light roux in a skillet with the butter and flour, then gradually whisk in the hot fish cooking broth.
Stir the sour cream and dry white wine into the sauce, and season with salt to taste.
Add the finely chopped parsley, simmer the sauce for another moment, and pour over the fish portions on the platter.

name: Tarator (Bulgarian cold cucumber soup)
summary: A refreshing Bulgarian cold soup based on kefir, with fresh cucumber, garlic, dill, and oil.
steps: Peel the cucumber and cut it into fine dice.
Mix the kefir thoroughly with the oil.
Peel the garlic, mince it finely, and mash with a pinch of salt.
Rinse, dry, and finely chop the fresh dill, then combine all ingredients and season the cold soup to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Koreczki greckie (Greek party skewers)
summary: Cold skewers of feta cheese, black olives, tomatoes, and fresh cucumber, dusted with herbs de Provence.
steps: Drain the black olives from the brine, wash the cucumber, and cut it into thick dice.
Wash the tomatoes, deseed them, and cut the flesh into pieces, and cut the feta cheese into neat cubes.
Thread onto toothpicks in order: a cucumber piece, a cube of feta, a tomato piece, and an olive.
Layer the skewers in a dish, dusting each layer with herbs de Provence, ground black pepper, and a pinch of salt, then set aside for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Kotlety mielone w sosie miętowym (minced meat patties with mint sauce)
summary: Small minced meat patties seasoned with fresh mint and mustard, served with a chilled yogurt-mint sauce.
steps: Tear the Kaiser rolls into smaller pieces and pass through a grinder, and rinse and finely chop 10 fresh mint leaves.
Combine the minced meat with the ground bread, chopped mint, mustard, and eggs, season with salt and pepper, and knead into a smooth mixture.
Shape the mixture into small round patties and fry them in 375 ml of very hot oil.
Rinse and finely chop the remaining 20 mint leaves, mix them with the plain yogurt, wine vinegar, and salt, and pour the sauce over the fried patties.

name: Roladki rybne z grzybami (fish rolls with porcini mushrooms)
summary: Baked white sea fish fillets stuffed with porcini filling, wrapped in smoked bacon, and served with hot lemon-caper sauce.
steps: Rinse the fish fillets, pat dry with paper towels, drizzle with lemon juice, dust with fish seasoning, and refrigerate covered.
Pour 250 ml of cold water over the capers and set aside to soak.
Clean and finely chop the porcini, place into a dry hot skillet and cook until liquid evaporates, then add 1 tablespoon of butter and braise until tender.
Remove the mushrooms from the heat, mix with chopped parsley leaves, chives, egg, sour cream, and breadcrumbs, and season with salt and pepper.
Cut the chilled fillets into portions, spread the mushroom filling over each, roll up, wrap each roll in a slice of bacon, and secure with a toothpick.
Dredge the rolls in flour, sear on all sides in hot oil, transfer to a roasting pan, sprinkle with fresh thyme, and bake for 10–15 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C, basting with pan drippings.
Make a blond roux from 2 tablespoons of butter and 2 tablespoons of flour, whisk in the cool vegetable broth, and cook stirring constantly until the sauce thickens.
Stir the juice and zest of half a lemon into the sauce, remove from heat, temper in the egg yolk, add the drained capers, and season with salt, pepper, and a pinch of sugar.

name: Mint yogurt sauce
summary: A refreshing cold sauce of plain yogurt, chopped mint, wine vinegar or olive oil, and cucumber.

ingredients.name: wine vinegar
ingredients.note: alternatively use half this volume of olive oil

steps: Dice the small cucumber, sprinkle with salt, and set aside for about 10 minutes to draw out moisture.
Rinse the fresh mint leaves, chop them finely, and mix with the plain yogurt and wine vinegar.
Squeeze the excess liquid from the cucumber, add it to the sauce, season to taste with salt and pepper, and refrigerate for about 20 minutes.

name: Koktajl z kurczaka (chicken cocktail salad)
summary: An elegant cocktail salad of boiled or roasted chicken breast, pineapple, mandarins, and flaked almonds with a mayonnaise-cognac dressing.
steps: Dice the chicken breast and pineapple slices finely, add the halved canned mandarin segments and the flaked almonds.
Season the ingredients with salt, pepper, and sweet paprika, toss, and set aside in a cool place.
Slowly pour the cognac, ketchup, and lemon juice into the mayonnaise and mix thoroughly into a smooth dressing.
Line glass bowls with lettuce leaves, spoon in portions of the chicken salad, drizzle with the dressing, and garnish with the drained compote fruit and parsley.

name: Pears poached in cider
summary: Pear halves poached in alcoholic apple cider with sugar and almond flavoring.
steps: Peel the pears, halve them, core them, and arrange the fruit in a shallow dish.
Pour the cider over the pears and sprinkle with sugar.
Cook covered or in the microwave for about 10 minutes until the fruit is tender, then transfer onto a serving dish.
Simmer the remaining liquid for about 2 minutes until slightly thickened, stir in the almond flavoring, and pour over the pears.

name: Fish schnitzels (Sznycle z ryby)
summary: Fried patties of minced fish, onion, and milk-soaked bread roll, served with a fried egg on top.
steps: Clean and rinse the fish, remove skin, and fillet the meat.
Soak the bread roll in milk for about 10 minutes, and peel the onions and cut into chunks.
Squeeze out the bread roll and mince in a meat grinder together with the fish and onions, then add 2 eggs, salt, and pepper, and knead the mixture thoroughly.
Shape into small patties, coat in breadcrumbs, fry in hot fat until golden, and place on plates.
Fry sunny-side-up eggs using the remaining 5 eggs and place one on top of each patty.

name: Grilled beef steaks (Steki wołowe z rusztu)
summary: Bone-in beef steaks marinated overnight in oil with garlic, mustard, wine vinegar, and fresh herbs, then grilled.
steps: Peel the garlic and press through a garlic press, and finely chop the fresh thyme, oregano, and basil.
Mix the garlic and fresh herbs with the wine vinegar, oil, mustard, dried marjoram, and pepper.
Coat the beef steaks in the marinade and refrigerate overnight (about 480 minutes).
Remove the steaks from the marinade, drain, grill on both sides on a hot grate, and sprinkle with salt after grilling.

name: Omlet gruszkowy (sweet pear omelette)
summary: A sweet omelette with pears braised in butter and honey, made with eggs, breadcrumbs, and lemon zest.
steps: Peel the pears, cut them in half, core them, and slice into smaller pieces.
Melt the butter in a frying pan or wide saucepan, add the pears and honey, and braise for about 10 minutes.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the breadcrumbs, pour in the water, season with salt and lemon zest, and mix well.
Pour the egg mixture over the braised fruit and fry covered for about 10 minutes.
Flip the omelette over and cook uncovered for another 5 minutes.

name: Sałatka egzotyczna (tropical fruit salad)
summary: A chilled fruit salad of oranges, melon, avocado, bananas, kiwi, mango, pineapple, and plump raisins, drizzled with fruit and lemon juice.
steps: Soak the raisins in warm water until plump, then drain thoroughly.
Peel the oranges, remove any seeds and white pith, and dice the flesh.
Peel the melon, avocado, bananas, kiwi, and mango and cut into dice or slices, and chop the pineapple slices into smaller pieces.
Transfer all the fruit and drained raisins to a glass bowl, drizzle with fruit juice and the freshly squeezed lemon juice, and toss gently.
Refrigerate the salad for 2–3 hours before serving.

name: Brzoskwinie w winnym sosie (peaches in white wine sabayon)
summary: A dessert of fresh peaches topped with a fluffy sauce of egg yolks whisked over steam with white wine and sugar.
steps: Wash the ripe peaches, cut them in half, discard the stones, and arrange the halves in dessert bowls.
Pour the white wine into a saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil.
Whisk the egg yolks with sugar until pale, then slowly pour in the hot wine, whisking constantly over a steam bath until the sauce thickens.
Pour the hot wine sauce over the peaches and set aside to cool.

name: Sałatka po chińsku (Chinese pickled cabbage salad)
summary: A crunchy Chinese-style slaw of white cabbage and hot red chilli marinated with ginger, wine vinegar, and sesame oil, topped with peanuts and almonds.
steps: Rinse and dry the white cabbage, cut it into pieces about 6 cm long, transfer to a pot, sprinkle with the salt and brown sugar, and let stand for 120 minutes.
Halve the hot chilli, remove the seeds, and slice into thin strips; peel and finely chop the ginger.
Blanch the almonds in boiling water and slip off their skins.
Gently squeeze the excess liquid from the cabbage, combine with the sesame oil, wine vinegar, ginger, and chilli, and chill for another 120 minutes.
Before serving, scatter the peanuts and blanched almonds over the salad.

name: Cold green bean salad with tomato and olives
summary: A salad of cooked green beans with sautéed onion, tomato, black olives, and a lemon-garlic dressing.
steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for about 15 minutes, drain, and allow to cool.
Peel and chop the onion, fry it in some of the olive oil, and place it over the beans.
Wash the tomato, cut into quarters, briefly sauté in the pan, arrange over the beans, and scatter with the black olives.
Peel the garlic, crush with salt and sugar, then mix with the juice squeezed from half a lemon, the remaining olive oil, rosemary, and oregano.
Drizzle the dressing over the beans and garnish with chopped parsley leaves.

name: Mazurek pomarańczowy (Polish Easter orange flat cake)
summary: Shortcrust Polish Easter mazurek topped with fresh orange segments, raisins, and almonds set in orange jelly.

ingredients.name: sour cream 18%
ingredients.note: optional, if the dough is too dry

steps: Sift the krupczatka flour onto a pastry board, add the margarine and powdered sugar, and chop together with a knife.
Add two egg yolks (and sour cream if the mixture is too dry) and quickly knead into a dough, then wrap and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Roll out the chilled dough to a thickness of about 7 mm, transfer to a baking sheet, shape a decorative rim around the edges using dough ropes, and brush it with the remaining beaten egg yolk.
Bake the crust in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 25 minutes until golden, then set aside to cool completely.
Prepare the orange jelly according to the package instructions and set aside until it begins to set.
Scald the orange, peel off the skin and white pith, remove the seeds, and divide into segments.
Rinse and scald the raisins, then skin and chop the almonds.
Arrange the orange segments on the cooled crust, sprinkle with raisins and almonds, pour over the setting jelly, and leave until completely set before slicing.

name: Śmieciuch (Polish one-bowl cocoa and plum jam cake)
summary: A quick cocoa and plum jam cake made by mixing all ingredients together in a single bowl.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, grease a baking pan, and dust it with breadcrumbs.
Place the flour, sugar, vegetable oil, milk, eggs, baking soda, baking powder, cocoa powder, and plum jam into a bowl and mix into a smooth batter.
Pour the batter onto the prepared pan and bake at 180 °C for about 45 minutes, until the cake cracks on top and a toothpick inserted into the centre comes out clean.

name: Kapuśniak (Polish sauerkraut soup)
summary: Traditional Polish sauerkraut soup with smoked bacon and potatoes.
steps: Rinse the sauerkraut in a colander under running water, drain well, and chop finely.
Dice the smoked bacon, peel and finely chop the onion, and peel, rinse, and dice the potatoes.
Fry the bacon in a large skillet, add the onion, and cook until golden brown.
Add the chopped sauerkraut, fry for 3–4 minutes, then pour in a little water, cover, and braise over low heat for 10 minutes.
Bring water to a boil in a pot, add the potatoes, and cook for 10 minutes, then add the braised sauerkraut with bacon and onion.
Dissolve the crumbled bouillon cubes in a small amount of water and pour into the soup.
Add the bay leaves and garlic mashed with salt, season with pepper, cover, and simmer for another 15 minutes.

name: Makaron z mortadelą (pasta with fried mortadella and breadcrumbs)
summary: Simple pasta pan-fried in butter with strips of mortadella and crispy breadcrumbs.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Cut the mortadella into thin strips and sauté in melted butter.
Add the cooked pasta and breadcrumbs to the pan and fry everything together for a moment, stirring.
Season the dish to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Pasta with parsley and toasted seeds
summary: Farfalle pasta tossed with chopped fresh parsley leaves, garlic, olive oil, and toasted sunflower or pumpkin seeds.
steps: Cook the farfalle pasta al dente and drain.
Toast the sunflower seeds in a dry frying pan.
Finely chop the parsley leaves along with the peeled garlic cloves and mix with the olive oil.
Combine the hot pasta with the parsley-garlic mixture and sprinkle with the toasted sunflower seeds.

name: Makaron z oscypkiem (spaghetti with smoked oscypek cheese and black pepper)
summary: Quick spaghetti tossed with grated smoked oscypek cheese and plenty of freshly ground black pepper.
steps: Cook the spaghetti pasta al dente, reserve 4 tablespoons of the pasta cooking water, and drain the rest.
Toss the hot spaghetti with the grated oscypek cheese, ground pepper, and reserved pasta cooking water.

name: Bruschetta z łososiem (grilled salmon and vegetable bruschetta)
summary: Crisp grilled panini buns served warm topped with grilled marinated salmon strips, aubergine, courgette, peppers, and dark balsamic glaze.
steps: Slice the salmon into thin strips, the aubergine and courgette into thin rounds, the seeded bell peppers into wide strips, and halve the onions.
Drizzle the salmon and vegetables with lemon juice and some of the olive oil, sprinkle with dried oregano, and set aside for 60 minutes.
Drain the fish and vegetables, then grill for 5 minutes, turning and basting with the marinade oil.
Remove from the grill, season with salt and black pepper, add chopped sun-dried tomatoes in olive oil, and drizzle with the dark balsamic glaze and remaining olive oil.
Cut the panini rolls in half, toast them quickly on the grill, pile the vegetables and salmon on top, garnish with basil leaves, and serve warm.

name: Gourmet mixed meat skewers (Szaszłyki smakosza)
summary: Grilled skewers of pork neck, pork loin, poultry, and smoked kiełbasa layered with colourful bell peppers and onion.
steps: Chop the garlic and mix with the olive oil, soy sauce, mustard, marjoram, and pepper.
Cut the pork neck, pork loin, and poultry into large cubes, add to the marinade, and chill in the refrigerator for at least 120 minutes.
Cut the smoked kiełbasa into thick rounds, bell peppers into squares matching the meat, and onions into slices.
Thread onto skewers alternately bell pepper, onion, the different meats, and slices of kiełbasa.
Grill the skewers for 10–15 minutes on a well-heated grill, then wrap them in aluminium foil and leave them at the edge of the grill for another 10 minutes.

name: Traditional Wodzionka (Silesian bread and garlic soup)
summary: An instant traditional Silesian bread soup prepared directly in a soup plate with diced stale bread, chopped garlic, fat, and seasonings scalded with boiling water.

ingredients.name: boiling water
ingredients.note: for pouring over the ingredients in the soup plate

steps: Dice the stale bread and finely chop the peeled garlic.
Place the bread, garlic, fat, and seasonings in a deep soup plate.
Pour the boiling water over everything and stir.

name: Sałatka letnia (summer feta and sweetcorn salad)
summary: A colourful salad of feta cheese, sweetcorn, vinegar pickles, red bell pepper and apples mixed with mayonnaise, garnished with tomatoes and fresh herbs.
steps: Wash the tomatoes and cut them into slices.
Peel and core the apples, then dice the apples, vinegar pickles, red bell pepper and feta cheese.
Add the drained sweetcorn, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper, and gently toss all the ingredients together.
Garnish the top of the salad with tomato slices and fresh herbs.

name: Gazpacho
summary: Traditional Spanish chilled tomato soup blended with sweet peppers, cucumber, garlic, olive oil, and bread.
steps: Cut the crust off the slice of white bread, keeping only the soft crumb.
Wash and roughly chop the tomatoes, red and green bell peppers, and peeled cucumber.
Peel and roughly chop the onion and garlic cloves.
Blend all the vegetables with the bread crumb, olive oil, wine vinegar, mineral water, salt, and ground cumin until completely smooth.
Chill the soup in the refrigerator before serving.

name: Makaron z papryką (pasta with bell pepper and sour cream sauce)
summary: Pasta served with a fresh bell pepper, thick sour cream, and herb sauce, topped with grated cheese.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Wash the bell peppers, remove the seed cores, finely dice the flesh, and mix it with the sour cream and salad dressing.
Season the sauce with salt, pepper, and dried basil.
Pour the prepared bell pepper sauce over the hot pasta and sprinkle with grated cheese.

name: Rainbow no-bake cheesecake (Sernik tęczowy)
summary: A vibrant no-bake cold cheesecake made with homogenised curd cheese and four colorful fruit jelly layers.
steps: Pour 100 ml of cold water over the gelatine, and once it has swelled, heat gently until completely dissolved, then set aside to cool.
Dissolve each of the four fruit jellies separately in half the amount of boiling water indicated on the packet, then let cool.
Beat the softened butter with the icing sugar and egg yolks, blend in the homogenised curd cheese until smooth, and divide the mixture into five equal portions.
Mix the first portion of the cheese mixture with the dissolved gelatine, and stir one cooled fruit jelly into each of the remaining four portions.
Pour the first white layer into the base of a springform tin and refrigerate until set, then pour each successive colourful layer on top after the previous one has fully set.

name: Knedle ze śliwkami (plum dumplings)
summary: Classic Polish potato dough dumplings stuffed with whole plums and served with breadcrumbs browned in butter.
steps: Peel the potatoes, boil until tender, pass through a meat grinder, and cool completely.
Turn the cold potatoes out onto a pastry board, add the plain flour, eggs, and salt, and knead into a uniform dough.
Roll the dough into a log about 4 cm in diameter and cut it into rounds 2 cm thick.
Flatten each round in your hand, place a pitted plum in the centre, pinch the edges together firmly, and shape into a ball.
Drop the knedle into salted boiling water and cook for about 10 minutes after they float to the surface.
Drain the cooked knedle and serve with breadcrumbs fried in butter.

name: Baked ham with raisins (Szynka pieczona z rodzynkami)
summary: Cooked ham baked in dry white wine, brandy, and butter with sweet raisins.
steps: Place the cooked ham in a baking dish, pour over the water and white wine, spread the ham with butter, and sprinkle the raisins over it.
Drizzle the meat with brandy and bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 40 minutes.
Remove the meat from the oven, slice, and serve warm or chilled together with the raisins.

name: Savory quark tart (Wytrawny serowiec)
summary: A savory cheese tart on a shortcrust base with a filling of farmer's cheese, garlic, chives, and cherry tomatoes, baked under slices of goat cheese.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: 1 for the dough, 5 for the cheese filling

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: half a teaspoon for the dough, and to taste for the filling

steps: Knead the flour with 1 egg, butter, and half a teaspoon of salt, form the dough into a ball, wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Wash the cherry tomatoes, rinse, dry, and chop the chives, reserving 1 tablespoon for garnishing before serving.
Blend the farmer's cheese with the remaining 5 eggs, garlic, salt, and pepper, then stir the chopped chives and cherry tomatoes into the mixture.
Line a greased springform pan with the chilled pastry, spread the farmer's cheese mixture over it, and arrange sliced goat cheese on top.
Bake for 50–60 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C, and sprinkle with the reserved chives before serving.

name: Makaron z pomidorowym sosem (pasta with tomato and sour cream sauce)
summary: Pasta in a simple sauce made of canned tomatoes, onion, garlic, and thick sour cream, topped with sharp grated cheese.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente and drain.
Peel and chop the onion, then fry it in heated vegetable oil.
Add the canned tomatoes to the onion and fry together for a few minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and mashed garlic clove, then season the sauce with salt and pepper.
Toss the sauce with the warm pasta and sprinkle with the sharp cheese.

name: Chocolate mousse (mus czekoladowy)
summary: Fluffy dessert made from dark bittersweet chocolate, egg yolks, whipped egg whites, and whipped cream, garnished with nuts or almonds.
steps: Separate the egg yolks from the whites and beat the yolks with half of the sugar until pale.
Break the chocolate into small pieces, melt in a water bath while stirring constantly, then remove from the heat and combine with the beaten egg yolks.
Whisk the egg whites over steam until stiff peaks form, adding the remaining sugar near the end of whipping.
Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the chocolate mixture, then fold everything into the whipped cream.
Spoon the mousse into dessert cups, garnish with chopped almonds, and chill in the refrigerator for 60 minutes.

name: Morelowy przysmak (apricot two-layer cake with almonds)
summary: A two-layer cake with a shortcrust base, a creamed cake batter layer, fresh apricots, an apricot jam glaze, and flaked almonds.
steps: Quickly knead a shortcrust pastry from 150 g of wheat flour, 100 g of butter, one egg, and salt, wrap in plastic wrap, and chill in the refrigerator.
Wash the apricots, cut in half, and remove the pits.
Beat 125 g of butter with the sugar, vanilla sugar, and two eggs until fluffy, then gradually add 200 g of wheat flour mixed with the baking powder, beating continuously.
Grease the bottom and sides of a 26 cm springform pan with margarine, line the base with the rolled-out shortcrust pastry, and spread the batter on top.
Smooth the top with a knife, arrange the apricot halves while pressing them gently into the batter, and bake for about 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C, then transfer to a platter and cool.
Warm the apricot jam in a saucepan over low heat, stirring until liquefied, brush it over the top of the cake, and sprinkle with almond flakes.

name: Jarzynowa zupa krem (creamy Polish vegetable soup with dill)
summary: Light creamy vegetable soup with carrots, parsley root, celeriac, leek, broccoli, and potatoes, finished with sour cream and dill.

ingredients.name: soup seasoning or a bouillon cube

steps: Wash, peel, and roughly chop the carrots, parsley root, celeriac, leek, onion, tomato, broccoli, and potatoes.
Place the vegetables in a pot, pour over boiling water, add the soup seasoning, and cook covered until tender.
Allow the soup to cool slightly, blend until smooth, and stir in sour cream (22% fat) tempered with a few spoonfuls of hot broth.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, and serve sprinkled with chopped dill.

name: Makaron z szynką i serowym sosem (baked pasta with ham and Emmental cheese sauce)
summary: Baked pasta tubes with strips of ham, an Emmental and cream sauce, and fresh dill.
steps: Cook the pasta tubes al dente and drain, then preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the ham into narrow strips, toss with the cooked pasta, and season with salt and grated nutmeg.
Transfer the pasta and ham mixture to a buttered ovenproof dish.
Grate the Emmental cheese, mix half of it with the light cream and a pinch of salt, and pour the sauce over the pasta.
Sprinkle the top with the remaining Emmental cheese and bake for 20 minutes at 200 °C, then scatter with chopped dill before serving.

name: Vegetarian vegetable stew
summary: A vegetable stew with bell peppers, eggplant, zucchini, black olives, and basil.
steps: Wash the vegetables, halve the eggplant lengthwise, sprinkle with salt and set aside for several minutes, then cut into pieces.
Deseed the yellow and red bell peppers and cut into pieces, slice the peeled onion into rings, and slice the zucchini into rounds.
Heat the olive oil in a pan, cook the onion until translucent, add the peppers, eggplant, zucchini, and chopped garlic, season with salt, and fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and cook gently, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the black olives and basil, simmer for a few moments longer, and season to taste with salt and black pepper.

name: Utopence (Czech pickled sausages)
summary: A traditional Czech cold pub snack of sausages pickled in a tangy sweet and sour vinegar brine with onions, peppers, garlic, and spices.
steps: Bring the water, vinegar, sugar, salt, peppercorns, allspice, pinch of chili, lovage, and bay leaves to the boil, then set the brine aside to cool completely to room temperature.
Peel the casings off the sausages (you can dip them in boiling water for 30 seconds beforehand and cool them), then slice them lengthwise into halves or quarters.
Slice the red and white onions into thin rounds, cut the sweet peppers and chili peppers into strips or rings, and mix the vegetables with the finely chopped garlic.
Pack the vegetables and sliced sausages tightly in alternating layers into a large jar, pour over the cooled brine, and top with the dill sprigs and bay leaves from the marinade.
Seal the jar tightly and leave in a cool place at 15–18 °C for 1–2 weeks (or for a minimum of 3 days).

name: Zupa zakonna (monastic bean and vegetable soup)
summary: A meatless bean and vegetable soup with carrots, celeriac, and onion, flavoured with tomato purée, hot paprika, and marjoram, best served reheated the next day.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: cold, for soaking and boiling the beans

steps: Cover the beans with cold water and soak overnight.
Cook the beans in the soaking water, topping up with more liquid as needed.
Trim, rinse, and chop the carrots, celeriac, and onion, then add them to the simmering beans.
Towards the end of cooking, season the soup with the tomato purée, salt, black pepper, hot paprika, and marjoram, and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the soup cool, refrigerate overnight, and serve reheated the following day.

name: Nectarine and chocolate cornflake parfait
summary: A layered dessert in bowls made with crisp dark-chocolate cornflakes, sweet quark cream, and fresh sliced nectarines.
steps: Melt the dark chocolate in a small saucepan, add the vegetable oil and cornflakes, stir gently to coat, and divide among the bottom of dessert bowls.
Mix the smooth quark with the orange juice and sugar, then spoon the mixture into the dessert bowls as the second layer.
Wash the nectarines, cut them into thin slices, and arrange them neatly on top of the dessert.

name: Sweet baked chicken with fruit
summary: Chicken portions baked with apples, canned peaches, orange segments, and wine-plumped raisins.
steps: Pour the wine over the raisins and leave to soak for about 60 minutes.
Cut the chicken into portions, rub with vegetable seasoning, and set aside for 30 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish, drizzle with olive oil, and bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for 45 minutes.
Arrange the sliced apples, peaches, and orange segments around the meat, scatter over the raisins, and pour over the soaking wine mixed with syrup from the peach can.
Bake everything for another 30 minutes.

name: Kąski drobiowe (marinated chicken and banana bites)
summary: Chicken breast and banana bites marinated in soy sauce, honey, and sesame, seared and baked.
steps: Cut the chicken fillet into large cubes and slice the peeled banana.
Mix oil with soy sauce, lemon juice, ginger, honey, and sesame seeds, then season the marinade with salt, pepper, and ground hot paprika.
Place the chicken and banana into the marinade, cover the dish, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Remove the ingredients from the marinade, brown on all sides in a hot oiled skillet, then transfer to a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes, basting frequently with leftover marinade.

name: Lángos (Hungarian fried flatbreads)
summary: Hungarian yeast-potato fried flatbreads deep-fried until golden.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.note: boiled and pressed through a potato ricer

steps: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in a small amount of warm milk and set aside in a warm place for 10–15 minutes for the starter to rise.
Place the flour into a bowl, pour in the yeast starter, and add the riced potatoes along with 3 teaspoons of oil.
Knead into a uniform dough, gradually adding the rest of the 200 ml of warm milk and the salt.
Cover the dough and set aside for about 60 minutes to rise, then knead it once more.
Tear off pieces of dough, shape into thin flatbreads with your fingers, and deep-fry in hot oil on both sides until golden.

name: Hungarian beef goulash with wine
summary: Hungarian beef goulash braised with onions, bell peppers, potatoes, caraway, and dry wine.
steps: Cut the beef into small, uniform pieces and brown in a pot in heated lard or oil.
