Add the chopped onion, bay leaf, and caraway, then braise over low heat, adding splashes of water from time to time.
Toward the end of braising, season with salt, add the chopped fresh bell peppers, ground paprika, tomato paste, wine, and peeled diced potatoes.
Cook everything covered until the meat and potatoes are tender.

name: Baked eggplants (Zapiekane bakłażany)
summary: An Italian casserole of roasted eggplant slices layered with fresh tomatoes, basil, mozzarella, and grated Parmesan.
steps: Cut each eggplant lengthwise into 6 slices and peel the skin from the outer slices.
Salt the eggplant slices, let rest for 30 minutes, then rinse and pat dry.
Brush the eggplants with olive oil on both sides, arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet, and bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C for 8 minutes per side.
Scald the tomatoes, peel the skin, quarter them, remove the seeds, coarsely chop the flesh, and mix with chopped basil, salt, and pepper.
Place the 4 largest eggplant slices on the baking sheet and layer each with tomatoes, thin slices of mozzarella, Parmesan, and more eggplant slices, finishing with Parmesan on top.
Bake for 10–15 minutes in a hot oven until the mozzarella melts and browns.

name: Pears poached in Barolo (Pere al Barolo)
summary: An Italian dessert of pears poached in Barolo red wine with warming spices.
steps: Peel the pears leaving their stems intact, and arrange them upright in a deep pot.
Add the cloves, bay leaves, cinnamon stick, and lemon peel, sprinkle the pears with sugar, and pour in the Barolo wine.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 50 minutes.
Check the tenderness of the pears with a fork and carefully remove them from the pot by their stems.
Simmer the remaining wine in the pot until it reduces to a syrup, drizzle over the cooled pears, and garnish with mint or lemon balm leaves.

name: Ravioli verdi (green herb ravioli)
summary: Homemade green herb ravioli stuffed with ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan, served with tomato sauce and saffron cream sauce.
steps: Cook the chopped onion and 3 cloves of garlic in olive oil with butter until translucent, let cool, then mix with the ricotta, shredded mozzarella, Parmesan, 10 chopped basil leaves, and pepper.
Blend the parsley leaves and basil bunch with the whole eggs and egg yolks, knead with the flour into a smooth dough, and roll out thinly.

Cut the dough into strips, place portions of cheese filling along one half, brush the edges with egg white, fold the other half of the dough over, press down, and cut with a knife into square ravioli.
Cook the ravioli in salted boiling water until they float to the surface and drain.
Prepare the red sauce: sauté the chopped garlic and cut tomatoes in olive oil, add the chopped basil, and season with salt and pepper.

Prepare the yellow sauce: steep the saffron in hot white wine with butter, reduce the 30% whipping cream in a skillet, pour in the saffron wine, cook until thickened, season with salt, and serve both sauces with the ravioli.

name: Melon and peach preserve with mint
summary: A homemade preserve of puréed honeydew melon and peaches with fresh mint.
steps: Cut the mint leaves into thin strips.
Peel the half honeydew melon, scoop out the seeds, and cut the flesh into small dice.
Prick the peaches with a fork, scald for a minute, cool, peel off the skin, remove the stones, and dice the flesh.
Blend the fruit until smooth, transfer to a pot, stir in the gelling sugar, and boil for 4 minutes while stirring constantly and skimming off any foam.
Stir the chopped mint into the hot preserve, spoon into jars, seal tightly, and turn upside down.

name: Braised veal with spring vegetables
summary: Tender chunks of veal braised with green beans, fresh green peas, white asparagus, tomatoes, and garlic.
steps: Rinse the veal, trim any sinew and cut into pieces, then brown in 2 tablespoons of oil, transfer to a saucepan, cover, and braise with a splash of water.
Wash the green beans and cut into smaller pieces, and rinse and drain the fresh green peas.
Rinse the white asparagus, snap off the woody ends, and briefly parboil in water.
Wash the tomatoes, dice them, and saute in the remaining oil.
Add the green beans, peas, asparagus along with its cooking liquid, and tomatoes to the braising meat, simmer until tender, and season with crushed garlic, salt, and pepper.

name: Carrot and honey salad (Surówka marchwiowa z miodem)
summary: A sweet and spicy raw salad of finely grated carrots, parboiled raisins, honey, and hot ground paprika.
steps: Peel the carrots, grate on a very fine grater, and mix with the hot paprika.
Parboil the raisins for 2 minutes in 250 ml of water and drain.
Combine the grated carrot with the raisins, drizzle with honey, and mix thoroughly.
Squeeze excess liquid from the salad and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Eggplant casserole (Zapiekanka z bakłażanów)
summary: A vegetable dish of golden-fried eggplant half-slices braised with zucchini, tomatoes, onion, and herbs de Provence, served warm or cold.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for salting the eggplants and seasoning

steps: Wash and pat dry the eggplants, cut into half-slices about 1 cm thick, salt, and let stand for about 30 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Peel the tomatoes, zucchini, and onions and cut them into large dice.
Heat the oil in a pan, add the eggplants, and brown on both sides.
Add the chopped tomatoes, onion, and zucchini, cover, and cook gently until the vegetables are tender.
Towards the end of braising, season the dish with herbs de Provence, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and serve warm or cold.

name: Baked spinach gratin (Szpinak zapiekany)
summary: Fresh spinach leaves braised with onion and garlic, baked with lean cured pork loin under an egg and milk mixture.
steps: Sort and rinse the spinach, blanch for 1 minute in salted boiling water, rinse with cold water, drain, and chop.
Peel and chop the onion and garlic, cook them gently in the margarine with the pan covered, then add the spinach and cook for about 2 minutes to evaporate excess moisture.
Chop the lean cured pork loin and mix with the spinach.
Whisk the eggs with milk and soup seasoning, and season with nutmeg and white pepper.
Grease a baking dish with olive oil, add the spinach, pour over the egg-milk mixture, and bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C for 10 minutes.

name: Zupa ziemniaczana z kurkami (potato soup with chanterelles)
summary: A creamy blended potato and vegetable soup with smoked bacon, served with sautéed chanterelles and button mushrooms and a hint of nutmeg.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for frying the onion and mushrooms

steps: Peel and chop the onion, fry in part of the oil, then add the diced smoked bacon and fry together.
Peel and chop the potatoes and soup vegetables, pour over 2 litres of boiling water, add the fried onion and bacon, cook for 15 minutes, then blend into a smooth soup.
Clean the chanterelles and button mushrooms, wash, dry thoroughly, and sauté in the remaining oil, seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Combine the sautéed mushrooms with the blended soup and season to taste with nutmeg, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the soup in ramekins, garnished with chopped parsley.

name: Baked snails in garlic butter
summary: A quick appetizer of canned snails baked in shells with butter creamed with fresh garlic.
steps: Remove the snails from their shells, drain them, and place them back into the shells.
Crush the peeled garlic cloves, blend thoroughly with the softened butter, and fill the snail shells with the garlic butter.
Place the prepared shells in a preheated oven (about 180 °C) and bake for 5–7 minutes.

name: Bigos z papryki (Polish bell pepper and sausage stew)
summary: A hearty one-pot Polish stew made with red bell peppers, pearl beans, and browned Polish sausage in a creamy tomato sauce.
steps: Sort and rinse the pearl beans, cover with cold water, bring to a boil, and let stand for 120 minutes, then drain, add fresh water, and simmer until tender.
Wash the red bell peppers, remove the seeds, dice the flesh, and braise in 1 tablespoon of oil.
Slice the kiełbasa into half-moons and fry in a skillet until browned.
Peel and finely chop the onions, dust with wheat flour, and lightly brown in the remaining oil and rendered sausage fat.
Combine the onions with the braised peppers, cooked beans, kiełbasa, tomato purée, and sour cream.
Simmer everything together briefly and season to taste with salt, pepper, hot paprika powder, and marjoram.

name: Grilled zander (Sandacz z rusztu)
summary: Skin-on zander fillets brushed with butter and grilled until golden, served with parsley.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: some melted for brushing, the rest for serving

steps: Clean and rinse the zander, fillet with the skin on, and cut into portions.
Dust the fish portions with salt and set aside in a cool place for 60 minutes.
Pat the fish dry with paper towels and brush with a portion of the melted butter.
Brush the preheated grill grate with vegetable oil, arrange the zander portions, and grill for about 5 minutes on each side until the skin is crisp and golden and the flesh is succulent.
Transfer the grilled fish to a serving platter, scatter chopped parsley leaves on top, and arrange pats of the remaining butter alongside.

name: Mięso z owocami (braised chicken with fruit)
summary: Diced chicken braised in butter with fruit, seasoned with salt and sugar.
steps: Clean, wash, and cut the fruit into pieces.
Melt the butter in a frying pan, add the cut fruit, and braise for about 15 minutes.
Cut the chicken meat into large cubes, add to the fruit in the pan, and braise together for a few more minutes until the meat is tender.
Season the dish to taste with salt and sugar.

name: Spicy pasta bake (Zapiekanka pikantna)
summary: A hearty, spicy pasta casserole with minced meat, button mushrooms, fresh tomatoes, tomato purée, and chili, baked under a layer of firm cheese.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for frying and greasing the dish

steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, rinse with cold water, and drain.
Fry the minced meat with chopped onion and seasonings (allspice, bay leaf, hot paprika, chili, salt, and pepper).
Clean the button mushrooms and fry them in oil, adding the peeled and diced tomatoes towards the end of frying.
Combine the mushrooms and tomatoes with the browned meat and stir in the tomato purée.
Grease an ovenproof baking dish, arrange alternating layers of pasta and meat filling, and sprinkle the top with grated firm cheese.
Bake for about 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Carrot and mushroom gratin (Zapiekanka z marchwi)
summary: A vegetarian gratin of butter-caramelized carrot batons and button mushrooms, baked with white wine, sour cream, and firm cheese.
steps: Peel and wash the carrots, cut into thick batons, then sauté in butter with sugar for about 3 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Pour the white wine into a saucepan, simmer over low heat for 6 minutes, and stir in half of the sour cream.
Peel the button mushrooms, slice them, and sauté in butter.

Arrange the carrots and mushrooms in a baking dish, pour the wine sauce over them, sprinkle with chopped parsley and finely diced firm cheese, then pour over the remaining sour cream and bake briefly.

name: Sałatka z ananasem i orzechami (chicken, pineapple, and walnut salad)
summary: A hearty salad of boiled chicken breast, hard-boiled eggs, pickled celeriac, sweet pineapple, sweetcorn, and walnuts in a creamy mayonnaise dressing.
steps: Soak the walnuts briefly, drain well, and roughly chop them.
Boil the chicken breast fillet until tender, let cool, dice, and transfer to a bowl with the walnuts.
Drain the canned pineapple, pickled celeriac, and sweetcorn, chop the pineapple into chunks, and add to the bowl.
Hard-boil the eggs, let them cool, peel, and chop into pieces.
Combine all ingredients with the mayonnaise, season with salt and pepper, and toss gently.

name: Kawa elegantissimo (iced dark chocolate espresso with whipped cream)
summary: Chilled espresso with dark chocolate, served over crushed ice with whipped cream.
steps: Brew two servings of strong espresso from the ground coffee.
Dissolve the sugar and most of the chopped dark chocolate in the hot coffee, grating the rest into chocolate shavings.
Place the coffee drink in the refrigerator for at least 180 minutes.
Fill glasses with crushed ice, pour in the chilled coffee, and garnish with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

name: Smoked mackerel salad (Sałatka z wędzonej makreli)
summary: A traditional salad of smoked mackerel, boiled potatoes, hard-boiled eggs, fermented pickles, and onion with mayonnaise.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their jackets until tender, then let cool, peel, and dice.
Hard-boil the eggs, let cool, peel, and dice.
Dice the fermented pickles and finely chop the onion.
Remove the skin and bones from the smoked mackerel and flake the flesh into bite-sized pieces.
Gently toss all the ingredients with mayonnaise, season to taste with black pepper, and sprinkle with chopped chives before serving.

name: Rosół rybno-grzybowy po mazursku (Masurian fish and mushroom broth)
summary: Clear Masurian freshwater fish broth made from pikeperch or pike, combined with root vegetable stock and dried porcini broth.

ingredients.name: Polish soup vegetables (carrot, parsley root, celeriac and leek)

steps: Soak the dried porcini in water, then simmer in a separate pot until tender.
Make 2 litres of stock from the Polish soup vegetables, bay leaf, allspice berries, and salt, add the cleaned pikeperch or pike, and simmer gently until the fish is tender.
Combine the strained fish stock with the mushroom broth.
Clarify the hot broth with egg white, strain through a sieve, and serve.

name: Avocado Stuffed with Beef Tartare
summary: An elegant starter of avocado halves filled with beef tartare, capers, minced onions, and seasoned mayonnaise dressing.
steps: Season the mayonnaise with salt and pepper, set aside 1 tablespoon for the meat, and blend the rest with ketchup and 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley leaves and chives.
Mix the steak tartare meat with the finely chopped onion, the reserved tablespoon of mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon of herbs, and 1 tablespoon of capers.
Cut the avocados in half lengthwise, remove the pits, rub the flesh with lemon juice, and fill the hollows with the prepared beef tartare.
Line a platter with lettuce leaves, arrange the stuffed avocado halves on top, garnish with the remaining capers and herbs, and place the sauce in the centre.

name: Neapolitan pizza (Pizza Napoletana)
summary: Classic Italian pizza topped with sieved tomato sauce, mozzarella, anchovy fillets and dried oregano.
steps: Preheat the oven to 250 °C at least 20 minutes before baking.
Pass the peeled tomatoes through a sieve into a bowl.
Roll out the pizza dough into a round base, spread with the sieved tomatoes leaving a border around the edge, and arrange the mozzarella and anchovy strips on top.
Sprinkle the pizza with dried oregano, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with olive oil, and bake for 15–20 minutes until the edges are browned and the cheese has melted.

name: Sweet and spicy turkey stew with pineapple
summary: Turkey thigh stew simmered with bell pepper, carrots, and canned pineapple in a sweet and spicy sauce.
steps: Dice the turkey meat and brown in a saucepan in heated olive oil.
Add the diced red onion and fry, stirring constantly, until golden.
Pour in the hot broth and rice vinegar, add the ground ginger, hot paprika, cinnamon, and salt, then braise covered.
Peel the carrots and cut into thin matchsticks, cut the bell pepper into strips, and cut the pineapple rings into pieces.
When the meat is almost tender, add the carrots, bell pepper, and pineapple, and braise everything until tender.

name: Bajgus torte (Tort Bajgus)
summary: A chocolate sponge cake layered with whipped cream and apples simmered in apple juice.
steps: Separate the egg whites from the yolks, beat the whites until stiff while slowly adding the sugar, and add the yolks towards the end.
Combine the cake flour with the potato starch and cocoa powder, then gently fold into the egg mixture.
Pour the batter into a greased springform cake tin 20–22 cm in diameter, bake at 180 °C for about 30 minutes, and once cooled, slice the sponge horizontally into two layers.
Peel the apples, cut them into pieces, simmer in the apple juice for a few minutes, and drain thoroughly.
Whip 300 g of whipping cream with the vanilla sugar, pour in the gelatine dissolved in a minimal amount of water, and fold the cream into the drained apples.
Layer the sponge discs with the apple cream, and spread the remaining 200 g of whipped cream over the top and sides of the torte.

name: Placek królewski (Polish royal layered honey and sponge cake)
summary: A three-layer Polish cake made of two honey-shortcrust layers and a fluffy sponge cake sandwiched with hot custard-buttercream.
steps: Quickly knead the shortcrust pastry from wheat flour, margarine, sour cream, sugar, honey, and baking soda, divide it into 2 equal parts, and bake two separate layers on a rectangular baking sheet at 180 °C for about 15–20 minutes.
For the sponge cake, whip the egg whites until soft peaks form, gradually add the sugar and whip until stiff peaks form, then gently fold in the egg yolks, both flours, and baking powder.
Pour the sponge batter into a baking pan of the same size and bake at 180 °C for about 25 minutes, then let all cake layers cool.
For the custard, set aside about 125 ml of milk and mix the wheat flour and potato starch into it, then bring the remaining milk to a boil with margarine, sugar and vanilla-flavoured sugar.
Slowly pour the starch slurry into the boiling milk, whisking vigorously until the custard thickens.
Assemble the cooled cake layers with the hot custard cream in order: shortcrust layer, half the cream, sponge layer, remaining cream, and the second shortcrust layer.

name: Krokodyle łzy (Ginger and lemon nalewka)
summary: Warming Polish vodka tincture infused with fresh ginger, lemons, honey, and sugar.
steps: Wash and dry the ginger, then cut it into thin slices. Scald the lemons with boiling water and slice into eighths.
Transfer the ginger and lemons to a large jar, cover with the sugar, add the honey, and pour in the vodka.
Seal the jar tightly, shake well, and leave for about 2 months, shaking the jar every few days.
After 2 months, strain the liqueur, decant into bottles, seal tightly, and age for another 30 days before serving.

name: Zawijaniec (pork tenderloin roulade with prunes)
summary: A roasted pork tenderloin roulade marinated in orange juice, stuffed with dried prunes, and finished with butter and orange zest.
steps: Butterfly the pork tenderloin into a 2 cm thick sheet, sprinkle with orange juice, season with salt and pepper, and refrigerate for about 60 minutes.
Rinse the dried prunes and arrange them over the meat.
Roll the meat into a roulade, sprinkle with marjoram, let stand for 10 minutes, then sear on all sides in heated butter.
Wrap the roulade in aluminum foil and bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C for about 50 minutes.
Towards the end of baking, open the foil, place butter shavings and chopped orange zest on top of the meat, and finish baking.
Slice the roasted meat into thick slices and garnish with fresh thyme sprigs.

name: Kiszona kapusta (homemade sauerkraut)
summary: Homemade fermented white cabbage with grated carrots and caraway, naturally preserved by lactic acid fermentation.
steps: Shred the white cabbage, grate the carrots on a coarse grater, and mix the vegetables with the salt and caraway seeds.

Line the bottom of a barrel or stoneware crock with whole cabbage leaves, then pack the shredded vegetables in layers, tamping them down firmly until juices release and leaving about 10 cm of headspace from the rim.
Cover the top with cabbage leaves, place a flat plate or wooden disc over them, and weigh down with a scalded stone or a jar filled with water.
Leave the crock for 3 days at room temperature for fermentation to start, then transfer to a cool place at 8–10 °C.
Ensure the cabbage remains completely submerged in brine, topping up if necessary with a brine made from 1 tbsp of salt per 1 l of water.

name: Zupa kremowa z brokułów (Cream of broccoli soup)
summary: A velvety cream of broccoli soup with onion and garlic in meat broth, blended with sour cream and seasoned with dried dill.
steps: Clean the broccoli, separate it into florets, and cut the stalks into smaller pieces.
Peel and chop the onion and garlic, then fry them in heated olive oil in a large pot.
Place the broccoli into the pot, pour in the meat broth, bring quickly to a boil, then reduce heat and cook gently covered for 5 minutes.
Strain the soup through a sieve, reserving the broth, transfer the drained broccoli to a bowl, add the sour cream, and blend until smooth.

Combine the blended broccoli purée with the broth, season with dried dill, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil (in a second variation, the soup can be prepared with 300 g broccoli cooked in 1 l chicken broth with the addition of 100 g blue cheese, 50 ml whipping cream (36% fat), and cheese croutons).

name: White cabbage and apricot salad (Sałatka z morelami)
summary: A sweet and spicy raw white cabbage salad with fresh and dried fruit and apricots from compote, dressed with lemon juice and olive oil.
steps: Soak the prunes and dried apples in apricot compote liquid until softened, then cut them and the apricots from the compote into smaller pieces.
Finely shred the white cabbage, cut the fresh apples into thin quarter-slices, and combine with the fruit.
Mix the lemon juice with the olive oil, 3–4 tbsp of apricot compote liquid, salt, and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Pour the prepared dressing over the salad, toss thoroughly, and sprinkle with chopped parsley leaves.

name: Braised chicken legs with mushrooms and sour cream (Udka z kurczaka z pieczarkami)
summary: Braised chicken legs with button mushrooms, celery, onion, and garlic in a rich sour cream sauce with thyme.
steps: Cut the chicken legs in half, season with salt and pepper, brown in the butter until the skin is golden and crisp, then transfer to a separate dish.
Add the sliced celery and onion to the same fat, sauté for a few minutes, and add to the chicken.
Add the thickly sliced button mushrooms to the pan, fry until browned, and set aside.
Briefly sauté the minced garlic without letting it brown, pour in 60 ml of water, and bring to the boil, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom.

Return the chicken, celery, and onion to the pan, add the bay leaf and thyme, cover, and braise over very low heat until the meat begins to fall off the bone, then add the mushrooms for a few minutes.
Pour in the sour cream thoroughly whisked with the coarse wheat flour, bring to a simmer until the sauce thickens, and season to taste with salt.

name: Keks (Polish fruitcake)
summary: A classic oblong sponge cake loaded with dried fruits and nuts dusted with plain flour.
steps: Separate the egg whites from the yolks, beat the whites until stiff peaks form, and chill in the refrigerator.
Beat the egg yolks with the sugar until pale, then, stirring constantly, fold in the dried fruit and nuts dusted with a little plain flour.
Gradually fold in the remaining plain flour 1 tbsp at a time, and finally gently fold in the chilled beaten egg whites.
Transfer the batter to a loaf tin and bake for about 40 minutes in an oven preheated to 160 °C, then increase the temperature to 180 °C and bake for another 10 minutes.

name: Leniwe pierogi (farmer's cheese dumplings)
summary: Traditional dumplings made from farmer's cheese, eggs, and flour, served with breadcrumbs browned in butter.
steps: Bring 2–3 liters of lightly salted water to a boil in a wide pot.

Press the farmer's cheese through a ricer or sieve into a deep bowl, crack in the eggs, add a small knob of butter, a pinch of salt, and two-thirds of the prepared flour, then mix into a light, fluffy dough.
Turn the dough onto a pastry board dusted with the remaining flour, shape into rolls about 2 cm in diameter, flatten them slightly, and cut diagonally into pieces.
Drop the dumplings in batches into the boiling water and cook for 1–2 minutes after they float to the surface, stirring gently.
Remove the cooked dumplings with a slotted spoon onto a platter.
Brown the breadcrumbs in a dry frying pan, remove from the heat, add the remaining butter, stir until melted, and pour over the leniwe dumplings.

name: Purple Passion cocktail
summary: Sweet-and-sour cocktail made with vodka, dark grape juice, and grapefruit juice, served in a sugar-rimmed glass.
steps: Pour the sugar onto a saucer, rub the rim of a highball glass with a lemon slice, dip the rim into the sugar, and leave to dry.
Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice cubes, pour in the vodka, dark grape juice, and grapefruit juice, and shake vigorously.
Fill the prepared glass three-quarters full with fresh ice cubes and strain the cocktail into it.

name: North Star cocktail
summary: Classic alcoholic cocktail made with brandy, gin, dry vermouth, and grapefruit juice.
steps: Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice cubes.
Pour in the grapefruit juice, dry vermouth, brandy, and gin, and mix thoroughly.
Strain the cocktail into a tall cocktail glass.

name: Pasta with poached salmon in sour cream sauce
summary: Single-serving pasta dish with salmon poached in vegetable broth, served in a delicate sour cream sauce with Parmesan and fresh parsley.
steps: Rinse the salmon fillet, poach in the vegetable broth, let cool, and cut into pieces.
Cook the pasta al dente, drain thoroughly in a sieve, and cover to keep warm.
Whisk the vegetable broth with the 12% sour cream in a saucepan, simmer for 5 minutes, and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Add the salmon pieces and margarine to the sauce and warm briefly without boiling.
Pour the prepared sauce over the pasta and sprinkle with grated Parmesan and chopped parsley leaves.

name: Ciastka andrzejkowe (Polish St. Andrew's Day fortune cookies)
summary: Crisp fortune cookies shaped into crescents while still warm for Polish St. Andrew's Eve celebrations.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for boiling a thick syrup (corrected from 500 ml)

steps: Stir the sugar into the water, boil into a syrup, and set aside to cool.
Cream the cooled syrup with the butter and vanilla sugar, then add the egg whites and plain flour, mixing thoroughly.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Spoon thin rounds of batter onto a baking sheet lined with baking paper and bake for about 10 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet, let the cookies cool slightly, place fortune papers onto the warm rounds, and fold into crescent shapes.
Bake the shaped cookies for another 5 minutes at 180 °C.

name: Semolina sponge cake
summary: A light baked semolina sponge cake studded with raisins, soaked with fruit juice, and served with whipped cream.
steps: Beat the egg yolks with half the sugar and the vanilla sugar, and whip the egg whites to stiff peaks with the remaining sugar.
Gently fold the whipped whites into the yolk mixture, sprinkle in the semolina and raisins, and mix carefully.
Pour the batter into a small loaf pan and bake for 30 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.
Remove the cake from the oven, pour the fruit juice evenly over the top, and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Cool the cake completely, remove from the pan, and decorate with whipped cream before serving.

name: Żur biały (white sour rye soup)
summary: A hearty white sour rye soup in beef broth with smoked kiełbasa, pork belly, dried mushrooms, and potatoes, thickened with sour cream and wholemeal flour.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for soaking mushrooms, blending the thickening mixture, and adjusting consistency

steps: Dice the pork belly finely and fry in a pan. Peel the onions, cut into medium dice, add to the pork belly, and cook until translucent or lightly golden.
Cover the dried mushrooms with hot water, and once softened, drain and chop them finely. Peel and dice the potatoes, and dice or score the kiełbasa.
Heat the beef broth in a pot, add the potatoes, kiełbasa, and mushrooms, and cook until the potatoes are tender.
Add the fried pork belly with onion, pour in the rye sour (or concentrate), season with marjoram, lovage, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
In a small bowl, whisk the flour into the sour cream until smooth, add a little water to make a pourable mixture, and pour it into the simmering soup, stirring constantly.
Season to taste with a crushed garlic clove or horseradish. Serve hot with a slice of traditional bread (the soup tastes even better when left to rest for a dozen up to 24 hours and reheated).

name: Sakiewki z rybą i ryżem (cabbage bundles with smoked fish and rice)
summary: Appetiser parcels made from parboiled cabbage leaves, filled with a salad of rice, smoked fish, vinegar pickles and spring onions, and tied with carrot ribbons.
steps: Peel the carrot, cut into long ribbons, parboil for 2 minutes in salted boiling water, and drain.
Blanch the cabbage leaves briefly in boiling water, remove, drain, and let cool.
Boil the rice until tender, drain well, and let cool completely.
Dice the vinegar pickles, divide the smoked fish into small pieces, and finely chop the spring onions.
Mix the cooled rice with the smoked fish, cucumbers, spring onions, and mayonnaise, and season the filling with salt and pepper.
Spoon portions of filling onto the cabbage leaves, gather the edges into little pouches, secure with toothpicks, and tie with the carrot ribbons.

name: Sałatka pieczarkowa (marinated mushroom salad)
summary: Sliced button mushrooms simmered with caraway and lemon juice, served on lettuce leaves with a sweet-and-sour parsley vinaigrette.
steps: Clean, rinse, and thinly slice the button mushrooms, then cook them gently covered in a skillet with a splash of water, salt, caraway, and lemon juice.
Whisk the vinegar with the oil, sugar, white pepper, and finely chopped parsley.
Arrange the washed green lettuce leaves on a platter, top with the cooled mushrooms, drizzle with the prepared marinade, and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.

name: Pork liver soup (Wątrobianka)
summary: A traditional puréed soup of braised pork liver in meat broth, thickened with egg yolks.
steps: Trim the pork liver, chop it finely, and braise gently in the butter.
Dust the liver with plain flour and cook gently for a moment longer, stirring.
Pour in the meat broth and simmer over low heat until tender.
Pass the soup through a sieve, bring back to the boil, season with salt, and pour hot into a tureen over the whisked egg yolks.

name: Egg, mushroom and walnut croquettes
summary: Bite-sized vegetarian croquettes made with chopped hard-boiled eggs, sautéed mushrooms, and walnuts, crumb-coated and fried.
steps: Clean the mushrooms, cut them into small dice, and sauté in heated oil.
Hard-boil 4 of the eggs, cool, peel, and dice them finely.
Combine the sautéed mushrooms with the diced eggs, parsley, and chopped walnuts, crack in 1 raw egg, season with salt and pepper, and mix into a cohesive mixture.
Shape into small oval patties, dredge successively in flour, the remaining beaten egg, and breadcrumbs, then fry in hot oil until golden brown.

name: Panczkraut (Silesian cabbage and mashed potatoes)
summary: A traditional Silesian dish of cooked white cabbage and sauerkraut combined with mashed potatoes and a pork fatback roux.
steps: Shred the white cabbage and boil until tender with caraway seeds, and cook the sauerkraut in a separate pot.
Peel the potatoes, boil until tender, drain, and mash thoroughly.
Finely dice the smoked fatback, render it in a skillet, lightly fry the chopped onion in the rendered fat, and sprinkle with flour to make a roux.
Combine both cooked cabbages with the mashed potatoes in a large pot.
Add the fatback and onion roux and pour in the pork rib broth.
Season with pepper, salt, and optional liquid seasoning, and stir thoroughly.

name: Hard-boiled eggs on spring vegetable slaw
summary: Hard-boiled eggs served over lettuce with a slaw of grated carrots, corn, and spring onions in a creamy yogurt-sour cream dressing.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, let them cool, and peel them.
Trim and chop the spring onions, peel and coarsely grate the carrots, drain the sweetcorn, and rinse and dry the lettuce.
In a small bowl, whisk the plain yogurt with the sour cream and mustard, then season the dressing with salt and black pepper.
Combine the spring onions, grated carrots, and sweetcorn in a large bowl.
Arrange the lettuce leaves on plates, top with the vegetables, drizzle with the dressing, arrange the halved eggs on top, and garnish with parsley leaves.

name: Green onion soup (Zielona zupa cebulowa)
summary: A quick soup of sautéed spring onions, leek, and yellow onions in broth, served over diced blue cheese (Rokpol type) and topped with chives and hot paprika.
steps: Finely chop 3 spring onions, leek, and yellow onions, and chop the fourth spring onion separately for serving.
Heat the oil in a saucepan, add the chopped vegetables, and fry until golden, stirring constantly.
Pour a liter of boiling water over the vegetables, add the bouillon cubes, and bring to a boil.
Season the soup with freshly ground pepper and a pinch of salt, and simmer covered for about 10 minutes.
Dice the blue cheese into small cubes, divide among plates, ladle the hot soup over, and garnish with the reserved chopped spring onion and a pinch of hot paprika.

name: No-bake layered vanilla quark and jelly cake (Torcik bez pieczenia)
summary: A colourful, multi-layered chilled dessert of vanilla quark cheese, assorted fruit jellies, and fresh fruit.
steps: Dissolve the first packet of jelly in 375 ml of hot water, cool, blend with one tub of vanilla quark, pour into a springform cake tin, and refrigerate until set.
Dissolve the second jelly of a different colour in 375 ml of water, cool, combine with the second tub of quark, pour over the set first layer, and chill again.
Prepare the third layer in the same way with another jelly and the third tub of quark, pour into the tin, and arrange fresh fruit on top.
Once the third layer has set, pour the fourth, cooled jelly dissolved in 375 ml of water over the fruit, and refrigerate the cake until completely set.

name: Pikle z ogórków (Polish sweet and sour pickled cucumbers)
summary: Sweet and tangy Polish cucumber pickles made from ripe field cucumbers in a spiced vinegar brine with yellow mustard seeds and allspice.
steps: Wash and peel the cucumbers, cut in half lengthwise, scrape out the seeds with a spoon, and cut the halves lengthwise into 4 long spears.
Layer the prepared cucumbers in a bowl, sprinkle with salt, and let stand for 12 hours, then drain in a colander and pack into sterilized jars.
Bring a brine of water, sugar, mustard seeds, and vinegar to a boil, then pour the hot liquid over the cucumbers in the jars.
Add a few allspice berries to each jar, seal tightly with lids, and pasteurise in a water bath for about 30 minutes.

name: Faworki (angel wings)
summary: Traditional Polish crisp, light carnival pastry ribbons made from beaten egg yolk and sour cream dough, fried in lard and dusted with vanilla powdered sugar.
steps: Knead an elastic dough from the plain flour, egg yolks, thick sour cream, and spirit or vinegar.
Fold, roll, and beat the dough repeatedly with a mallet or rolling pin until air bubbles appear, then cover with a kitchen towel and let rest for 60 minutes.
Cut off a portion of dough at a time, dust lightly with flour, roll out paper-thin, and slice into strips about 4 cm wide.
Make a slit in the center of each strip and pull one end through the slit to form a ribbon bow.
Melt and heat the lard in a wide pot and fry the faworki in batches on both sides until golden.
Remove the fried faworki with a fork, drain on paper towels, and, while still hot, sift over icing sugar mixed with vanilla sugar.

name: Roast turkey breast in citrus ginger sauce
summary: Cold roast turkey breast served in a toasted sesame citrus-ginger sauce with mandarin orange segments.
steps: Rub the turkey breast with salt and black pepper, place in a roasting pan, brush with oil, and roast for about 50 minutes at 200 °C, basting with pan juices.
Cool the roasted meat, slice thinly, and arrange on a platter.
Toast the sesame seeds in a saucepan, add the butter, and once melted, pour in the orange juice and lemon juice, add the lemon zest and grated ginger, and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Pour the sauce over the turkey slices, chill in the refrigerator, and garnish with mandarin orange segments.

name: Fresh strawberry and citrus salad (Sałatka z truskawkami)
summary: A vibrant fruit salad of sliced strawberries, kiwi, bananas, and oranges dressed with ginger, orange liqueur, and honey.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: scalded, 4 slices and zest for garnish, juice for dressing

steps: Wash and hull the strawberries, peel the kiwis and bananas, and slice the fruit.
Peel the oranges, slice them into half-rounds, and divide all the fruit among four salad bowls.
Scald the lemon, cut off 4 thin slices for garnish, pare thin strips of zest from the rest, and squeeze the juice from the pulp.
Whisk the lemon juice with the orange juice, orange liqueur, honey, and finely grated ginger.
Drizzle the fruit in the bowls with the prepared dressing and garnish with lemon slices, zest strips, and lemon balm leaves.

name: Sałatka miłosna (celery, pineapple, and grape salad)
summary: A fresh fruit and vegetable salad of celery stalks, apple, pineapple, grapes, and wheat sprouts in a honey-sweetened yogurt and horseradish dressing.

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.note: stalks with leaves reserved for garnish

steps: Wash the celery stalks and slice them into pieces, reserving the tender leaves for garnish.
Wash and dry the grapes, cut them in half, and slice the peeled apple thinly.
Rinse the wheat sprouts, drain the canned pineapple and cut into chunks, then place all the prepared ingredients into a salad bowl.
Whisk the plain yogurt with the horseradish, lemon juice, and honey, season with salt and pepper, pour over the salad, and garnish with the reserved celery leaves.

name: Garlic braised chicken
summary: Chicken portions braised with two whole heads of garlic, sliced onions, herbs, broth, and white wine.
steps: Rinse and pat dry the chicken, sprinkle with lemon juice, rub with salt and pepper, chill for 2 hours, then joint into portions.
Peel the onions and slice into thin crescents. Separate the garlic heads into cloves and peel them.
Heat the oil in a braising pan and brown the chicken portions on all sides.
Add the onion, whole peeled garlic cloves, and a portion of the herbs, pour in the broth, and braise gently over low heat for about 50 minutes.
Remove the softened garlic cloves and herbs from the pan, pour in the white wine, and simmer for a few minutes more. Scatter fresh herbs over the dish before serving.

name: Fasolowa po chłopsku (peasant-style bean soup)
summary: A simple vegetarian bean soup with garlic and bay leaf, finished with sour cream mixed with flour.
steps: Rinse and pick over the beans, cover with part of the water, and leave to soak overnight.
Top up the water in the pot to about 2 liters and begin cooking the beans.
When the beans are halfway tender, add the peeled garlic cloves, bay leaf, and salt, and cook until completely soft.
Whisk the sour cream with the flour, pour through a fine sieve into the simmering soup, and bring to a boil again.

name: Cold radish and yogurt soup
summary: Light summer cold soup of fresh radishes blended with plain yogurt and whipped cream.
steps: Wash the radishes and trim the ends. Reserve a few for garnish, and chop and blend the remainder with the plain yogurt.
Add a few drops of lemon juice and a pinch of salt to the whipping cream, whip until stiff, and gently fold into the blended yogurt mixture.
Season the cold soup with salt and pepper, stir thoroughly, and chill in the refrigerator.
Ladle into bowls, scatter over the chopped herbs, and garnish with pieces of the reserved radishes.

name: Owocowy chłodnik duński (Danish strawberry buttermilk cold soup / koldskål)
summary: A chilled dessert soup of buttermilk, egg yolks whipped with sugar, whipped cream, and blended strawberries, served with flaked almonds and meringues.
steps: Wash the strawberries, hull them and set aside a few berries for garnish; blend the remainder, press through a sieve, and chill.
Whisk the egg yolks with sugar and lemon juice until pale and fluffy.
Whip the cream to stiff peaks, lightly whisk the chilled buttermilk, and pour it into the whisked yolks.
Fold in the whipped cream and strawberry puree until gently combined.
Ladle the cold soup into four bowls, scatter with flaked almonds, and garnish with sliced strawberries and mini meringues.

name: Polish mushroom noodle soup (Zupa grzybowa z makaronem)
summary: A classic Polish mushroom soup made from dried porcini and soup vegetables, thickened with a light butter-and-onion roux, and served with noodles.

ingredients.name: dried mushrooms (porcini, slippery jacks, or bay boletes)
onion
ingredients.note: small (or half a larger one), finely chopped, for the roux

steps: Scald the dried mushrooms with boiling water, rinse them, and simmer gently covered.
Peel and wash the soup vegetables, add whole to the mushrooms along with peppercorns and allspice berries, simmer for 25–30 minutes, then strain the broth.
Slice the caps of the cooked mushrooms into thin strips, return them to the broth, and season the soup with salt and vinegar or lemon juice.

Melt a tablespoon of butter in a skillet, sauté the finely chopped onion and transfer it to the soup, then briefly cook a tablespoon of flour in the remaining fat until it loses its raw taste without browning. Whisk in a few tablespoons of broth and pour into the pot. Optionally, stir in sour cream.
Cook the pasta separately, drain, rinse with cold water, divide among plates, ladle hot soup over, and serve with chopped dill or parsley leaves.

name: Bogrács (Hungarian goulash soup with csipetke)
summary: A Hungarian goulash soup with tender beef, potatoes, bell peppers, and tomatoes, served with hand-pinched csipetke noodles.
steps: Dice the beef, peel and chop the onions, dust with paprika powder, and fry together in melted lard until browned.
Add the finely minced garlic and caraway, pour in a splash of water, cover, and braise over low heat for about 90 minutes until the meat is tender.
Dice the potatoes and tomatoes, cut the green and red bell peppers into strips, add to the pot with water, season with salt, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Knead a stiff dough from the wheat flour, egg, and a pinch of salt, then pinch off small noodles (csipetke) directly into the simmering soup.
Cook for a few minutes more until the pinched noodles float to the surface.

name: Cod in spicy tomato sauce
summary: Cod fillets gently simmered in a robust, zesty sauce of fresh ripe tomatoes, onion, and red chili peppers.
steps: Blanch the tomatoes in boiling water, peel and dice them, and finely chop the peeled onion and seeded red chili peppers.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan and cook the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, chili peppers, and vinegar, season with salt and pepper, then cover and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Rinse and pat dry the cod fillets, nestle them into the sauce in the pan, cover, and simmer for another 15 minutes.

name: Kalarepa faszerowana (stuffed kohlrabi with veal and cream sauce)
summary: Kohlrabi bulbs stuffed with minced veal and baked in a creamy kohlrabi sauce.
steps: Trim the kohlrabi, cut off tops, hollow out the flesh, and parboil the hollowed bulbs in broth, then drain.
Peel and chop the onion, cook until translucent in part of the butter, add the minced veal, fry lightly, and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Gently stew the scooped-out kohlrabi flesh in the fat left from frying the meat, add 125 ml of broth, and stew until tender.
Add chopped parsley leaves and sour cream to the cooked flesh, blend until smooth, and stir part of the sauce into the meat.
Fill the kohlrabi with the meat stuffing, arrange in a greased baking dish, dot with the remaining butter, and bake for about 20 minutes.

name: Łódeczki z pomidorów (stuffed tomato boats)
summary: Hollowed-out tomatoes stuffed with a crunchy vegetable salad and decorated with firm cheese sails.
steps: Wash the tomatoes, slice off their tops, hollow out the flesh, and dice the sliced tops.
Wash, dry, and shred the iceberg lettuce leaves. Peel the cucumber, deseed the red and yellow bell peppers, and cut the vegetables into small pieces.
Mix the lemon juice with a pinch of salt, black pepper, and olive oil, then pour the dressing over the chopped vegetables and toss.
Fill the hollowed tomatoes with the salad. Cut the firm cheese slices into triangles, skewer on toothpicks, and decorate the tomatoes to resemble sails.

name: Jajka panierowane (Polish breaded fried eggs)
summary: Hard-boiled egg halves coated in egg and breadcrumbs, fried until golden and served cold with mayonnaise.
steps: Peel the hard-boiled eggs and slice them in half lengthwise.
Whisk the raw egg with the milk and season with salt and black pepper.
Coat the egg halves in the egg mixture and breadcrumbs, fry in hot oil until golden, and transfer to a serving platter.
Once the eggs have cooled, drizzle with mayonnaise, garnish with lettuce leaves and sliced bell pepper, and sprinkle chopped chives and parsley leaves on top.

name: Beef with pears (Wołowina z gruszkami)
summary: Slices of meat marinated in soy sauce and cooked until tender in an aromatic broth with fennel and rosemary, served alternately with fresh pear slices and crumbled mold-ripened cheese.

ingredients.name: lean beef or pork
ingredients.note: listed as pork in ingredients, but beef in title and steps

steps: Cut the meat into four slices, sprinkle with soy sauce, cover, and let rest for 2 hours.
Pour the broth into a pot, add the rosemary sprigs, carrots, fennel, onion, bay leaves, and marinated meat slices, and cook until tender.
Peel the pears, halve, core, and slice them, then season each slice with salt and pepper and sprinkle with crumbled mold-ripened cheese.
Arrange the cooked meat slices alternately with the pear slices topped with mold-ripened cheese on a platter.

name: Pyzy z mięsem (potato dumplings stuffed with meat)
summary: Polish potato dumplings filled with cooked veal and beef, sautéed onion, and button mushrooms, served sprinkled with chives.
steps: Boil the potatoes, let them cool, and pass through a meat grinder or ricer.
Add the plain flour, eggs, and salt to the potatoes, knead into a uniform dough, roll into a log, and cut into equal pieces.
Chop the onion and button mushrooms, and brown in hot oil.

Soak the bread roll, squeeze out excess liquid, and grind together with the cooked veal and beef, then mix with the sautéed onion and mushrooms, tomato paste, and sour cream, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Place portions of meat filling onto the dough pieces, shape into round dumplings, and boil in salted water until they float to the surface.
Remove the cooked dumplings with a slotted spoon and sprinkle with chopped chives before serving.

name: Smoked fish, potato and egg casserole (Zapiekanka z rybą wędzoną)
summary: A layered casserole of jacket-boiled potatoes, smoked fish, hard-boiled eggs, and sautéed onions, baked under a sour cream and flour sauce.

ingredients.name: margarine
ingredients.note: for sautéing the onion and greasing the dish

steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, cool, peel, and slice into rounds.
Peel the onions, slice into half-rings, and sauté in fat.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel and slice them, and skin, debone, and flake the smoked fish into small pieces.
Grease an ovenproof baking dish with fat and arrange a layer of potatoes, then a layer of onion, fish, and eggs, and cover with the remaining potatoes on top.
Whisk the sour cream with flour, season with salt and pepper, pour over the casserole, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and bake in the oven.

name: Cream and fruit-custard sponge cake (Tort śmietanowy)
summary: A tall sponge torte layered with orange and apple juice custard and gelatine-stabilised whipped cream.
steps: Beat the egg whites with a pinch of salt and sugar until stiff peaks form, add the egg yolks mixed with vinegar and baking powder, then gently fold in the sifted cake flour and potato starch.
Pour the batter into the tin, bake at 180 °C for about 40 minutes, and once cooled, slice the sponge horizontally into two layers.
Dissolve the custard powder with sugar in 500 ml of the orange-apple juice, pour into the remaining 500 ml of simmering juice, and cook into a thick custard.
Whip the cream until stiff and combine with the dissolved gelatine.
Spread the custard filling over one sponge half, spread most of the whipped cream over the other, and once cooled and set, sandwich the two halves together.
Spread the remaining whipped cream over the top of the cake and refrigerate for about 60 minutes to chill.

name: Roast meat and broccoli casserole (Zapiekanka z pieczonym mięsem)
summary: A simple casserole of sliced roast meat and boiled potatoes topped with broccoli florets and carrots, baked under grated firm cheese.
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots in their skins, peel, and slice the potatoes and dice the carrots.
Parboil the broccoli briefly and divide into florets.

Grease an ovenproof baking dish with oil, layer the slices of potatoes and roast meat alternately, arrange the broccoli florets and carrots around them, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle the top with grated cheese.
Bake for about 30 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.

name: Marchewka w sosie ziołowym (carrot and celeriac salad in herb yogurt dressing)
summary: Grated carrot and celeriac salad with raisins and yogurt-mustard dressing, served on lettuce leaves with apple slices.
steps: Peel the carrots and celeriac and finely dice them or grate on a coarse grater.
Add the raisins to the vegetables, toss together, season with salt and pepper, and set aside.
Whisk the plain yogurt thoroughly with the sweet paprika, grated lemon zest, pepper, mustard, and finely chopped herbs.
Dress the carrots and celeriac with the yogurt sauce, arrange on lettuce leaves, and garnish with apple slices.

name: Zupa z soczewicy (Polish lentil soup with beef and bacon)
summary: A nourishing red lentil soup cooked with beef, Polish soup vegetables, and potatoes, finished with a roux of smoked bacon, onion, and garlic.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: 4 glasses for cooking (plus cold water to soak the lentils)

steps: Cover the lentils with cold water and soak for 8 hours.
Place the beef in a pot, pour in 1 litre (4 glasses) of water, add the soaked lentils along with their water and the bay leaf, season with salt, and cook for about 60 minutes.
Clean the soup vegetables and potatoes, dice them, add to the soup, and cook until tender.
Peel and chop the onion and garlic, and dice the smoked bacon.
Fry the bacon in heated oil together with the onion and garlic, dust with the wheat flour, stir, and transfer into the simmering soup.

Bring everything to a boil, season with pepper, and garnish with chopped parsley before serving (in a second version, the soup can be cooked on smoked meat with the addition of sweet paprika, mustard, sour cream, and lemon juice).

name: Smoked turkey and farmer's cheese salad (Sałatka z indykiem)
summary: A quick salad of smoked turkey breast, tomatoes, and vinegar pickle with a farmer's cheese, yogurt, horseradish, and mustard dressing.
steps: Mash and beat the farmer's cheese with plain yogurt, oil, horseradish, and mustard until smooth, then season to taste with vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Peel the tomatoes and vinegar pickle, then dice them into small cubes.
Dice the smoked turkey breast into bite-sized pieces, combine with the vegetables, and toss with the prepared farmer's cheese dressing.

name: Sweet rice and fruit salad (Sałatka z ryżem i owocami)
summary: A sweet rice salad with apples, canned peaches, prunes, and raisins, topped with a warm cream and egg yolk sauce.
steps: Cook the rice until fluffy with grains separated, then set aside to cool.
Soak the dried prunes and raisins in warm water, then drain thoroughly and cut the prunes into thin strips.
Drain the canned peaches and dice them along with the fresh apples.
In a small saucepan, whisk the egg yolks with the sugar, pour in the heavy cream, and cook over very low heat, whisking constantly, until the sauce thickens.
Mix the cooked rice with the fresh and dried fruit, pour over the warm cream sauce, and dust with vanilla sugar.

name: Kapusta pekińska z pieczarkami (napa cabbage salad with mushrooms)
summary: Salad of shredded napa cabbage and braised mushrooms in a garlic vinegar dressing.
steps: Finely shred the napa cabbage and transfer it to a bowl.
Clean the mushrooms, quarter them, drizzle with lemon juice, season with salt, and cook gently, covered, with water over low heat for a few minutes.
Add chopped parsley leaves to the mushrooms, mix, and combine with the shredded cabbage.
Finely chop the onion, whisk with crushed garlic, oil, vinegar, and sugar, and pour the prepared dressing over the salad.

name: Kartoflanka po węgiersku (Hungarian-style potato soup with browned pasta)
summary: Simple Hungarian potato soup with pasta browned in pork fatback and sweet paprika.
steps: Finely dice the pork fatback and render it in a pot.
Add the pasta into the hot fat and fry until golden brown.
Stir in the sweet paprika powder quickly, then add the peeled, diced potatoes.
Pour in water, season with salt to taste, and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes and pasta are tender.

name: Kisiel mleczno-migdałowy (milk pudding with almonds)
summary: A delicate milk dessert thickened with potato starch, enriched with chopped almonds and vanilla flavouring.
steps: Skin the almonds and chop them finely.
Bring 250 ml of the milk to a boil in a saucepan. Thoroughly mix the heaped tablespoon of potato starch into the remaining 125 ml of cold milk until smooth.
Slowly pour the slurry into the simmering milk, stirring vigorously all the while.
Add the chopped almonds and vanilla flavouring and cook briefly until thickened, then pour the dessert into dessert bowls rinsed with cold water.

name: Łosoś w sosie serowym (baked salmon in cheese sauce)
summary: Salmon steaks baked under a sauce made with sour cream, plain yogurt, garlic, and firm cheese.
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Grease an ovenproof dish with olive oil, place the salmon steaks in it, sprinkle with salt, cover with aluminium foil, and bake for 20 minutes.
Combine the 12% sour cream with plain yogurt, add the minced garlic, chopped parsley leaves, and grated firm cheese, and mix thoroughly.
Remove the foil, pour the cheese sauce over the fish, and bake for another 15 minutes.

name: Kawa mrożona (iced coffee with whipped cream)
summary: Classic iced black coffee served with fluffy whipped cream.
steps: Pour boiling water over the ground coffee, strain the brew, sweeten with sugar, and let cool.
Place the cooled coffee in the freezer and chill until semi-frozen.
Whip the heavy whipping cream into stiff peaks, beating in the powdered sugar towards the end.
Pour the frozen coffee into cups and garnish with whipped cream.

name: Kotlety z kaszy jęczmiennej (Barley groats and mushroom cutlets)
summary: Vegetarian patties made from cooked barley groats, dried mushrooms, onion, and eggs, crumb-coated and fried.
steps: Cook the barley groats until tender yet distinct.
Rinse the dried mushrooms, soak them for 60 minutes in lukewarm boiled water, then simmer in the same water for about 50 minutes.
Pass the cooked mushrooms, peeled onion, and half of the groats through a mincer. Add the remaining groats, crack in the eggs, season with salt and pepper, and work into a cohesive mixture.
Turn the mixture onto a pastry board dusted with breadcrumbs, shape into a thick log, and divide into 10 portions.
Form into patties, coat in breadcrumbs, and fry in hot fat until golden brown.

name: Pasta and feta salad (Sałatka z makaronem i fetą)
summary: A hearty pasta salad with ham, feta cheese, red bell pepper, cucumber, and canned sweetcorn.
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, drain, and let cool.
Wash and dry the bell pepper and cucumber, then cut them into dice along with the feta cheese.
Drain the canned sweetcorn, and slice the ham into strips or thin slices.
Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and season to taste with all-purpose seasoning, salt, and pepper.

name: Rosół babuni (traditional Polish beef and chicken broth)
summary: Traditional slow-simmered beef and chicken broth with root vegetables, dried mushroom, and charred onion, served with sliced crêpe strips.

ingredients.name: Polish soup vegetables (carrot, parsley root, celeriac and leek)

steps: Place the beef and half chicken into a pot, add the rinsed soup vegetables without the cabbage, dried mushroom, bay leaf, black peppercorns, and allspice berries.
Pour 2 litres of water over the ingredients, bring to a boil, reduce the heat, and simmer gently for an hour, skimming any foam from the surface regularly.
After an hour of simmering, add the cabbage from the soup vegetables and the onion charred in a dry skillet, then simmer for another hour.
Remove the meat and vegetables, strain the broth through a fine sieve, season with salt, and heat thoroughly.
Roll the crêpes into tight cylinders, slice into thin ribbons, and serve with hot broth ladled over them.

name: Cold horseradish and yogurt sauce
summary: A quick cold sauce made from mayonnaise, plain yogurt, grated horseradish, lemon juice, and pickled peppercorns.
steps: Mix the mayonnaise with the plain yogurt in a small bowl, then add the grated horseradish and a few drops of lemon juice.
Combine the ingredients thoroughly, stir in the pickled peppercorns, and season the sauce to taste with salt and black pepper.

name: Gołąbki z orzechami (cabbage rolls with pork and walnuts)
summary: Savoy cabbage leaves stuffed with minced pork, pork belly, bell pepper, and walnuts, baked in butter.
steps: Blanch the savoy cabbage leaves briefly in boiling water and drain them thoroughly.
Finely chop the walnuts, core and finely dice the bell pepper, and finely dice the pork belly.
Season the ground pork with salt, pepper, ground paprika, and crumbled dried mint.
Add the flour, eggs, diced pepper, pork belly, and walnuts to the meat and knead the mixture thoroughly.
Divide the filling among the cabbage leaves, roll them up into parcels, and tie with kitchen twine.
Arrange the cabbage rolls in an ovenproof dish, dot with butter, cover, and bake for 30 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Stuffed Pineapple Fruit Salad
summary: A refreshing fruit salad of fresh pineapple, orange, apple, and strawberries dressed with honey and vanilla, served inside a hollowed-out pineapple.
steps: Slice off and reserve the leafy top of the pineapple, scoop out the flesh from the base, chop it finely, and save any released juice.
Peel and core the apple, dice the flesh finely, and toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Peel the orange, remove the bitter white membranes from the segments, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Combine the chopped pineapple and orange pieces with the reserved juice, honey, and vanilla flavouring, then add the diced apple and sliced strawberries.
Fill the hollowed pineapple shell with the fruit salad, cover with the reserved top, and chill in the refrigerator before serving.

name: Pstrąg w winie (trout in white wine)
summary: Grilled whole trout stuffed with fresh rosemary sprigs and basted with dry white wine.
steps: Clean and gut the trout, trim the fins, remove the gills and eyes, then wash thoroughly and pat dry.
Drizzle each fish with olive oil and let stand for 30 minutes.
Season the trout with salt and pepper, and insert a sprig of fresh rosemary into the cavity of each fish.
Place the trout on a preheated grill rack and cook, basting occasionally with dry white wine, then serve with lemon slices.

name: Spiked iced tea with rum and lemon
summary: Chilled brewed black tea infused with rum, lemon peel, ice cubes, and fresh lemon balm.
steps: Cool the brewed tea, stir in the sugar, rum, and lemon peel, and chill in the refrigerator.
Fill a tall glass one-third full with ice cubes and pour in the cold tea.
Garnish the drink with lemon slices and fresh lemon balm leaves.

name: Oven-baked vegetables with breadcrumbs (Warzywa z piekarnika)
summary: Parboiled broccoli and cauliflower florets, carrots, and colourful courgettes baked under a golden topping of breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, and butter.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for greasing the baking sheet and topping

steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and grease a baking sheet with a little butter.
Divide the broccoli and cauliflower into florets, and slice the peeled carrots and rinsed courgettes into rounds.
Bring 500 ml of salted water to the boil in a pot, add the broccoli, cauliflower, and carrots, and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes, adding the courgette slices for the final minute.
Drain the vegetables, arrange them on the baking sheet, season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with breadcrumbs mixed with chopped fresh parsley, and dot with butter flakes.
Bake the vegetables for 30 minutes, turning them occasionally.

name: Omlet z serem i ziołami (cheese and herb omelette)
summary: Fluffy savoury omelettes made from a cooked egg-and-flour batter with grated cheese, whipped egg whites, and chives.
steps: Separate the egg yolks from the whites; in a saucepan, mix the yolks with salt and flour, and pour in the water.
Heat the mixture over low heat for about 15 minutes, until the batter thickens and puffs.
Beat the egg whites until stiff, then fold them into the batter along with the grated cheese and part of the chopped chives.
Heat oil in a frying pan and fry four pale golden omelettes.
Transfer the omelettes to plates, sprinkle with the remaining chives, and serve hot.

name: Zupa serowa zapiekana (Baked cheese soup)
summary: A thick onion and firm cheese soup made with broth and milk, baked in the oven and served with crunchy croutons.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: boiling water to dissolve the stock cubes

steps: Pour 1 litre of boiling water over the stock cubes and stir until dissolved.
Peel the onions, dice them, and cook until translucent in heated butter in a pot.
Add the flour and fry together with the onions for about 2 minutes, then gradually pour in the hot broth, stirring constantly.
Cook the soup for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Pour in the milk, season with salt and pepper, and stir in the grated firm cheese.
Pour the soup into an ovenproof dish, place in an oven preheated to 180 °C, and bake for 15 minutes; serve with croutons.

name: Salt-crusted sea bream
summary: Whole sea bream stuffed with garlic and fresh thyme, baked under a thick crust of sea salt to lock in moisture.
steps: Rinse the cleaned sea bream, pat dry with paper towels, and rub the cavity with lemon juice.
Peel and halve the garlic cloves, then place them and the thyme sprig inside the fish.
Cover the base of a baking dish with a finger-thick layer of sea salt, arrange the fish on top, bury completely with the remaining salt, press down gently, and mist with water.
Cover the dish with foil, bake for about 45 minutes in an oven preheated to 250 °C, crack open the salt crust, and serve the fish with lemon wedges.

name: Basil chicken with carrots in sour cream sauce
summary: Tender chicken breast chunks braised with carrots, onions, and garlic in a savoury sour cream and broth sauce scented with fresh basil.
steps: Cut the chicken fillets into large dice. Peel the carrots and onions and slice into rounds, and peel and mince the garlic.
Melt the cooking fat in a frying pan, add the chicken, and cook for 8–10 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Add the carrots, onion, and garlic, and cook together for 3 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth and sour cream, bring to a brief boil, and thicken the sauce with the flour.
Lower the heat and braise for 10 minutes, then stir in the finely chopped basil and adjust the seasoning to taste.

name: Likier Wisielec (suspended orange liqueur)
summary: Homemade orange-clove liqueur made by suspending the fruit above sweetened vodka.
steps: Pour the vodka into a tall jar, add the sugar cubes, and stir until completely dissolved.
Thoroughly wash the orange, scald it with boiling water, pat dry, and stud its peel with the cloves.
Thread a thick string through the center of the orange and suspend the fruit under the lid of the jar so it does not touch the liquid.
Seal the jar tightly and set aside for about 2 months.

name: Potatoes in sour cream sauce (Ziemniaki w sosie śmietanowym)
summary: Jacket-boiled potatoes cut into slices and baked under thick sour cream with nutmeg, served with fresh chives.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: 1 tablespoon for the pan, 2 tablespoons for the sauce

steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel them, and cut into slices.
Arrange the potato slices on a baking sheet greased with 1 tablespoon of oil and season with salt and pepper.
Mix the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil with the sour cream, season with nutmeg, and pour the sauce over the potatoes.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 30 minutes, and sprinkle with chopped chives before serving.

name: Sałatka wiosenna (spring vegetable and egg salad)
summary: A classic Polish spring salad of fresh lettuce, cucumbers, radishes, green peas, and hard-boiled eggs in a creamy mayonnaise and sour cream dressing.
steps: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves, then tear them into bite-sized pieces.
Wash the radishes, peel the fresh cucumbers, and slice both vegetables thinly.
Hard-boil the eggs, let them cool, peel, and chop.
Transfer all the vegetables to a bowl, add the drained canned peas and chopped eggs.
Whisk the mayonnaise with the sour cream, pour the dressing over the ingredients, season with salt and pepper, and gently toss.

name: Zupa ze szparagów (white asparagus soup)
summary: A delicate white asparagus soup made with broth, thickened with roux and whipping cream, served with fresh tomatoes and parsley.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: 1 teaspoon for the broth, 1 teaspoon for the tomatoes

steps: Wash and peel the white asparagus. Simmer the peelings in the broth with 1 teaspoon of sugar for 10 minutes, then strain the broth.
Cut the peeled asparagus into diagonal pieces and parboil them in the strained broth until tender.
Scald the tomatoes with boiling water, peel them, cut into quarters, and remove the seeds. Dice the flesh and mix with the chopped parsley, lemon juice, and the remaining teaspoon of sugar.
Prepare a roux from the butter and flour, stir it into the soup, and cook covered for 5 minutes.
Pour in the whipping cream, taking care that it does not curdle, and season the soup with salt, black pepper, and nutmeg.
Before serving, add the prepared tomatoes mixed with parsley to the soup.

name: Chicken with peas and pineapple in curry cream sauce
summary: Pounded chicken breasts, pan-fried and braised in a sauce of whipping cream, butter, curry powder, peas, and pineapple.
steps: Rinse the chicken breasts, pound lightly with a meat mallet, season with salt and pepper, and fry in hot oil, then drain on paper towels.
Dice the pineapple slices, add to a pan together with the drained peas, add the butter and curry powder, and cook gently for a few moments.
Pour in the whipping cream, stir, return the fried chicken breasts to the pan, and braise together for several minutes.
Season the dish to taste with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Spiced marinated herring
summary: Herring pieces layered in a jar with onion, lemon juice and zest, vegetable oil, and crushed whole spices.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for seasoning the onion before serving

steps: Rinse the herrings, cut into 3–4 cm pieces, and layer in a large jar.
Crush the cloves, allspice, bay leaves, and juniper berries, mix with the mustard seeds and sugar, and slice one of the onions into rings.
Sprinkle each layer of herring with the spice mixture, layer with onion rings, drizzle with lemon juice and vegetable oil, and top with strips of scalded lemon zest.
Close the jar and chill in a cool place for 2–3 days (at least 48 hours).
An hour before serving, remove the herrings from the marinade, discard spices, arrange the fish on a platter, garnish with the second onion diced and salted, then chill before serving.

name: Frykadele w sosie (meatballs in sauce)
summary: Fried meatballs made with ground meat, onion, garlic, and a soaked bread roll.
steps: Soak the bread roll, squeeze it out, and combine it with the ground meat.
Add the finely chopped onion, egg, and pressed garlic, then season with salt and pepper.
Knead the meat mixture thoroughly and shape it into small balls.
Heat the oil in a frying pan and fry the meatballs on all sides until golden brown.

name: Korniszony (cornichons / pickled baby gherkins)
summary: Small field cucumbers preserved in a sweet-and-sour vinegar brine with spring onion, carrot, and whole spices.
steps: Wash the small cucumbers, then pour boiling water over them, followed by cold water.
Peel the carrot and slice into decorative stars, then pack the cucumbers tightly into jars, layering them with the spring onion slices, carrot, and dry dill seeds.
Bring 625 ml of water to a boil with 250 ml of 6% vinegar, the sugar, salt, peppercorns, allspice, cloves, and bay leaves, then leave the pickling brine to cool.
Pour the cooled vinegar brine over the cucumbers in the jars, seal tightly, and pasteurise for about 25 minutes.

name: Chutney pomidorowy (sweet and sour spiced tomato chutney)
summary: A sweet-and-sour, spiced sauce made from fresh tomatoes, tart apples, onions, raisins, and spices, perfect for grilled meats.
steps: Blanch the ripe tomatoes, rinse them with cold water, peel, and dice.
Peel the tart apples, core them, and cut into eighths, then cut the peeled white onion into eighths as well.
Peel and finely mince the garlic and fresh ginger, and slice the small hot chili peppers.
Combine the tomatoes, apples, onion, garlic, ginger, raisins, chili peppers, cinnamon bark, mustard seeds, green peppercorns, salt, and brown sugar in a saucepan.
Pour in about 60 ml of the red wine vinegar and bring the mixture to a boil while stirring.
Simmer gently over low heat for 60–75 minutes, stirring frequently and gradually adding the remaining red wine vinegar.
Ladle the hot chutney into sterilised jars and seal tightly at once.

name: Spiced hot chocolate
summary: A warming drink of chocolate melted in hot milk with cinnamon, cloves, and a hint of almond flavouring, served with whipped cream.
steps: Heat the milk gently in a saucepan along with the cinnamon stick and cloves.
Finely chop the chocolate, add it to the hot milk, and stir over low heat until completely melted and smooth.
Strain the drink through a sieve, add a few drops of almond flavouring, and froth with a mixer.
Pour the hot chocolate into cups or mugs and crown with whipped cream.

name: Strawberries with rice and yogurt (Truskawki z ryżem i jogurtem)
summary: A quick bowl dessert made with fresh strawberries, cooked rice, and plain yogurt.
steps: Wash and hull the strawberries, then arrange them in the bottom of a bowl.
Cover the fruit with a layer of cooked rice and spoon over the plain yogurt.
Optionally sprinkle the top with cane sugar and drizzle with maple syrup.

name: Spaghetti with tomato sauce and olives (Spaghetti z sosem pomidorowym i oliwkami)
summary: Vegetarian spaghetti in a canned tomato sauce with red onion, garlic, and herbs, served with olives, firm cheese, and blue cheese.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water and drain.
Peel and chop the red onion and garlic, cook in hot olive oil until translucent, then add the canned tomatoes.
Simmer the sauce until slightly reduced, season with salt, pepper, oregano, and basil, add the cooked pasta, and heat over low heat for 5 minutes.
Portion the spaghetti onto plates, arrange olives over top, and scatter with grated firm cheese and crumbled Rokpol blue cheese.

name: Naleśniki z czereśniami (sweet cherry crepes)
summary: Thick crepes fried in butter with fresh sweet cherry halves folded into chilled crepe batter.
steps: Blend the milk with the icing sugar, flour, eggs, and oil into a smooth batter, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Wash the sweet cherries, halve them, remove the stones, and drain slightly.
Fold the cherries into the batter and return the mixture to the refrigerator for another 30 minutes.
Grease a hot skillet with butter and fry thick crepes on both sides until golden brown.

name: Zupa z wina (wine soup)
summary: An elegant sweet spiced white wine soup infused with cinnamon, cloves, and lemon zest, thickened with egg yolks beaten with sugar.
steps: Beat the egg yolks with the sugar until pale and fluffy.
Heat the wine in a covered pan with the grated zest of half a lemon, a pinch of cinnamon, and the cloves.
Strain the hot wine and pour it slowly into the beaten yolks, whisking constantly with a whisk or mixer.
Place the saucepan back over low heat and whisk until the soup thickens, without letting it boil so the yolks do not curdle.
Serve in large goblets or decorative glass cups.

name: Beer-battered vegetables (Warzywa w cieście piwnym)
summary: Crispy bites of courgette, broccoli, carrot, onion, and button mushrooms coated in a fluffy beer batter and deep-fried until golden.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for blanching the vegetables and seasoning the mushrooms

steps: Mix the plain flour thoroughly with the egg yolks, beer, and herb seasoning, then gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites.
Trim and cut the courgettes, broccoli, carrots, and onion into pieces or slices, blanch in salted water for 2–3 minutes, then rinse with cold water, drain, and cool.
Clean the button mushrooms, cook gently covered until tender, and sprinkle with salt once cooled.
Dip the vegetables and mushrooms in batches into the beer batter and deep-fry for about 2 minutes until golden.

name: Vilnius-style cold sorrel soup (Wileńska zupa szczawiowa)
summary: A traditional Vilnius-style chilled soup made with fresh sorrel, chives, dill, garlic, and thick sour cream, served with hard-boiled eggs.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: boiling water for cooking the sorrel

steps: Wash the fresh sorrel, chop it finely, simmer for 2–3 minutes in lightly salted boiling water, and let cool.
Boil the eggs until hard, cool, peel, and cut into quarters.
Peel and chop the garlic, mash it with salt, and add to the cooled sorrel.
Wash and finely chop the dill and chives, add to the soup, pour in the thick sour cream, mix thoroughly, and chill in the refrigerator.
Serve the chilled soup topped with the hard-boiled egg quarters.

name: Spiced mango salad with yogurt (Sałatka z mango)
summary: An aromatic ripe mango salad with toasted mustard seeds, ginger, chili, lemon zest, and plain yogurt.
steps: Peel the mango, separate the flesh from the stone, dice it, and toss in a bowl with freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the chili, ginger, and mustard seeds, and cook briefly until the mustard seeds begin to pop.
Add the lemon zest to the pan, stir well, and remove from the heat.
Pour the hot spiced oil over the diced mango, stir, and once cooled, fold in the plain yogurt and season with salt.

name: Malakoff Torte (Bomba Malakoff)
summary: A classic no-bake dessert made of layered sponge ladyfinger biscuits and rich custard buttercream, garnished with dried fruits and nuts.
steps: Cook the cream-flavoured pudding with the milk and set aside to cool completely.
Beat the softened butter with vanilla sugar until light and fluffy, then gradually incorporate the cooled pudding.
In a springform tin, alternate layers of sponge biscuits and custard buttercream, finishing with a dense layer of biscuits on top.
Cover the tin with cling film, weigh it down lightly, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours.
Before serving, garnish the top of the dessert with mixed nuts and dried fruits.

name: Bomba z kremem (Strawberry cream bombe)
summary: A chilled dessert dome lined with sponge roll slices and filled with a cream and egg-yolk custard with strawberries.
steps: Cut the sponge cake roll into slices and line the bottom and sides of a 2-litre bowl, setting aside some slices to cover the top.
Cut the strawberries into pieces and toss with a tablespoon of vanilla sugar.
Dissolve the instant gelatin in a little hot water, beat the egg yolks with half the powdered sugar, combine with the hot milk and dissolved gelatin, then refrigerate until slightly set.

Whip the whipping cream for the cream filling with the remaining icing sugar, gently fold into the setting custard along with the strawberries, spoon into the roll-lined bowl, and cover with the reserved roll slices.
Refrigerate the dessert for 2–3 hours until completely set.
Invert the bombe onto a serving platter, brush with warmed apricot jam, decorate with the whipping cream for the decoration whipped with vanilla sugar, and sprinkle with chopped hazelnuts.

name: Layered ladyfinger pudding cake
summary: A chilled, no-bake layered cake made with ladyfinger biscuits, chocolate and sweet-cream puddings, and fresh kiwi pieces.
steps: Line a deep round cake tin with aluminum foil and line the bottom and sides with ladyfinger biscuits.
Soak the gelatin in cold water, then warm gently until completely dissolved.
Cook the chocolate pudding with half the milk and half the sugar, blend with half the dissolved gelatin, pour over the biscuit base, and top with a radial layer of ladyfingers.
Cook the sweet-cream pudding with the remaining milk, sugar, and the vanillin sugar.
Stir the remaining gelatin and the diced kiwi into the warm cream pudding, spread over the ladyfingers, and chill in the refrigerator until set.

name: Sole with asparagus and strawberry sauce
summary: Sole roulades tied with leek and poached in white wine broth, served with asparagus, spinach, and a spicy strawberry-tabasco sauce.
steps: Roll the sole fillet into roulades, tie them with blanched leek strips, and simmer along with the asparagus in vegetable broth combined with white wine.
Finely chop the onion and garlic, cook in part of the butter until translucent, add the spinach, sauté, and season with salt and pepper.
Wash the strawberries, blend them, glaze in the remaining melted butter, and season with a dash of tabasco sauce.
Arrange the sautéed spinach, asparagus, and sole roulades on a plate, and drizzle everything with the strawberry sauce.

name: Zupa tajska ostra (Spicy Thai soup)
summary: A spicy and sour Thai-style soup with shrimp, oyster mushrooms, coconut milk, fresh ginger, coriander, and chili.
steps: Rinse and peel the shrimp, leaving the shell on the tail.
Cut the oyster mushrooms into strips, and finely chop the chili pepper and spring onion.
