Bring the water and coconut milk to a boil in a pot, add the ginger, coriander leaves, and oyster mushrooms, and reduce heat.
Pour in the lemon juice and fish sauce, add the chopped chili, spring onion, and shrimp, and boil everything together for a few minutes until the shrimp change colour.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

name: Pickled garlic in white wine vinegar and olive oil
summary: Fresh whole garlic cloves pickled in white wine vinegar with honey, olive oil, hot chili peppers, and whole spices.
steps: Peel the cloves of fresh garlic.
Bring the white wine vinegar to a boil in a pot with the honey, hot chili peppers, bay leaves, allspice, white peppercorns, mustard seeds, whole cloves, and salt.
Add the peeled garlic to the boiling brine and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the garlic and chili peppers, drain, and place in a sterilized jar.
Bring the pickling liquid back to a boil, pour it along with the olive oil into the jar, seal immediately and tightly, and store in a cool place.

name: Kolorowa papryka (pickled mixed bell peppers)
summary: Red, yellow, and green bell peppers pickled in jars in a spiced vinegar brine with tarragon and nutmeg.

ingredients.name: mixed red, yellow, and green bell peppers

steps: Wash the peppers, blanch them briefly in boiling water, then rinse with cold water.
Remove the seeds, slice the peppers into fairly wide strips, and pack them in layers into jars.
Bring 250 ml of water to a boil with 250 ml of vinegar, the tarragon, grated nutmeg, allspice berries, cloves, mustard seeds, peppercorns, salt, and sugar.
Pour the boiling brine over the peppers, seal the jars tightly, and pasteurise for about 20 minutes.

name: Zrazy cielęce (veal roulades)
summary: Tender veal roulades wrapped with a slice of ham and fresh sage, browned until golden and braised in dry white wine.
steps: Wash and pat dry the veal, cut into 6 cutlets, pound lightly, sprinkle with lemon juice, season with salt, and dust lightly with flour.
Place a slice of ham on each cutlet, sprinkle with sage, roll up tightly, secure with white kitchen twine or toothpicks, and dredge in flour.
Brown the roulades in heated margarine on all sides until golden.
Transfer the roulades to a saucepan, pour over the pan drippings, add the white wine, and simmer covered over low heat for about 20 minutes.
Serve with fries or pasta and braised carrots.

name: Nalewka Smocza Krew (Dragon's Blood raspberry liqueur)
summary: A homemade sweet raspberry liqueur made with rectified spirit, macerated from fresh blended fruit and aged for months.
steps: Sort the raspberries, blend them, mix thoroughly with the sugar, and transfer the fruit puree to a large jar.
Cover the jar with cheesecloth and leave in a sunny spot for 2 days.
Pour in the rectified spirit, stir thoroughly, seal the jar, and after 3 days strain the liquid from the fruit.
Set the liquid aside for a week until the sediment settles to the bottom, then carefully filter the liqueur through a coffee filter.
Pour the clear liqueur into bottles, seal tightly, and age in a dark place for about 6 months.

name: Pilaw z pęczaku (pearl barley pilaf with vegetables and walnuts)
summary: Vegetarian Polish pearl barley pilaf simmered with broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, chili pepper, and toasted walnuts.
steps: Rinse the pearl barley, chop the onion and cook until translucent in hot oil in a saucepan, then add the barley and sauté together for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in a litre of boiling water, add the vegetable seasoning, and simmer covered for about 30 minutes until the barley is tender.
Blanch the cauliflower and broccoli florets for 3 minutes in salted boiling water and drain thoroughly.
Grate the carrot, and slice the seeded chili pepper into thin strips.
Add the prepared vegetables to the barley, cook together for 10 minutes, and season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet and scatter them over the dish before serving.

name: Zucchini à la caprese
summary: Crisp batter-fried zucchini slices layered with sauteed garlic tomatoes and fresh basil leaves.
steps: Wash the zucchini, trim the ends and slice into rounds about 0.5 cm thick, season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, and rub with half of the crushed garlic.
Whisk the flour with water, the egg, and a pinch of salt to form a smooth batter with the consistency of heavy cream.
Dip the zucchini slices into the batter and fry in well-heated sunflower oil until golden on both sides.
Slice the tomatoes, add the remaining crushed garlic, and fry briefly in the pan.
Layer the fried zucchini slices alternately with the tomatoes on a platter and garnish with fresh basil leaves.

name: Florentine meatballs
summary: Pork and bacon meatballs seasoned with sage and rosemary, braised with grated root vegetables in white wine and lemon juice.
steps: Grind the pork, smoked bacon, and onions in a meat grinder, add chopped sage, ground rosemary, eggs, salt, and pepper, mix thoroughly, and set aside for 30 minutes.
Peel the carrots, parsley root, and celeriac, then grate on a coarse grater.
Melt the margarine in a saucepan, add the grated vegetables, and brown over high heat, then reduce the heat, add salt, basil, and dry white wine, and simmer covered for a few minutes.
With damp hands, shape the meat mixture into small meatballs, dredge in plain flour, and fry in hot oil until golden.
Transfer the browned meatballs to the saucepan with vegetables and simmer together covered for about 30 minutes.
Toward the end of braising, season with a pinch of sugar and lemon juice, stir gently, and sprinkle with chopped parsley leaves.

name: Galaretka pikantna (savory apple and herb jelly)
summary: A sweet-and-sour jelly made from tart apples, wine vinegar, and fresh sage, basil, and mint, served with meats and pâtés.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: approx. 200 g (250 ml by volume) per 250 ml of strained juice

steps: Wash and dry the apples, cut into quarters, and core them.
Transfer the apples to a large pot, add the basil, mint, and 2 tablespoons of sage, then pour in the water and wine vinegar.
Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the apples break down completely.
Transfer the pulp to a jelly bag suspended over a pot and leave overnight to strain naturally without squeezing.
Measure the strained juice, add 200 g of sugar for every 250 ml of juice, and simmer for about 30 minutes, stirring and skimming off foam.
Toward the end of boiling, stir in the remaining tablespoon of sage.
Ladle the hot jelly into sterilised small jars, seal tightly, and leave to cool under a towel.

name: Kaczka po włosku (Italian-style braised duck with oranges and sage)
summary: Duck braised in white wine and broth with fresh oranges and sage.
steps: Wash the dressed young duck, portion into serving pieces, and rub with black pepper.
Scrub the oranges, blanch in boiling water, peel thin strips of zest with a sharp knife, then peel the fruit, remove seeds, and dice the flesh.
Peel the onion and chop it finely.
Heat olive oil in a wide shallow pan, brown the duck pieces until golden, add onion, sage, and orange zest, then season with salt and pepper.
Pour in the dry white wine and cook uncovered over high heat for a few minutes, then pour in the broth, cover, and simmer over low heat for about 60 minutes.
Transfer the tender duck to an ovenproof platter, blend or sieve the sauce, add sugar and diced orange flesh, and heat until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the orange sauce over the duck and bake for a few minutes in a preheated oven.

name: Kolorowa sałatka warzywna (colourful vegetable salad with creamy dressing)
summary: A vibrant fresh salad of radishes, tomatoes, courgette, kohlrabi, and peppers tossed in a creamy mustard-sour cream dressing.
steps: Wash and dry all the vegetables, cut the radishes into rounds, finely dice the tomatoes, and slice the courgette into matchsticks.
Halve the red bell peppers, remove the seeds, and slice the flesh into thin strips, then grate the peeled kohlrabi on a coarse grater.
Finely chop the chives and dill, and toss them in a bowl with the chopped vegetables and cress.
Whisk together the sour cream, vinegar, and mustard, season with salt and pepper, then gradually pour in the oil, whisking until a thick, creamy dressing forms.
Pour the dressing over the salad, toss thoroughly, and set aside for about 10 minutes before serving.

name: Kasza trzebiatowska po rycersku (Trzebiatów knight-style barley with pork and pork belly)
summary: Barley groats cooked in curry broth, served with braised pork belly, minced pork, and tomatoes.
steps: Cook the broth vegetables in water, pour the broth over the barley groats in a large pot at a 1:3 ratio, add curry powder, and cook until the grains are separate.
Dice the raw pork belly and fry in melted lard until golden.
Add finely chopped onion, and after 2–3 minutes add the minced pork and fry together for about 15 minutes.
Add coarsely diced canned tomatoes, season with salt and white pepper, and stir well.
Combine the skillet contents into the pot with hot cooked barley, mix thoroughly, and let rest covered for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Rolmopsy z musztardą (rollmops with mustard)
summary: Rolled matjes herring fillets spread with hard-boiled egg, honey mustard, and olive oil paste, garnished with olives.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool, and peel, reserving a few wedges for garnish, then mash the rest with olive oil and honey mustard, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Spread the prepared egg-mustard paste onto the matjes herring fillets and cut each lengthwise in half.
Roll up eight rolls and arrange them on a serving platter.
Garnish the rollmops with reserved egg wedges, olive slices, and parsley leaves.

name: Kotopita (Greek chicken phyllo pie)
summary: Greek savoury pie of shredded poached chicken, firm cheese, eggs, and parsley layered between crisp sheets of buttered phyllo pastry.
steps: Place the chicken in a pot, pour over 1 l of salted water, add the sliced onion, and simmer until the meat is tender.
Remove the cooked chicken, reserving the broth and onion. Skin and bone the chicken, and shred or dice the meat finely.
Beat the eggs and mix with the grated firm cheese, chopped parsley, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken pieces along with the broth and cooked onion, stirring into a cohesive filling.

Divide the phyllo pastry into two portions. Line a buttered baking dish with half of the sheets, brushing each sheet with melted butter, spread the chicken filling over, and top with the second portion of phyllo sheets brushed with butter.
Bake for 60 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Fajitas
summary: Sizzling skillet-grilled strips of marinated beef or chicken cooked with bell peppers and onions, served with warm tortillas and dips.
steps: Cut the meat and red bell pepper into thin strips, and slice the onion into thick wedges.
Mix the oil with the garlic, marjoram, cumin, hot paprika, and black pepper.
Toss the meat in the marinade and let sit for about 40 minutes.
Heat a grill pan and sear the meat together with the bell pepper and onion for 6–9 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Serve with warm flour tortillas, sprinkled with grated cheese, alongside guacamole, sour cream, and salsa.

name: Napa cabbage salad with walnuts and raisins (Sałatka z kapusty pekińskiej i orzechów)
summary: A crunchy napa cabbage salad with walnuts, raisins, and pickled garlic in a mayonnaise and sour cream dressing.
steps: Whisk together the mayonnaise, sour cream, and finely chopped pickled garlic.
Wash and finely shred the napa cabbage, toss it with the dressing, and set aside for 30 minutes.
Chop the walnuts, add them to the salad along with the raisins, and mix thoroughly before serving.

name: Aphrodite's Smile (Uśmiech Afrodyty)
summary: A chilled yogurt dessert with honey, cinnamon, and toasted almonds, topped with dark chocolate shavings.
steps: Chop the almonds and toast them gently in a dry frying pan.
Mix the plain yogurt with the honey, cinnamon, and toasted almonds.
Spoon the mixture into dessert glasses and refrigerate for 60 minutes.
Grate the dark chocolate into shavings and sprinkle over the chilled dessert before serving.

name: Minced pork curry with apples
summary: A quick one-pot ground pork dish braised with root vegetables, apples, raisins, curry powder, and cinnamon.
steps: Peel the carrots, parsley root, celeriac, onion, and apples, then cut into thin matchsticks or grate coarsely.
Brown the ground pork in hot olive oil, then add the prepared vegetables and apples.
Pour in the broth, stir in the curry powder, and simmer for about 10 minutes until the vegetables soften.
Add the raisins and ground cinnamon, then simmer for another 5 minutes.

name: Ryba gotowana (poached fish with egg and herbs)
summary: Fish poached in vegetable broth with onion, served with chopped hard-boiled eggs, fresh herbs, cold butter, and lemon.
steps: Place the cleaned fish and sliced onion into the salted vegetable broth and simmer gently for about 20 minutes.
Carefully transfer the fish with a slotted spoon to a platter and arrange the cooked onion beside it.
Hard-boil the eggs, cool, peel, and chop very finely.
Sprinkle the hot fish with chopped egg and fresh herbs, and top each portion with a pat of cold butter and a lemon slice.

name: Ryż po chińsku (Chinese stir-fried beef and rice)
summary: Rice with beef strips marinated in soy sauce, white wine and egg white, briefly stir-fried in a wok and served with napa cabbage.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: half for marinade, half for stir-frying

ingredients.name: dry white wine
ingredients.note: half for marinade, half for stir-frying

steps: Rinse the rice, bring it to a boil in salted water, then wrap the pot in a blanket and leave for 240 minutes to swell.
Slice the beef into thin strips, and finely chop the spring onions with their greens, the garlic, and peeled ginger.
Mix the sugar, half the soy sauce, half the white wine, the potato starch, and the egg white, coat the beef strips in the marinade, and set aside for 15 minutes.

Heat the oil in a pan or wok, toss in the garlic and spring onions, add the marinated beef along with the marinade and chopped ginger, and stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes, stirring continuously.
Pour in the remaining white wine and the rest of the soy sauce, and stir briefly.
Combine the stir-fried beef with the cooked rice, season with salt and pepper, and top with the shredded napa cabbage leaves.

name: Kotlety chlebowe (bread and onion patties)
summary: Vegetarian patties made from stale white bread soaked in milk, combined with onions, parsley, and toasted sunflower seeds.
steps: Slice the stale white bread and soak it in 750 ml of milk.
Squeeze out the soaked bread and mince it through a grinder along with the peeled onions.
Toast the sunflower seeds in a dry pan and finely chop the parsley.
Add the eggs, sunflower seeds, and 2 tbsp of chopped parsley to the bread mixture, season with salt and freshly ground pepper, mix thoroughly, and shape into patties.
Fry the patties in well-heated oil on both sides until golden brown, then drain excess fat.

name: Ciasteczka różane (Polish rose petal shortbread cookies)
summary: Buttery Polish shortbread cookies studded with chopped almonds, sprinkled with rose water, and sandwiching fragrant rose petal preserve.
steps: Cream the butter with a mixer, then beat in the egg yolks, sugar, chopped almonds, plain flour, and baking powder, kneading into a smooth dough.
Roll out the dough on a pastry board and cut out cookies.
Bake for about 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 170 °C.
After removing from the oven, sprinkle the cookies with rose water, sandwich with rose petal preserve, and dust with icing sugar.

name: Turkey and baby corn skewers (Szaszłyki z indyka i kukurydzy)
summary: Baked skewers of turkey breast fillets, pork belly, baby corn, button mushrooms, red onion, and bell pepper in a thyme marinade.
steps: Cut the turkey breast fillet into cubes.
Mix the wine vinegar with oil, thyme, salt, and pepper, pour over the meat, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Clean the button mushrooms, peel the red onions and halve them lengthwise, halve the baby corn cobs, and cut the pork belly and red bell pepper into chunks.
Thread alternately turkey, bell pepper, pork belly, onion, mushrooms, and corn onto skewers, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and bake for about 20 minutes, turning occasionally.

name: Kolorowe ciasteczka (colourful candy butter cookies)
summary: Crumbly butter cookies decorated with colourful chocolate dragées or tinted icing.

ingredients.name: colourful chocolate dragées
ingredients.note: or icing with natural food colouring

steps: Beat the softened butter with the sugar using a mixer until light and fluffy.
Add the plain flour and baking powder, and knead by hand into a uniform dough.
Shape the dough into 14 balls and arrange them well-spaced on a baking sheet without flattening them.
Decorate the tops of the dough balls with colourful chocolate dragées before baking, or with icing towards the end of baking.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for 11–12 minutes.
Wait a moment after removing from the oven, then transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Ryż po meksykańsku (Mexican-style rice with stewing meat and beans)
summary: A spicy one-pot dish of braised stewing meat with rice, bell pepper, garlic, tomato paste, sweetcorn, and red kidney beans.
steps: Dice the stewing meat finely, brown it in hot cooking fat, and season generously with salt, pepper, sweet paprika and hot paprika.
Wash the bell pepper, remove the seeds, and dice the flesh; press the peeled garlic through a garlic press.
Once the meat has browned and softened slightly, add water, tomato paste, diced bell pepper, garlic, and the uncooked rice.
Simmer everything gently over low heat until the rice is almost tender, then stir in the drained sweetcorn and red kidney beans, and heat through for a few minutes.
Sprinkle the finished dish with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Cold green herb soup (Zielony chłodnik)
summary: A refreshing chilled soup of plain yogurt with radishes, cucumber, sorrel, garlic, and fresh herbs, served with homemade crusty roll croutons.
steps: Wash the radishes and cut into half-slices, and peel and finely dice the cucumber.
Rinse the sorrel thoroughly, remove the stems, and finely chop the leaves together with chives, dill, and parsley leaves.
Whisk the yogurt with mineral water, add the chopped vegetables and greens, and season with soy sauce, salt, pepper, and crushed garlic.
Place the soup in the refrigerator to chill.
Dice the Kaiser rolls, fry in hot oil until golden, and serve the croutons with the chilled soup.

name: Pork braised in beer with caraway (Wieprzowina z piwem)
summary: Strips of pork braised with onion and caraway in a beer sauce thickened with grated wholemeal bread.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to top up the gravy if needed

steps: Rinse and pat dry the pork, cut into thin strips, brown in the hot lard or oil, and transfer to a pot.
Peel and chop the onion, cook until translucent in the fat left from frying the meat, and transfer to the pot.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, pour over the beer and top up with water if needed, then cover and braise until tender.
Add the grated dry bread, stir, and simmer for another 3–5 minutes until the sauce thickens.

name: Zupa ryżowa (Polish rice and vegetable soup)
summary: Home-style rice soup cooked in pork bone broth with Polish soup vegetables and potatoes, enriched with beaten egg, sour cream, and lemon juice.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to make the broth and beat the egg

steps: Place the pork bones into a pot, cover with water, add the bay leaf, peeled onion, and salt, and simmer the broth for about 60 minutes.
Clean and cut the carrot, parsley roots, celeriac, and potatoes, then add them to the broth.
Bring the soup to a boil, stir in the rice, and simmer over low heat until the rice and vegetables are tender (you may remove and discard the cooked onion).
Season the soup with lemon juice, then pour in the egg beaten with a little water, stirring vigorously.
Thicken the soup with the flour mixed into the sour cream, bring briefly to a boil, ladle into soup plates, and garnish with chopped parsley.

name: Chrzanica (Polish Podhale horseradish soup)
summary: A highland horseradish soup made with a broth of smoked pork belly, kiełbasa, and smoked meat, enriched with sour cream and served with hard-boiled eggs.
steps: Bring water to a boil in a pot with the smoked pork belly, kiełbasa, and smoked highland pork, simmer until the meats are tender, then remove them from the broth.
Whisk the thick sour cream with plain flour, stir into the broth, and simmer until the soup thickens.
Add the grated horseradish and lemon juice, then season the soup to taste with salt and black pepper.
Dice the cooked pork belly, kiełbasa, and smoked pork, and return them to the soup.
Hard-boil the eggs, peel them, and serve in the hot chrzanica.

name: Zupa z zielonego groszku (green pea soup)
summary: A simple puréed green pea and sautéed onion soup, served with a garlic yogurt sauce and soup pearls (choux puffs).
steps: Cook the green peas until tender in 375 ml (1.5 szklanki) of water.
Peel the onions, chop and lightly fry in the heated fat, then blend together with the cooked peas and cooking liquid, and season with salt and black pepper.
Mix the plain yogurt thoroughly with the crushed garlic cloves, and salt and black pepper to taste.
Ladle the soup into bowls, garnish with the garlic yogurt sauce, and sprinkle with soup pearls.

name: Ryba w pomidorach (baked fish with tomatoes)
summary: Fish portions rubbed with paprika, flour, and oil, baked under thick slices of fresh tomatoes and parsley leaves.

ingredients.name: cooking oil
ingredients.note: half to rub the fish, half for drizzling

steps: Clean, gut, and rinse the fish, then divide into portions and season with salt.
Mix 1 tablespoon of oil with the flour and sweet paprika, and rub the resulting paste over the fish pieces.
Arrange the fish on a baking sheet and top with thick slices of fresh tomatoes.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley leaves, drizzle with the remaining tablespoon of oil, lightly salt, and bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 25 minutes.

name: Baked giant beans (Zapiekanka z fasolą / Gigantes plaki)
summary: Giant white beans baked under a layer of onions, tomatoes, garlic, parsley leaves, and thyme braised in olive oil.
steps: Soak the beans overnight in water, and the next day boil them (in the original recipe for 10 minutes; culinary note: dry giant white beans should be cooked until tender, approx. 60 minutes, before baking to break down lectins).
Heat olive oil in a large skillet, add the thick-sliced onion, chopped tomatoes, and crushed garlic, fry, sprinkle with chopped parsley, and season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the drained beans to a buttered baking dish, sprinkle with thyme, and cover with the fried vegetables along with the olive oil.
Bake for 30 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C and serve with crusty white bread.

name: Galaretka mleczno-migdałowa (almond blancmange jelly)
summary: A delicate Polish milk and almond gelatin jelly made with crushed sweet and bitter almonds.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: boiled and cooled, for grinding almonds and softening gelatin

steps: Blanch the sweet and bitter almonds, peel off their skins, and pound finely in a mortar or bowl.
Grind the crushed almonds, adding cooled water a few drops at a time, until a thick paste forms.
Bring the milk to a boil and slowly pour it hot into the almond paste, stirring in the sugar continuously.
Soften the gelatin in the remaining water, dissolve it completely, and combine with the warm almond milk.
Refrigerate the mixture, and as soon as it begins to set, ladle into dessert bowls and chill until completely set.

name: Rolada serowa (cheese roulade)
summary: Cold firm cheese roulade rolled with a creamy butter-cheese spread packed with ham, hard-boiled egg, carrot, and green peas.
steps: Beat the softened butter with the processed cheese until smooth and stir in the chopped parsley leaves.
Boil the carrots and eggs until hard-boiled, cool, peel, and dice finely along with the ham, then fold into the butter-cheese mixture with the drained peas, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Place the piece of firm cheese into a sealed plastic bag and submerge in boiling water, turning until the cheese softens.
Remove the warm cheese from the bag and roll it out into a rectangle about 1 cm thick.
Spread the prepared filling over the cheese sheet, roll tightly into a log, wrap in aluminium foil, and chill in the refrigerator for about 2 hours before slicing.

name: Date and fig muffins
summary: Homemade muffins studded with chopped dried figs and dates, sprinkled with sugar before baking.
steps: Finely chop the dried figs and dried dates, and preheat the oven to 210 °C.
Melt the butter and let it cool, and whisk the eggs with the milk.
Sift the wheat flour into a bowl and mix with the chopped fruit, 3 tablespoons of sugar, the vanilla sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Pour the egg and milk mixture along with the melted butter into the dry ingredients and stir into a uniform batter.
Spoon the batter into a buttered or paper-lined muffin tin to 3/4 of its height, sprinkle with the remaining tablespoon of sugar, and bake for about 25 minutes at 210 °C, then let cool.

name: Zupa leśna (Polish forest mushroom soup)
summary: A thick, aromatic wild mushroom soup made with fresh bay boletes and potatoes simmered in a caraway and bay leaf spice broth, enriched with milk, sour cream, and egg yolks.
steps: Clean and slice the bay boletes, and peel and dice the potatoes.
Boil 500 ml of water with the bay leaves, allspice, black peppercorns, and ground caraway, then strain the spiced broth.
Place the potatoes and mushrooms in a saucepan, pour the strained spiced broth over them, and cook over low heat until tender.
Whisk the flour into the milk, blend with the sour cream, slowly pour into the soup, and simmer until thickened.
Salt the soup and season with pepper to taste, then add the egg yolks, quickly whisk them into the soup, and remove the saucepan from the heat just as it starts to simmer.
Sprinkle the soup with chopped dill and serve with croutons or rye bread.

name: Ice cream cheesecake (Sernik lodowy)
summary: A no-bake cheesecake on a sponge cake base soaked in lemon and vodka punch, topped with fruit and scoops of ice cream.

ingredients.name: canned peaches in syrup
ingredients.note: can, half for the filling and half for garnish

steps: Place the sponge cake base into the bottom of a springform tin and soak it with a punch made from about 330 ml of water, lemon juice, and vodka.
Pass the farmer's cheese through a mincer three times, then cream it with the icing sugar and plain yogurt or cream.
Dissolve the gelatine in a small amount of boiling water, allow to cool, and mix into the cheese mixture along with the raisins and half of the diced peaches.
Pour the setting cheese mixture over the sponge base and refrigerate until completely firm.
Slice the pears, banana, and remaining peaches, and arrange them over the chilled cheesecake along with scoops of ice cream just before serving.

name: Baked pears with nuts in raspberry wine sauce
summary: Baked pears stuffed with almonds, raisins, and honey, served with a sauce of white wine and raspberry juice.
steps: Chop the raisins, combine with the chopped almonds and honey, and season with ginger.
Core the pears from the bottom, peel them, sprinkle with lemon juice, fill with the nut mixture, and arrange in a baking dish.
Mix the raspberry juice with the white wine and pour over the pears.
Bake for 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C and serve warm.

name: Green bean salad (Sałatka z fasolki szparagowej)
summary: Tender cooked green beans tossed with finely chopped onion, vegetable oil, and fragrant tarragon vinegar.
steps: Rinse the green beans, trim the ends, remove any strings, and cut the pods into bite-sized lengths.
Cook the beans in salted boiling water until tender, drain in a colander, and let cool completely.
Drizzle the cooled beans with tarragon vinegar and oil, add the chopped onion, season with salt and pepper, and toss thoroughly.
Chill the salad in the refrigerator before serving.

name: Poznański budyń orzechowy (Poznań baked walnut pudding)
summary: Baked Polish egg-and-walnut dessert made with finely chopped walnuts, breadcrumbs, and whipped egg whites.
steps: Separate the egg yolks from the whites, beat the yolks with the sugar until pale and fluffy, then gradually stir in the finely chopped walnuts.
Whip the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into the walnut mixture one spoonful at a time.
Add the sifted breadcrumbs and fold gently but thoroughly.
Transfer the mixture into a buttered baking dish and bake for 40 minutes in an oven preheated to 150 °C.

name: Sałatka italiana (Italian pasta and vegetable salad)
summary: A colourful pasta salad with tomatoes, cucumber, and sweetcorn tossed in a fresh herbal dressing of olive oil, dill, parsley, and lemon balm.
steps: Cook the pasta al dente, drain, and let cool, and drain the canned sweetcorn.
Wash the tomatoes and cucumber, slice them, and gently combine with the pasta and sweetcorn.

Mix the instant broth powder with a little water into a thick paste, transfer to a screw-top jar, add the olive oil and 2 tablespoons of water, along with the finely chopped dill, parsley, lemon balm, salt, and pepper.
Screw the lid tightly onto the jar and shake vigorously until the dressing is thoroughly combined.
Pour the dressing over the salad, toss gently, and chill in a cool place for about 30 minutes.

name: Gofry z sera białego (quark waffles)
summary: Fluffy Polish curd cheese waffles made with quark, honey, butter, cinnamon, and fresh lemon zest.
steps: Separate the egg yolks from the whites, grate the zest from the lemon, and squeeze out its juice.
Cream the butter with the honey and egg yolks until fluffy.
Continuing to beat, gradually add the quark, lemon zest and juice, cinnamon, and flour mixed with baking powder.
Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold them into the batter.
Use a large spoon to portion the batter onto a preheated waffle maker and cook until golden brown.

name: Greek salad with mint
summary: A fresh salad of tomatoes, cucumbers, green bell pepper, onions, black olives, and feta cheese with fresh mint.
steps: Wash the tomatoes and cucumbers and slice them into rounds.
Peel the onions and slice into rings; wash, core, and slice the green bell pepper into strips.
Dice the feta cheese into cubes and rinse the fresh mint leaves.
Gently toss the vegetables with the black olives, feta cheese, and mint leaves, then drizzle the salad with the vinaigrette.

name: Zupa szpinakowa (Spinach soup with chicken and cinnamon)
summary: A spinach soup with finely chopped chicken and a hint of cinnamon, thickened with finely ground corn flour.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: half a glass, for mixing with the corn flour

steps: Wash the fresh spinach and finely chop or blend it (if using frozen, thaw and blend into a purée).
Heat the broth in a deep saucepan, add the finely chopped chicken, and bring to a boil.
Add the spinach, crumbled stock cube, and cinnamon stick, stir well, and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Mix the corn flour with 125 ml (half a glass) of water to make a smooth slurry, pour into the soup, and stir until thickened.
Remove the cinnamon stick and season the soup to taste with salt and pepper.

name: Baked turkey breast in orange-cheese sauce (Pierś indyka z serem)
summary: Tender turkey breast cutlets baked under a creamy béchamel-sour cream cheese sauce infused with orange liqueur and juice.
steps: Dredge the turkey breast slices in 50 g of wheat flour mixed with salt, brown on both sides in a tablespoon of butter, and transfer to a baking dish.
Make a roux from the remaining butter and 3 tablespoons of wheat flour, whisk in the milk, and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Pour the orange liqueur and orange juice into the sauce, stir in most of the grated cheese, and heat, stirring until the cheese has melted.
Remove the sauce from the heat, stir in the sour cream, pour over the cutlets in the dish, scatter with the remaining cheese, and bake for 10 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Mixed green salad with fresh herbs (Sałaty w ziołach)
summary: A mixture of crisp lettuces with fresh cucumber, radishes, and colourful bell peppers in a mustard and herb vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: mixed salad greens
ingredients.note: half head each of several varieties

steps: Rinse and pat dry the salad greens, tear large leaves into bite-sized pieces, and arrange them in a salad bowl.
Finely chop the parsley leaves, basil, tarragon, and thyme.
Whisk the wine vinegar with mustard, olive oil, salt, and pepper, stir in the chopped herbs, and drizzle the dressing over the salad greens.
Peel and slice the cucumber, quarter the radishes, and cut the seeded bell pepper halves into thin strips.
Scatter the sliced vegetables over the dressed salad leaves and serve immediately.

name: Chilled lemon mousse
summary: An airy lemon dessert made with beaten egg yolks, whipped cream, and beaten egg whites, set with gelatin.
steps: Separate the egg whites from the yolks. Beat the yolks with the sugar and vanilla sugar until pale and thick.
Scald the lemon with boiling water, finely grate the zest and squeeze the juice, then add both to the beaten yolks.
Dissolve the gelatin in a small amount of hot water, allow to cool slightly, and stir into the yolk mixture.
In separate bowls, whip the egg whites until stiff and whip the cream, then gently fold both into the lemon mixture.
Spoon the mousse into dessert dishes and refrigerate until set.

name: Baked zucchini with tomatoes and oscypek cheese
summary: Lightly fried zucchini slices baked with garlic olive oil, fresh basil, tomatoes, and smoked oscypek cheese.
steps: Cut the oscypek into thin slices, and blanch the tomatoes in boiling water, peel and slice them.
Wash the zucchini, slice into rounds about 1 cm thick, sprinkle with salt, set aside for 15 minutes, and then fry briefly.
Crush the peeled garlic cloves through a press and stir with the olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Arrange the zucchini slices in a baking dish, brush with the garlic oil, and layer the chopped fresh basil, tomato slices, and oscypek on top.
Bake for about 10 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.

name: Kluski orzechowe (baked dumplings with walnuts)
summary: Butter-baked dumplings made from wheat and soy flour, served sprinkled with finely chopped walnuts.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for the dough, plus 1.5 l for boiling

steps: Bring 1.5 l of salted water to a boil in a pot.
Sift the plain flour onto a pastry board, add the egg, soy flour, and 100 ml of water, and knead into a fairly soft dough.
Cut small dumplings from the dough, drop them into the salted boiling water, cook for several minutes over low heat, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Grease an ovenproof dish with a generous layer of butter, transfer the cooked dumplings into it, and bake briefly in the oven.
Serve the dumplings hot, sprinkled with the finely chopped walnuts.

name: Spanish tomato salad
summary: Salad of peeled tomatoes with a dressing of hot mustard, vinegar, olive oil, and tarragon.
steps: Blanch the tomatoes, remove the skins, and dice them.
Rub the bottom of a salad bowl with a halved garlic clove, arrange the tomatoes in it, season with salt and white pepper, and sprinkle with chopped parsley leaves.
Whisk the mustard with the vinegar, olive oil, and tarragon, pour the dressing over the tomatoes, toss well, and chill in the refrigerator before serving.

name: Kaszanka smażona (fried Polish blood sausage with apples and oscypek).
summary: Crispy slices of Polish blood sausage baked with apples, onions, fresh marjoram, and smoked oscypek cheese.

ingredients.name: oscypek (smoked sheep cheese) or firm cheese

steps: Peel casing from the kaszanka, slice into rounds, and fry in 2 tablespoons of oil until crispy.
Wash the apples, cut into eighths, and fry in another 2 tablespoons of oil until golden.
Peel the onions, slice them, and sauté in the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil.
Arrange the apples at the bottom of a baking dish, cover with the sautéed onions and chopped fresh marjoram.
Layer the slices of kaszanka on top, sprinkle with grated oscypek or firm cheese, and bake for 15–20 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C.

name: Cucumber and daikon radish salad (Sałatka z ogórków i białej rzodkwi)
summary: A light Asian-style raw cucumber and daikon salad with a sweet and spicy light soy sauce and rice vinegar dressing.
steps: Peel the daikon radish and cucumber, then grate coarsely or julienne into long, thin matchsticks.
Whisk the light soy sauce with the rice vinegar, sugar, and a generous pinch of chili powder until the sugar dissolves.
Mound the shredded vegetables into a high pyramid on a plate and drizzle with the prepared dressing.

name: Crystal strawberry sorbet
summary: A frozen dessert made of strawberries blended with sour cherry juice, sugar, and crushed ice, garnished with lemon balm.
steps: Rinse, dry, and hull the strawberries, then arrange them on a tray and place in the freezer for about 30 minutes.
Transfer the semi-frozen strawberries to a blender, add the sour cherry juice, sugar, and crushed ice, and blend.
Return the mixture to the freezer for 30 minutes, then blend again upon removing.
Spoon the sorbet into dessert cups and garnish with lemon balm leaves.

name: Chicken in curry yogurt marinade
summary: Chicken breast pieces marinated and braised in a fragrant sauce of plain yogurt, sautéed onions, garlic, and curry powder.
steps: Peel and finely dice the onions and garlic, sauté in hot oil, and set aside to cool.
Mix the cooled onion and garlic with the plain yogurt, curry powder, and salt.
Cut the chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces, submerge in the yogurt marinade, and set aside for at least 30 minutes.
Transfer the marinated chicken along with all the marinade into a pot and braise covered over low heat until the meat is tender.

name: Kalafior zapiekany z serem (baked cauliflower with cheese and breadcrumbs)
summary: Cauliflower florets baked with hard or semi-hard cheese, butter, and nutmeg-spiced breadcrumbs, finished with dill.
steps: Cook the cauliflower until tender-crisp in water with salt, sugar, and lemon juice, then drain and separate into florets.
Arrange the cauliflower florets in a baking dish and drizzle with melted butter.
Sprinkle the cauliflower with grated hard or semi-hard cheese and breadcrumbs mixed with nutmeg.
Place the dish in a preheated oven and bake until the cheese melts and the breadcrumbs turn golden.
Before serving, sprinkle the dish with chopped dill.

name: Bananas in Honey-Orange Sauce
summary: A quick dessert of warm bananas in a sauce of orange juice, honey, and butter, served with whipped cream.
steps: Combine the butter, freshly squeezed orange juice, and honey in a microwave-safe dish, microwave for about 2 minutes, and stir thoroughly.
Peel the bananas, slice them in half lengthwise, place in the prepared sauce, and turn to coat.
Microwave the bananas in the sauce for about 4 minutes, then serve with whipped cream.

name: Batter-fried eggs
summary: Medium-boiled egg halves coated in a fluffy batter with beaten egg whites and fried until golden.
steps: Whisk the milk with part of the plain flour and a pinch of salt to form a batter slightly thicker than pancake batter.
Beat the egg whites with the sugar until stiff peaks form, then gently fold into the batter.
Cook the whole eggs to medium-hard, peel them, cut them into halves, and season with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the egg halves in the remaining flour, dip them in the batter, and fry in hot fat until golden brown.

name: Sałatka szparagowa (asparagus salad with parsley dressing)
summary: A simple and light salad of tender boiled asparagus drizzled with an oil, vinegar, and fresh parsley dressing.
steps: Trim the asparagus, tie the spears into a bunch with kitchen twine, and cook standing upright in a tall pot of boiling water.
Drain the cooked asparagus, remove the twine, and cut the stalks into smaller pieces.
Finely chop the parsley and mix it with the vinegar diluted with a splash of water, sugar, salt, and oil.
Pour the prepared dressing over the asparagus and place the salad in the refrigerator to chill.

name: Boczek pieczony (Polish roasted pork belly with cracklings)
summary: Lean pork belly marinated with crushed garlic, marjoram, and paprika, roasted until tender with cracklings and golden onions.
steps: Peel the garlic and mash it into a paste with the salt.
Rinse the pork belly, cut off a slice about 1 cm thick, and rub the remaining roast with the garlic paste, then season with marjoram, pepper, and ground paprika.
Wrap the seasoned pork belly in cling film and chill in a cool place for about 2 hours.
Place the meat in a roasting pan, dice the reserved pork belly slice, render in a skillet until crisp cracklings form, and pour the hot fat over the roast.
Roast the pork belly for about 45 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.
Peel the onions, cut them into wedges, add to the roasting pan, and roast everything for another 15 minutes, then serve the pork topped with onions and cracklings.

name: Rydze panierowane (breaded saffron milk caps)
summary: Saffron milk cap mushroom caps breaded in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs, pan-fried in lard until golden and served piping hot with fresh dill.
steps: Clean the saffron milk caps, cut off the stems, gently rinse the caps under running water, dry thoroughly, and dust with plain flour.
Beat the eggs with a fork in a shallow bowl and season with salt.
Dip the mushroom caps into the beaten egg, then dredge them in the sifted breadcrumbs.
Fry the breaded mushrooms on both sides in well-heated lard until golden brown.
Before serving, dust the piping-hot saffron milk caps with freshly ground pepper and sprinkle with chopped dill.

name: Warm turkey salad with tender vegetables
summary: Sautéed turkey breast strips served over crisp lettuce with parboiled carrots, kohlrabi, and green beans in a lemon-herb yogurt dressing.
steps: Wash and peel the carrots and kohlrabi, trim the green beans, chop the vegetables into bite-sized pieces, and cook in salted boiling water for about 3 minutes, then drain and cool.
Cut the turkey breast into thin strips, sear in heated oil, and season with salt and black pepper.
Whisk the plain yogurt with the lemon juice and chopped parsley leaves, and season with salt and black pepper.
Arrange the washed lettuce leaves on a platter, top with the cooled vegetables and turkey strips, and drizzle with the yogurt dressing.

name: Zraziki z rusztu (grilled minced meat and kiełbasa rolls)
summary: Oblong grilled meat rolls made from minced meat combined with finely chopped Polish sausage, garlic, onion, and parsley leaves.

ingredients.name: onions
ingredients.note: 1 for the meat mixture, 3 for serving

steps: Skin the kiełbasa, chop it finely, and mix with the minced meat, salt, and coarsely ground pepper.
Peel and chop the onions and garlic; add 1/4 of the chopped onion, garlic, oil, flour, and parsley to the meat, then knead into a uniform mixture.
Scoop small portions of the mixture using a heaped tablespoon and shape into oblong rolls with slightly flattened ends.
Grill the rolls on a preheated grill on each side until browned, and serve with a salad of the remaining onions and tomatoes.

name: Chłodnik ogórkowy (Polish cold cucumber soup)
summary: A light chilled soup of fresh cucumbers and celery blended with vegetable broth, plain yogurt, and garlic.
steps: Peel the cucumbers, halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds with a spoon, and dice the flesh, then finely chop the parsley leaves and celery.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, add the prepared vegetables, and cook for 3–4 minutes.
Dust the vegetables with plain flour, stir, pour in the hot vegetable broth, and simmer for 5 minutes over low heat.
Let the broth cool, then blend until smooth and velvety.
Stir in the plain yogurt, add the pressed garlic, season with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and chill thoroughly before serving.

name: Mushroom and root vegetable stew
summary: Hearty vegetable stew made with button mushrooms, carrots, celeriac, and green beans simmered in broth.
steps: Clean, peel, and rinse the mushrooms, carrots, celeriac, green beans, and onions, then chop everything into small pieces.
Melt the butter in a saucepan and saute the chopped onion.
Add the remaining vegetables and mushrooms, pour in the vegetable broth, and braise covered until tender.
Season the stew with basil and sweet paprika, and thicken with flour towards the end of simmering.

name: Frozen mocha cheesecake (Sernik kawowy)
summary: A frozen coffee and chocolate cheesecake made with homogenised curd cheese, sweetened condensed milk, and whipped cream on a biscuit base.
steps: Melt the butter, mix with the crushed biscuits and sugar, and press the crumb mixture firmly into the base and sides of a springform tin.
Dissolve the instant coffee in 1 tbsp of hot water, and melt the broken chocolate in 2 tbsp of warm milk.
Beat the homogenised curd cheese with the condensed milk, dissolved coffee, and melted chocolate until smooth and fluffy.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the coffee-cheese mixture and spread into the prepared crust.
Cover the tin with foil and freeze for 12 hours until firm.

name: Oeufs mimosa (Mimosa stuffed eggs)
summary: Classic eggs stuffed with a mixture of egg yolks, mayonnaise, and parsley leaves, then sprinkled with sieved egg yolk.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, cool, peel, and cut in half lengthwise.
Remove the yolks and push through a sieve, then mix half of the sieved yolks with the mayonnaise, chopped parsley leaves, salt, and black pepper.
Fill the hollowed egg white halves with the prepared yolk mixture.
Arrange the stuffed eggs on a platter lined with lettuce leaves, sprinkle with the remaining sieved yolks, and garnish with tomato slices.

name: Likier z czarnych jagód (wild bilberry liqueur)
summary: Spiced wild bilberry liqueur made with rectified spirit and honey with hints of cinnamon, cloves, and orange.
steps: Place the bilberries, cloves, orange peel, and cinnamon bark into a demijohn and pour in the rectified spirit.
Cork the vessel tightly, shake vigorously, and set aside for 3 weeks, swirling the contents from time to time.
Boil 500 ml of water with the honey, skim off any scum, and remove the pot from the heat.
Gradually pour the filtered spirit infusion into the hot honey mixture, stirring constantly.
Pour everything back into the demijohn, cork tightly, and set aside for another 3 weeks, then filter again, bottle, and leave in a cool, dark place for several months.

name: Sałatka grzybowa (pickled mushroom and potato salad)
summary: A robust salad of soaked fermented mushrooms, pan-fried potatoes and onions, grated tart apple and plenty of garlic.

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.note: part for sautéing, remainder for the salad

steps: Soak the fermented mushrooms in cold water for several hours, changing the water a few times, then drain well and slice into strips.
Peel the tart apple and grate it coarsely on a box grater.
Peel the onions and dice them along with the boiled potatoes, then sauté briefly in part of the oil and allow to cool.
Peel the garlic cloves and press them through a garlic press.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl, drizzle with the remaining oil, season with salt and pepper, mix thoroughly, and chill before serving.

name: Koktajl karambolowy (starfruit cocktail)
summary: A refreshing cocktail made with champagne, vermouth, and pineapple juice, garnished with diced pineapple and starfruit slices.
steps: Wash the starfruit, slice off a few star-shaped rounds for garnish, and cut the remainder into small pieces.
Dice the pineapple slices finely, crush the ice cubes, and place them into glasses.
Mix the pineapple juice with the vermouth and 125 ml of chilled champagne, then pour into the ice-filled glasses.
Add the diced pineapple and starfruit pieces to the cocktail, and garnish the glasses with the starfruit slices.

name: Pikle ze śliwek (spiced pickled plums)
summary: Spiced prune plums marinated for several days in a sweet-and-sour syrup with cinnamon and garlic, served with roast meat.
steps: Wash the prune plums, remove the stones, and transfer the fruit to a pot.
Bring a syrup of sugar, vinegar, water, cinnamon stick, and peeled garlic cloves to a boil, skimming off foam, then cool slightly and pour over the plums for 24 hours.
On the second and third days, drain the syrup from the fruit, bring it to a rolling boil, and pour it hot back over the plums.
On the fourth day, simmer the plums in the syrup for 10 minutes, then ladle hot into sterilised jars and seal tightly.

name: Karp w piwie (Polish carp braised in lager with root vegetables)
summary: Carp fillets seared in butter and braised with root vegetables and mushrooms in lager beer.
steps: Fillet the carp, cut into portions, season with salt and pepper, dust with wheat flour, and sear in part of the butter.
Peel the onion, celeriac, parsley root, and mushrooms, cut into strips, and cook gently, covered, in the remaining butter until tender.
Pour the lager beer over the vegetables, arrange the seared fish on top, cover, and braise together for about 15 minutes.

name: Mazowiecka potrawka z kury (Masovian chicken fricassee in milk sauce)
summary: Traditional Masovian chicken stew braised with pork fatback and served in a creamy white milk sauce with fresh parsley.
steps: Rinse the hen, cut it into a dozen or so pieces, put them in a saucepan, and add enough water to cover the meat.
Cut the pork fatback into strips, add to the pan, cover tightly with a lid, and braise until the meat is tender and the liquid has evaporated.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the wheat flour, and cook a pale blond roux without letting it brown.
Pour the milk into the roux, bring to a boil while stirring, and season the sauce to taste with salt and pepper.
Arrange the tender pieces of chicken on a serving platter, ladle over the hot milk sauce, and sprinkle with finely chopped parsley leaves.

name: Babka ziemniaczana z mięsem (Potato and minced beef casserole)
summary: A layered potato casserole made with fluffy mashed cooked potatoes and seasoned ground beef with fried onions.

ingredients.name: fat for frying and baking dish

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water, let cool, peel, and pass through a food mill or meat grinder.
Set aside 1 teaspoon of the ground potatoes for the filling, then beat the rest with the butter and 3 egg yolks until smooth, seasoning with salt.
Beat the 3 egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold into the potato mixture.
Grind the beef, peel and chop the onions, fry in fat, then mix the meat with the onions, whole egg, sour cream, reserved teaspoon of potatoes, salt, and pepper.
Spread half of the potato mixture into a greased baking dish, top with the beef filling, cover with the remaining potato mixture, and bake for about 45 minutes at 180 °C.

name: Zupa włoska (Italian-style vegetable soup)
summary: A mild vegetable soup made from Polish soup vegetables and carrots, enriched with sour cream and egg yolk, served with fine soup pasta and grated firm cheese.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: cold to cook the vegetables and water for the pasta

steps: Clean, wash, and cut the soup vegetables and additional carrots into pieces, cover them with cold water, and cook until tender.
Mix the flour with the sour cream and egg yolk, pour into the simmering vegetables, bring to a boil, and season to taste with salt and vegetable seasoning.
Cook the fine pasta separately, and grate the firm cheese on a coarse grater.
Distribute the cooked pasta into soup bowls, top with grated firm cheese, and ladle over the hot soup.

name: Yogurt cake
summary: A fluffy, tender homemade sponge cake made with creamed butter, plain yogurt, and whipped egg whites.
steps: Whisk the flour with the baking powder and baking soda together in a bowl.
Cream the butter with the sugar and egg yolks, then gradually add the flour mixture alternately with the plain yogurt.
Whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold them into the batter.
Transfer the batter to a baking tin and bake for 45 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Jajka nadziewane wiosennym farszem (Spring-herb stuffed eggs in shells)
summary: Eggs in their shells stuffed with a mixture of yolks, butter, sour cream, and fresh herbs.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, let cool, and slice each in half lengthwise through the shell.
Scoop out the yolks and part of the whites, creating hollows in the shell halves for the filling.

Chop the scooped yolks and whites, combine with washed and chopped parsley leaves, chives, and dill, add the softened butter, sour cream, salt, and black pepper, mix, and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Spoon the chilled filling into the eggshell halves, dust with breadcrumbs, and garnish with fresh herb leaves.

name: Green island salad (Zielona sałatka z wysp)
summary: A light salad of cucumbers, yellow zucchini, and arugula with a yogurt-lemon dressing and fresh mint.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: grated zest and freshly squeezed juice

steps: Tear the arugula into smaller pieces, salt lightly, and let stand for a few minutes.
Peel the zucchini and cucumbers, dice them, toss with arugula, and season with salt and pepper.
Whisk the plain yogurt with the lemon zest and squeezed lemon juice, then pour the dressing over the salad.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh mint leaves and serve as a side dish for meat.

name: Zander on braised leeks (Sandacz na duszonych porach)
summary: Zander fillet braised on leek rounds in butter, white wine, whipping cream, and egg yolk.
steps: Rinse and pat dry the zander portion, season with salt and pepper, and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Wash the leek, slice it into fairly thick rounds, and gently fry in a skillet in melted butter.
Season the leeks with salt and pepper, then pour in the white wine mixed with the 30% fat whipping cream and egg yolk.
Place the fish on the leeks, cover the skillet, and braise gently over low heat for about 10 minutes.

name: Braised turkey breast with apricots and curry
summary: Tender turkey breast strips braised with onions, canned apricots, spicy fruit chutney, and aromatic curry.
steps: Slice the turkey breast fillets into thin strips and season with curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a saucepan, saute the chopped onion, add the meat strips, and brown on all sides.
Pour the hot vegetable broth over the meat and braise over low heat for about 15 minutes.
Add the sliced apricots, fruit chutney, and potato starch mixed with 100 ml of the apricot canning liquid, bring to a boil while stirring constantly, and season to taste with salt and black pepper.

name: Iberian white bean soup with croutons
summary: Creamy Spanish white bean soup simmered with red bell pepper, garlic, and fresh marjoram, served with golden butter croutons.
steps: Soak the white beans overnight in cold water, then drain and cover with fresh water.
Finely chop the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper, add to the beans with the olive oil, and simmer until tender.
Pass the soup through a sieve or blend until smooth, pour in the chicken broth, add the fresh marjoram and parsley leaves, season with salt and black pepper, and cook for about 30 minutes more.
Dice the white bread, brown in butter to make golden croutons, and serve floating on the hot soup.

name: Klopsy (braised pork and rice meatballs)
summary: Ground pork and raw rice meatballs braised in a rich vegetable bed of grated carrots, onions, and tomato paste.
steps: Grind the pork collar in a meat grinder, season with salt, pepper, and sweet paprika, and mix with 250 ml of raw rice.
Dice the onions, cook until translucent in 125 ml of heated oil, add the coarsely grated carrots, and fry for 5 minutes over low heat.
Stir the tomato paste into the sautéed vegetables and set aside to cool.
Add one-third of the stewed carrots and onions to the meat-and-rice mixture, mix thoroughly, and shape into small meatballs.
Spread the remaining vegetables over the bottom of a deep pan, arrange the shaped meatballs on top, add a splash of water, and braise, covered, for about 40 minutes.

name: Owocowe pucharki (summer fruit salad cups with honey yogurt)
summary: A light fruit salad of apricots, watermelon, melon, and kiwi drizzled with lemon juice and served with a honey-yogurt dressing.
steps: Wash the fruit, peel the watermelon, melon, and kiwi, stone the apricots, and cut everything into bite-sized cubes.
Squeeze the lemon juice, dissolve the vanilla sugar in it, and drizzle over the prepared fruit.
Whisk the yogurt with the runny honey into a smooth dressing.
Divide the fruit among dessert cups, spoon the honey-yogurt sauce on top, and garnish with fresh mint leaves.

name: Baked stuffed tomatoes (Zapiekane faszerowane pomidory)
summary: Vegan tomatoes stuffed with an aromatic filling of breadcrumbs, garlic, and parsley leaves, drizzled with olive oil and baked in the oven.
steps: Slice off the tomato tops, reserve them, and scoop out the seeds from the inside.
Mix the breadcrumbs with chopped parsley leaves, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Fill the tomatoes with the prepared stuffing and cover with the sliced tops.
Place the tomatoes in a baking dish, drizzle generously with olive oil, and bake for 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.

name: Firm cheese and egg salad (Sałatka z jajkami)
summary: A salad of hard-boiled eggs, firm cheese, leeks, scallions, green bell pepper, and canned peas with a mustard and lemon dressing.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, let cool, peel, and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Trim the scallions and leeks, slicing them on an angle, and cut the seeded green bell pepper into thin matchsticks.
Cut the firm cheese into small dice and combine in a salad bowl with the sliced vegetables, canned peas, eggs, and chopped chives.
Whisk the olive oil with lemon juice, mustard, salt, and pepper into a smooth dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad, cover, and let rest for about 30 minutes before serving.

name: Baked apples with almonds
summary: Tart apple halves baked with butter, fresh orange juice, ground cinnamon, sugar, and toasted flaked almonds.
steps: Wash and peel the tart apples, cut them in half, and scoop out the cores.
Grease a baking dish with some of the butter, arrange the apple halves hollow-side up, and drizzle with orange juice.
Place a knob of the remaining butter into each hollow, and sprinkle the tops with sugar, ground cinnamon, and flaked almonds.
Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for about 30 minutes.

name: Jajka w sosie wielkanocnym (Polish Easter eggs in horseradish cream sauce)
summary: Hard-boiled egg halves in a chilled sour cream, horseradish, dill, and chive sauce.
steps: Hard-boil 10 eggs, let them cool, and peel them.
Press one hard-boiled egg through a sieve and mix with sour cream 22%, horseradish, the remaining raw egg, dill, and chives.
Season the sauce to taste with salt and sugar.
Cut the remaining hard-boiled eggs in half lengthwise, arrange on a platter, and pour over the prepared sauce.

name: Nalewka gruszkowa (spiced pear liqueur)
summary: A homemade liqueur made from fresh pear juice, rectified spirit, and rum with a spiced hint of ground cloves.
steps: Wash the pears, chop them into pieces, blend, and chill for a few hours until the sediment settles to the bottom.
Carefully siphon the clear juice from above the sediment and pour it into a pot.
Add the sugar and heat over low heat, stirring continuously until completely dissolved.
Allow the pear syrup to cool, pour in the rectified spirit and rum, and season with ground cloves.
Pour the liquid into a demijohn, seal tightly, and age for 3 months, then filter again.

name: Łosoś z pieczonymi ziemniakami (baked salmon with potatoes)
summary: Salmon fillets baked in foil with onion and herbs, served with baked potatoes and sour cream.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and prepare sheets of aluminium foil.
Divide the salmon fillets into 4 portions, arrange on pieces of foil, season with salt, drizzle with lemon juice, top with sliced onion and chopped herbs, and wrap tightly.
Wash the potatoes thoroughly without peeling, place on separate pieces of foil, drizzle with oil, and wrap.
Place the fish and potato parcels into the oven and bake for about 25 minutes at 200 °C.
Remove from the oven, unwrap the foil, salt the potatoes, and serve the fish portions with the potatoes drizzled with sour cream.

name: Chicken breast with bell peppers in curry sauce (Pierś kurczaka z papryką)
summary: A quick skillet dish of diced chicken breast braised with vibrant bell peppers in an aromatic curry sauce.
steps: Wash the chicken breast, cut into cubes, season with salt, and sauté in hot oil until tender.
Wash the red, yellow, and green bell peppers, remove the seeds, and cut the flesh into strips.
Add the pepper strips and curry powder to the chicken and fry together briefly.
Pour in a little water to form a light sauce and simmer covered until the peppers are tender.

name: Lingonberry and pear preserve
summary: A traditional Polish fruit preserve of tart lingonberries and whole sweet wild pears simmered in lemon-infused syrup.
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a pot with the sugar and finely grated lemon zest to form a clear syrup.
Add the sorted lingonberries to the syrup and simmer gently over low heat until slightly thickened.
Peel the pears thinly while keeping the stems intact, add them to the lingonberries, and simmer gently until translucent, then stir in the freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Carefully ladle the hot lingonberries and pears into sterilized jars, seal immediately, and leave covered with a towel until cool.

name: Peppery beef goulash (Wołowy gulasz z pieprzem)
summary: A spicy goulash of beef strips braised in lard with onion, garlic, bell pepper, and tomatoes, generously seasoned with black pepper.
steps: Cut the beef into strips about 3 cm long, and chop the onions and fry in lard until golden.
Salt the meat, add to the pot with the onions, and brown until it releases juices.
Add a small clove of garlic, splash with a little water, and braise in a small amount of liquid, stirring occasionally and adding water as needed.
When the meat is half-tender, reduce the liquid until only the fat remains, add tomato pulp and diced bell pepper, and continue to cook uncovered over low heat.
Towards the end of cooking, season the goulash generously with black pepper so that it has a distinctly peppery flavor and aroma.

name: Flaki na kwaśnicy (beef tripe soup in sauerkraut juice)
summary: Beef tripe cooked in sauerkraut juice with marjoram and spices, thickened with an onion roux.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for parboiling tripe and thinning roux

steps: Wash the beef tripe thoroughly, cover with hot water in a pot, parboil, and drain.
Cover the tripe with fresh boiling water, parboil again, drain, let cool, and slice into thin strips.
Transfer the sliced tripe to a soup pot, pour in the sauerkraut juice, add the bay leaf and allspice berries, and simmer until tender.
Season the broth with salt, black pepper, and marjoram.
Peel and finely chop the onion, fry it in the heated lard until golden, then add the flour and make a roux.
Thin the roux with a small amount of lukewarm water, whisk into the tripe soup, and bring to a boil.

name: Baked potatoes with herb butter (Ziemniaki z masłem ziołowym)
summary: Slices of potatoes boiled in their skins, baked with herb butter, garlic, lemon juice, fresh herbs, and grated firm cheese.

ingredients.name: herb butter
ingredients.note: 400 g in the original, probably intended to mean 40 g

steps: Wash the potatoes, boil them in their skins, rinse with cold water, and slice into rounds about 0.5 cm thick.
Grease an ovenproof baking dish, arrange the potato slices in it, and season with salt.
Distribute half of the herb butter and crushed garlic over the potatoes, and sprinkle with lemon juice.
Sprinkle everything with grated firm cheese, fresh herbs, and pepper, dot the top with the remaining butter, and bake for 25 minutes in a very hot oven (approx. 200 °C).
Serve hot.

name: Sałatka z makaronu ryżowego i papryki (rice noodle and bell pepper salad)
summary: A colourful Asian-style salad of rice noodles, wood ear mushrooms, three colours of bell pepper, and cucumber with soy sauce.
steps: Pour hot water over the dried wood ear mushrooms and rice noodles in separate bowls and soak for about 15 minutes, then drain.
Wash all three bell peppers, discard the seeds, and julienne the flesh along with the cucumber and soaked wood ear mushrooms into very thin strips.
Toss the rice noodles with the chopped vegetables and mushrooms, pour over the soy sauce, and season to taste with hot paprika and salt.

name: Golden balls (Złote kule)
summary: Hollowed orange halves filled with a chilled, zesty salad of chopped orange pulp, grated apples, and grated horseradish.
steps: Scrub the oranges, scald with boiling water, dry, cut in half, and carefully scoop out the pulp.
Peel the apples, core them, grate finely on a box grater, and immediately drizzle with lemon juice.
Finely chop the orange pulp, combine it with the grated apples and grated horseradish, and season with sugar, salt, and pepper.
Mix the salad thoroughly, chill in the refrigerator, and fill the hollowed orange halves before serving.

name: Rowanberry, pear and apple jam
summary: An autumn jam of blanched wild rowanberries, pears, and apples simmered in sugar syrup with a splash of lemon juice.
steps: Sort through the rowanberries, blanch them in boiling water, and drain well; peel and core the pears and apples, then cut into quarters.
Prepare a syrup by boiling the water and sugar, add the drained rowanberries, and simmer briefly.
Add the sliced apples and pears and cook over very low heat until the fruit turns translucent and the jam thickens nicely.
Stir in the lemon juice, ladle the hot jam into sterilized jars, seal tightly, and leave covered to cool slowly.

name: Kapusta w kolorach tęczy (rainbow layered pickled cabbage with wild mushrooms)
summary: Layered fermented cabbage made with three cabbage varieties, carrots, beetroots, and wild tricholoma mushrooms, pasteurized in a jar.

ingredients.name: yellow knight and green tricholoma mushrooms

steps: Shred the white cabbage, savoy cabbage, and red cabbage separately.
Peel the carrots and beetroots, then coarsely grate them.
Briefly blanch the caps of the wild tricholoma mushrooms in boiling water, then dry them.

Layer into a two-liter jar sequentially: white cabbage, green tricholomas, beetroots, savoy cabbage, yellow knights, carrots, and red cabbage, sprinkling the layers with salt, sugar, caraway seeds, black peppercorns, and cloves, packing down tightly with a pestle.
Leave the firmly packed ferment in a warm place for 3 days, then move to a cool, dark place for a few days.
Seal the jar with a lid and pasteurize for 15–20 minutes in a water bath at 80 °C.

name: Dolmades (Greek stuffed vine leaves)
summary: Tender grape leaves wrapped around an aromatic rice filling with onions, fresh dill, parsley, and mint, gently braised in lemon broth.
steps: Blanch the vine leaves in boiling water and arrange them flat on a plate to cool.
Finely chop the onions and gently fry in the olive oil.
Add the rice, chopped parsley leaves, dill, chopped mint, salt, pepper, and a splash of water to the onions; stir, simmer for 10 minutes, and let cool.
Place a teaspoon of filling near the stem end of each vine leaf, fold the sides inward, and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Line the bottom of the pot with the remaining vine leaves and pack the stuffed rolls closely on top.
Pour the remaining water mixed with the lemon juice over the parcels so they are just submerged, cover, and simmer over low heat for 40–45 minutes until the rice is tender.
Let cool and serve cold.

name: Korzenna pieczeń z gruszkami (spiced roast pork shoulder with pears)
summary: Pork shoulder studded with garlic and cloves, marinated in red wine and wholegrain mustard, roasted with pears.
steps: Make several 1 cm deep cuts in the pork shoulder and insert crushed garlic, crushed cloves, and bay leaves into the slits.
Rub the meat with the ground ginger, curry powder, and thyme.
Mix the wholegrain mustard with the oil, lemon juice, red wine, and a pinch of salt, pour the marinade over the meat, and refrigerate overnight.
Roast the marinated pork shoulder for 60 minutes, turning often and basting with the pan juices.
Surround the roast with the peeled pears and bake for another 30 minutes.

name: Sweet and sour pork ribs (Żeberka na słodko-kwaśno)
summary: Fried pork ribs marinated in plum wine with five-spice powder, glazed with plum sauce and Worcestershire sauce, and garnished with chives.
steps: Mix the plum wine with Chinese spice, pour the marinade over the ribs, and set aside in a cool place for 60 minutes.
Remove the meat from the marinade (reserving the liquid) and pat dry with paper towels.
Fry the ribs in heated soybean oil and season lightly with salt.
Towards the end of frying, pour in the reserved marinade, add plum sauce and Worcestershire sauce, and cook while stirring until the sauce thickens.
Sprinkle the dish with chopped chives before serving.

name: Quiche Lorraine
summary: Classic French tart in shortcrust pastry filled with smoked bacon, onion, and firm cheese, baked in an egg and sour cream custard spiced with cayenne.
steps: Thaw the savoury shortcrust pastry and use it to line a tart tin.
Finely chop the smoked bacon and scatter it over the pastry base along with the chopped onion and grated firm cheese.
Whisk the eggs with the 12% sour cream, season with salt and cayenne pepper, and pour the mixture over the filling in the tin.
Bake the tart for 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 180 °C, then reduce the temperature to 150 °C and bake for another 10 minutes, then let cool.

name: Jajka faszerowane (Polish deviled eggs with cheese and sweetcorn)
summary: Hard-boiled egg halves stuffed with a mixture of egg yolks, semi-hard cheese, sweetcorn, sour cream, and mayonnaise.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs, let them cool, peel, and cut in half lengthwise.
Remove the egg yolks and mash until smooth with the grated cheese, thick sour cream, mayonnaise, and mustard.
Stir the drained sweetcorn and chopped chives into the yolk mixture, and season to taste with salt and black pepper.
Fill the hollowed egg whites with the prepared mixture, arrange on a platter, and garnish with radish slices and radish sprouts.

name: Strawberry and red wine sorbet
summary: An airy sorbet made from strawberry puree, red wine, and whipped egg white, garnished with pomegranate seeds and lime slices.
steps: Puree the strawberries until smooth, dissolve the sugar in the red wine, and whip the egg white to stiff peaks.
Combine the strawberry puree with the sweetened wine and whipped egg white, cover, and place in the freezer for 180 minutes, stirring several times during freezing.
Transfer the sorbet from the freezer to the top refrigerator shelf 15 minutes before serving.
Break up the slightly softened sorbet, blend briefly, spoon into chilled dessert dishes, and serve immediately garnished with pomegranate seeds and lime slices.

name: Turkish-style braised vegetables (Warzywa po turecku)
summary: A layered vegetable stew of multicoloured bell peppers, tomatoes, courgette, green beans, onion, and fried aubergine slices.
steps: Scald and peel the tomatoes, cut them and the onions into thin rounds, cut the peppers into pieces, and slice the courgette and aubergines.
Season the aubergine slices with salt and pepper, sprinkle with lemon juice, and set aside for 10 minutes, then dredge in flour, fry in 3 tablespoons of olive oil until golden, and drain.
Cook the green beans for 2 minutes in a small amount of salted boiling water and drain.

Season the remaining vegetables with salt and pepper, arrange them in layers in a shallow pot, top with the fried aubergines, and pour over 500 ml of water and the remaining 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Braise covered for about 45 minutes, and garnish generously with chopped fresh parsley before serving.

name: Baked leeks with Emmental cheese (Pory zapiekane)
summary: Tender leek whites simmered with a hint of nutmeg and baked au gratin under an herbed béchamel-sour cream sauce with grated Emmental cheese.
steps: Trim the white parts of the leeks, slice in half lengthwise, wash thoroughly, and boil for about 20 minutes in 2 litres of water with a pinch of nutmeg.
Grease a baking dish with half a teaspoon of margarine, lift out the cooked leeks, drain well, and arrange in the dish.
Make a blond roux with the remaining margarine and wheat flour, gradually whisk in the milk, and bring to a boil.
Stir the sour cream, salt, white pepper, thyme, and tarragon into the sauce and mix well.
Pour the sauce over the leeks, scatter with chopped parsley leaves and grated Emmental, and bake in an oven preheated to 200 °C until the cheese turns golden brown.

name: Keks warzywny (savoury vegetable loaf cake)
summary: A savoury loaf cake with carrots, red bell pepper, green beans, and courgette, baked in a loaf tin.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: plus extra for greasing the tin

steps: Dice the carrots, red bell pepper, and courgette, trim the woody ends off the green beans, and cut the pods into smaller pieces.
Parboil the vegetables in boiling water: the bell pepper and courgette for 5 minutes, and the carrots and green beans for 10 minutes, then drain, pat dry, and toss in a little plain flour.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites and beat the yolks with 200 g of butter until smooth and fluffy.
Add the remaining plain flour mixed with the baking powder, season with salt and white pepper, and combine with the cooled vegetables.
Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold them into the batter.
Transfer the mixture into the buttered loaf tin, bake for 50–60 minutes in an oven preheated to 210 °C, and slice once cooled.

name: Pstrąg po królewsku (royal-style trout with celery)
summary: Trout steaks seasoned with sweet paprika and caraway, seared in butter and baked in white wine, served with tied bundles of celery stalks.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: part for frying, part for drizzling with breadcrumbs

steps: Gut and clean the trout, cut into steaks, rinse and pat dry, then coat in sweet paprika and season with salt, pepper, and caraway.
Melt part of the butter in a skillet, sear the fish pieces on both sides until golden, pour in the white wine, and bake for 10 minutes in an oven preheated to 200 °C.
Cut the celery stalks into pieces about 10 cm long, scald with boiling water, and drain; slice the leek into thin ribbons and use them to tie the celery into bundles.
Arrange the baked trout and celery bundles on a platter, drizzle with the remaining melted butter mixed with browned breadcrumbs, and garnish with lemon slices.

name: Aragonese-style pork with ham and olives (Wieprzowina Aragończyka)
summary: Tender pork cutlets braised with ham, black olives, onion, tomato paste, and dry white wine.
steps: Peel the onion and dice it along with the ham and black olives.
Trim the pork of excess fat, cut into 4 slices, pound lightly, season with salt, and dredge in flour.
Brown the meat slices on both sides in hot olive oil, then transfer them along with the cooking fat to a saucepan.
Add the onion, ham, and olives, cook gently for a moment, then stir in the tomato paste, cover, and simmer until the meat is tender.
Towards the end of braising, pour in the dry white wine, bring to the boil, transfer the meat to a serving platter, and spoon the sauce over it.

name: Lody z sosem orzechowym (ice cream with warm nut sauce)
summary: Ice cream dessert topped with a warm sauce made from condensed milk, egg yolks, nuts, and desiccated coconut.
steps: Whisk the condensed milk with the egg yolks in a saucepan and add the butter.
Heat the mixture over low heat for about 10 minutes, stirring constantly, until it thickens and comes to a simmer.
Add the vanilla flavouring oil and heat for another 2–3 minutes, stirring continuously.
Remove the saucepan from the heat, stir in the chopped walnuts, hazelnuts, and 125 ml of desiccated coconut, and mix well.
Scoop portions of ice cream and ladle the warm nut sauce over them.

name: Chocolate and walnut truffles (Trufle czekoladowo-orzechowe)
summary: Homemade no-bake truffles made from ground walnuts, crumbled yeast cake, chocolate, rum, and lemon, rolled in desiccated coconut.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: juice of both and grated zest of half

steps: Grind the shelled walnuts and mix them with the crumbled yeast cake and sugar.
Add the rum, the juice squeezed from two lemons, and the grated zest of half a lemon.
Warm the milk, melt the chocolate in it, pour into the dry ingredients, and knead into a pliable paste.
Shape the mixture into balls about 4 cm in diameter, roll each in desiccated coconut, and arrange on a platter to dry.

name: Zupa kremowa z orzechów (Walnut cream soup)
summary: A creamy vegetarian walnut, onion, and apple soup in a broth and milk base, flavoured with orange, curry, and nutmeg.
steps: Grate the zest from the washed orange and squeeze out its juice.
Peel and chop the onions, cook until translucent in melted butter, then add the chopped walnuts and the peeled, diced apple.
Dust the ingredients with the flour, curry powder, and nutmeg, and stir briefly.
Pour in the broth, milk, and orange juice, add the grated orange zest, and simmer over low heat for 15–20 minutes.
Blend the soup into a smooth cream and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Stir the sour cream into the slightly cooled soup, mix thoroughly, and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving.

name: Kluski z bryndzą (bryndza cheese dumplings)
summary: Savoury wheat dumplings prepared with sheep's milk bryndza cheese, plain yogurt, and fresh dill.
steps: Cream the bryndza cheese in a bowl with a wooden spoon until smooth, and rinse and finely chop the dill.
Add 125 ml of plain yogurt, the chopped dill, sifted plain flour, and egg to the bryndza, and knead into a firm dough.
Cover the dough and set aside for 60 minutes to rest.
Roll out the dough fairly thickly on a floured board and cut into small squares.
Drop the dumplings in batches into salted boiling water, cook until they float to the surface, then remove to a sieve and rinse with warm water.

name: Salmon spread on toast (Tosty z łososiem)
summary: Crispy oven-baked toasts topped with a spread of pan-seared and smoked salmon, mayonnaise, olives, and fresh dill.
steps: Season the fresh salmon with salt and pepper, fry in a portion of the oil, and flake into small pieces once cooled.
Finely dice the smoked salmon and combine with the fried fish.
Add the mayonnaise, chopped olives, juice from part of the lemon, and chopped dill, mix thoroughly, and season to taste with salt and pepper.
