Finely chop the onions and fry them in butter for about 8 minutes until golden brown, reserving part of the onions and butter for topping the finished dumplings.

Cream the egg yolks with a tablespoon of butter until pale, add three tablespoons of wheat flour, the browned onion, and the soaked breadcrumbs, season with salt, and gently fold in the stiffly beaten egg whites.
Shape the mixture into round dumplings and roll each one in wheat flour.
Drop the dumplings into boiling salted water in a large pot and boil for about 10 minutes, then lift out with a slotted spoon onto a platter and pour plenty of onion-browned butter over them.

name: Pierogi gryczane w papilotach (buckwheat pierogi baked in paper)
summary: Pierogi made from buckwheat flour and sour cream dough, filled with farmer's cheese, baked in paper packets, and served with a sour cream and butter sauce.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: 2 for the dough and 1 for mashing with the farmer's cheese

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.note: for mixing the dough and for the sauce

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted for brushing the paper and for boiling with the sour cream

steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C and beat 2 eggs in a bowl with the buckwheat flour, salt, and enough sour cream to form a fairly soft dough.
Mash the farmer's cheese in a separate bowl with the remaining 1 egg until smooth.
Brush sheets of baking paper with melted butter, spread a thin round of buckwheat dough on each, and place a spoonful of the farmer's cheese filling in the centre.
Fold each pieróg in half together with the paper, crimp the edges of the paper packets tightly, and arrange them on a baking sheet.
Place the baking sheet in the oven preheated to 220 °C and bake for about 20 minutes until the paper browns.
Boil an extra portion of sour cream with butter in a small saucepan for 5 minutes and serve in a sauceboat alongside the baked pierogi.

name: Strudel z serem (Polish quark cheese strudel)
summary: Traditional strudel made from hand-stretched, paper-thin dough filled with a sweet and salty mixture of farmer's cheese, sour cream, and eggs.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: 1 for the dough and 2 for the cheese filling

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp for the dough and 1 tsp for the cheese filling

ingredients.name: plain wheat flour
ingredients.note: approximately 350–400 g, as needed to form the dough, plus extra for dusting the tablecloth

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, for sprinkling the dough and greasing the baking dish

steps: Knead a supple, medium-soft dough from 1 egg, the water, 1 teaspoon of salt, and the wheat flour, then beat it against the board for 10 minutes, cover with a warm bowl, and let rest for 60 minutes.
Roll out the dough, transfer it to a tablecloth dusted with wheat flour, stretch it carefully with your fingers from the centre outwards until paper-thin, and let dry slightly for 30 minutes.
Beat the farmer's cheese with the remaining 2 eggs, sour cream, 1 teaspoon of salt, and sugar until smooth.
Sprinkle the stretched dough with melted butter, spread the cheese filling thinly over it, and roll it up into a long log with the aid of the tablecloth.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C, butter a shallow baking dish, coil the strudel carefully into a spiral, and drizzle the top with melted butter.
Bake the strudel in the oven preheated to 220 °C for 60 minutes until golden brown.

name: Grzyby z kaszą gryczaną (porcini mushrooms with buckwheat groats)
summary: Fluffy buckwheat groats baked under a layer of fresh porcini mushrooms braised with onion and sour cream.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for cooking the groats until fluffy

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for the groats, plus extra for greasing the dish and cooking the mushrooms

steps: Cook the buckwheat groats in water with a tablespoon of butter for about 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Cook the sliced porcini mushrooms gently in butter with the chopped onion for about 15 minutes, then stir in the sour cream.
Butter an ovenproof dish, spread the cooked buckwheat groats over the bottom, and spoon the creamed mushrooms on top without mixing the layers.
Place the dish in an oven preheated to 180 °C for 5 minutes and serve hot.

name: Zrazy nelsońskie z grzybów (vegetarian Nelson casserole with dried mushrooms and potatoes)
summary: A vegetarian casserole of sliced potatoes, whole dried mushroom caps, and onions, braised slowly under cover in a sauce of sour cream and mushroom broth.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: or milk, for soaking and boiling the mushrooms

steps: Soak the dried mushrooms overnight in a bowl of water for about 480 minutes, then boil them until tender for 30 minutes and strain the broth.
Cut the raw potatoes into rounds and the onions into thin slices.
Put the butter on the bottom of a casserole or ovenproof dish, then layer the potatoes, whole cooked dried mushrooms, and onions, seasoning each layer lightly with salt and pepper.
Mix the sour cream with the strained mushroom broth and pour over the dish so that the sauce covers it completely.
Cover the dish with a lid, cook gently over very low heat for about 45 minutes until the potatoes are completely tender, and serve in the same dish.

name: Jajecznica z grzybami (baked eggs with porcini mushrooms)
summary: Fresh porcini or slippery jack mushrooms braised with onion in a thick sour cream sauce, baked under a layer of eggs beaten with milk.
steps: Clean the porcini mushrooms, slice them into strips, and cook gently in butter with the chopped onion for about 12 minutes.
Sprinkle the mushrooms with the wheat flour, pour in the sour cream, season with salt and pepper, simmer for 3 minutes, and transfer to a shallow ovenproof dish.
Beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of salt, then pour the egg mixture over the mushrooms without stirring.
Place the dish in an oven preheated to 200 °C for about 10 minutes until the eggs are set, and serve immediately.

name: Rydze zapiekane z ryżem (baked saffron milk cap mushrooms with rice and cheese)
summary: An autumn dish of saffron milk cap mushrooms fried in butter and tossed with fluffy rice and golden onions, baked under a crust of sharp cheese.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for cooking the rice until fluffy

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for the mushrooms, plus a little extra for the rice and onion

steps: Briefly sauté the rice in a little butter, pour in the water, and cook until fluffy for about 15 minutes.
Dry-clean the saffron milk cap mushrooms and fry them until golden brown in 1 tablespoon of butter for about 10 minutes.
Slice the onion into strips and fry separately in butter until golden.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C, toss the rice, mushrooms, and onion together in an ovenproof dish, sprinkle the top generously with coarsely grated cheese, and bake for 15 minutes.

name: Grzyby w koszyku (creamed mushrooms in a bread bowl)
summary: Fresh porcini or button mushrooms braised in a thick sour cream sauce, baked and served inside a hollowed, cheese-crusted wheat loaf.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for brushing the loaf and cooking the mushrooms

steps: Grate off the outer crust of the day-old half-kilogram wheat loaf on a coarse grater, slice off the top about 2 cm thick, and hollow out the centre with a spoon, leaving walls 2 cm thick.

Brush the hollowed loaf and the cut lid thinly inside and out with butter, sprinkle generously with grated sharp cheese, and bake in the oven at 160 °C for about 10 minutes until the cheese melts and the bread is lightly toasted.

Meanwhile, cook the sliced porcini mushrooms gently in butter with the chopped onion for about 15 minutes, then sprinkle with the wheat flour, pour in the sour cream, and simmer for another 5 minutes until the sauce is very thick.
Fill the toasted bread basket with the thick creamed mushrooms, replace the top lid, and return to the oven preheated to 180 °C for 10 minutes.
Serve the dish immediately from the oven while the bread remains crisp.

name: Turkey à la Daube
summary: Boned turkey stuffed with meat forcemeat, ham, gherkins, and omelets, simmered in broth and served cold.

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.note: orig. 1¼ funt; converted assuming 1 funt = 400 g

ingredients.name: French roll
ingredients.note: quantity according to the ingredient list

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.note: for soaking the roll; amount not specified in the source

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: orig. half a funt; converted assuming 1 funt = 400 g

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: for frying the onion; no separate amount specified in the source

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: quantity according to the ingredient list

ingredients.name: cooked ham
ingredients.note: orig. ⅓ funt; converted assuming 1 funt = 400 g

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: for separate egg-white and egg-yolk omelets

ingredients.name: gherkins
ingredients.note: for layering; amount not specified in the source

ingredients.name: broth
ingredients.note: for cooking the turkey; volume and composition not specified in the source

steps: Bone the turkey completely by slitting along the back, keeping the skin and meat intact.
Salt the turkey.
Soak the roll in milk.
Fry the chopped onion in the butter intended for frying.
Grind the membrane-trimmed veal and liver together with the soaked roll, 200 g of butter, the onion, seven eggs, and pepper.
Slice the cooked ham.
Separate the whites from the yolks of the five eggs intended for the omelets.
Fry one omelet from the whites and a separate one from the yolks.
Fill the turkey with alternating layers of forcemeat, ham, gherkins, and omelets.
Sew up the opening in the turkey.
Wrap the turkey in a clean cloth and tie with kitchen twine.
Simmer in the broth for 180 minutes.
Remove the turkey and leave it wrapped until completely cooled.
Unwrap the cooled turkey.
Serve the sliced turkey garnished with mayonnaise and accompanied by mustard sauce.
